jobs.title: Senior Fullstack .NET developer
.NET Developer
.Net Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Bouw mee aan innovatieve oplossingen binnen de energiemarkt!

Zie jij uitdaging in het ontwerpen, ontwikkelen en optimaliseren van softwareoplossingen? Bij Scholt Energy krijg je de kans om een belangrijke rol te spelen in de snel veranderende energiemarkt. Samen met een team van 10 tot 15 gedreven ontwikkelaars vertaal je strategische doelstellingen naar slimme informatievoorzieningen en systeemintegraties die risico's verminderen en de efficiëntie verhogen. Jouw communicatieve vaardigheden zorgen ervoor dat projecten succesvol worden afgerond, terwijl je de kwaliteit van de software en documentatie hooghoudt. Je vertaalt wensen naar softwareoplossingen en houdt daarbij rekening met technische en functionele eisen, waarborgt de kwaliteit en zorgt voor een actuele documentatie.

Bij Scholt Energy doe je meer dan alleen software onderhouden; door onze aanhoudende groei werk je actief mee aan het ontwikkelen en toevoegen van nieuwe functionaliteiten die ons én de energiemarkt naar een hoger niveau tillen!

Wat breng je mee:

Een bachelorsdiploma, bijvoorbeeld in informatica of een vergelijkbare richting, aangevuld met minimaal vijf jaar relevante werkervaring binnen softwareontwikkeling of integratie.
Sterke kennis van .NET C#, waarbij ervaring met TypeScript of JavaScript, SQL, Azure en het Microsoft Power Platform worden gezien als een pre.
Aantoonbare ervaring met het ontwerpen, initiëren en realiseren van softwareoplossingen binnen vastgestelde architectuur- en beveiligingsrichtlijnen.
Het vermogen om teams te ondersteunen bij de ontwikkeling en implementatie van informatievoorzieningsoplossingen en om de impact van proces- en systeemwijzigingen nauwkeurig te analyseren.
Ervaring met het bewaken van integraties, inclusief monitoring, root cause analyses en het verbeteren van prestaties en betrouwbaarheid.
Een nauwkeurige en gestructureerde manier van werken waardoor documentatie, rapportages en informatiestromen altijd volledig, duidelijk en actueel zijn.
Het vermogen om als intern en extern aanspreekpunt te fungeren voor de doorontwikkeling van software en integraties, inclusief technische advisering op het gebied van inrichting en maatwerk.
Ervaring in het opstellen en evalueren van businesscases.
Een vooruitdenkende instelling, gecombineerd met analytisch vermogen en uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden, waardoor je complexe vraagstukken helder weet over te brengen.

Wat wij jou bieden:

Een organisatie met een duidelijke visie: klimaat neutrale energie voor alle bedrijven. Wij ondersteunen onze klanten en partners in de energietransitie. We zijn ambitieus, maar tegelijkertijd realistisch over wat haalbaar is.
Een open, betrokken en professionele bedrijfscultuur: bij ons staat een persoonlijke aanpak voorop maar tegelijkertijd blijven we professioneel en gefocust. We vinden het belangrijk dat collega’s het naar hun zin hebben en met een eNPS (medewerkerstevredenheid) van maar liefst +37 weten we dit met z’n allen te bereiken.
Werkplezier als vast onderdeel van je baan. We vieren successen. Dit doen we door onder andere elke werkweek af te sluiten met een borrel, verschillende sportevents te organiseren, een jaarlijkse teamactiviteit en een internationaal bedrijfsuitje met collega’s uit al onze landen. Jij kiest wat je leuk vindt en waarbij je graag aansluit.
Een internationaal team dat jou verwelkomt. Gedreven collega’s uit verschillende landen die uitkijken naar jouw kennis, ideeën en energie.
Bij ons creëer jij zélf je kansen. Wie initiatief toont en wil groeien, kan bereiken wat hij of zij wil. Jij bepaalt het tempo én de richting; wij zorgen voor de mogelijkheden. Er is geen vast opleidingsbudget: iedere training, opleiding of cursus die jou sterker maakt in je rol én bijdraagt aan onze gezamenlijke ambities, ondersteunen we volledig. In 2025 stroomden maar liefst 102 collega’s intern door naar een nieuwe functie — simpelweg omdat ze hun kansen grepen en hun eigen pad vormgaven.
Aantrekkelijke arbeidsvoorwaarden. Met waaronder vakantiegeld, een zorgeloos pensioen, een fietsplan en 28 vakantiedagen, met de mogelijkheid om tot 5 extra dagen bij te kopen bij een fulltime dienstverband.
Flexibel werken mét persoonlijke verbinding. Start je dag tussen 7.00 en 9.00 uur. Je werkt minimaal drie dagen per week op kantoor en de rest kan je (indien gewenst) werken vanuit thuis. Daarvoor ontvang je een thuiswerkvergoeding én €250 om jouw thuiswerkplek naar wens in te richten. Je ontvangt deze vergoeding ongeacht of jij jouw thuiswerkplek al hebt ingericht of niet.

jobs.title: .NET Azure Developer
jobs.description:
Niet nog een vacature met een lijstje requirements.

Je kent het inmiddels waarschijnlijk wel.

“Wij zoeken een enthousiaste .NET Developer die wil werken in een dynamische omgeving…”

Nee.

Daar zoeken we je niet voor.

We zoeken iemand die het interessant vindt om te ontdekken wat er technisch mogelijk is
.

Iemand die C# en .NET niet alleen gebruikt omdat het de stack van vandaag is, maar omdat je het leuk vindt om software goed te bouwen. En die nieuwsgierig genoeg is om vervolgens te kijken hoe Azure, cloud, automation en AI
je oplossingen nog beter kunnen maken.

Voor een innovatieve organisatie in Rotterdam
zoeken we een .NET Developer
die daar onderdeel van wil worden.

Dit wordt jouw technische speelveld

Je werkt dagelijks met C# en .NET
en bouwt aan software die daadwerkelijk gebruikt wordt.
Maar je blijft niet hangen in één applicatie of één stukje functionaliteit.

Je gaat aan de slag met onder andere:
C# / .NET 8+

ASP.NET Core
REST API's
Entity Framework Core
SQL
Microsoft Azure
Azure Functions
Azure App Services
Azure Service Bus
Azure DevOps
CI/CD
Docker
Microservices

En afhankelijk van jouw interesses en ervaring kun je je verder verdiepen in bijvoorbeeld AI, Azure OpenAI, cloud-native development, Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code of softwarearchitectuur
.

De technologie staat hier niet voor de sier.

Er wordt daadwerkelijk gekeken naar hoe nieuwe technologie kan bijdragen aan betere, slimmere en schaalbaardere software
.

Je krijgt hier geen dichtgetimmerde rol

Misschien ben je een sterke backend developer.

Misschien ben je inmiddels richting cloud aan het bewegen.

Of misschien ben je juist die .NET'er die steeds vaker denkt:
“Dit moet toch slimmer kunnen?”

Alle drie kunnen interessant zijn.

We zoeken geen wandelend certificatenoverzicht. We zoeken iemand met een stevige technische basis die wil blijven leren en verantwoordelijkheid durft te pakken
.
Je denkt mee over architectuur, technische keuzes en de manier waarop software ontwikkeld wordt.

En als jij een technologie ontdekt waarvan je denkt dat die interessant kan zijn voor het team?
Dan verwachten we dat je hem op tafel legt.

Wat we wél belangrijk vinden

Je hebt ongeveer 5 jaar of meer professionele ervaring met C#/.NET
en begrijpt wat erbij komt kijken om software professioneel te ontwikkelen.

Daarnaast:
Je hebt ervaring met .NET / ASP.NET Core
Je hebt ervaring met Azure óf wilt hier serieus verder in groeien
Je bent bekend met API's en databases
Je kunt zelfstandig werken, maar zoekt actief de samenwerking op
Je bent technisch nieuwsgierig
Je denkt in oplossingen in plaats van alleen in tickets
Je spreekt en schrijft goed Nederlands

Dat laatste is belangrijk: Nederlands spreken en schrijven is een harde eis voor deze functie.

Gouda als uitvalsbasis

Je werkt vanuit Rotterdam
, gecombineerd met de mogelijkheid om hybride te werken.

De organisatie is groot genoeg om interessante technische uitdagingen te hebben, maar klein genoeg om niet te verdwijnen in eindeloze lagen management.

Je ziet wat er met jouw werk gebeurt.

Je kunt ideeën aandragen.

Je kunt jezelf ontwikkelen.

En je krijgt de ruimte om niet alleen een betere developer te worden, maar ook te ontdekken waar jij technisch het beste tot je recht komt
.

Wat staat daar tegenover?
€4.000 – €6.500 bruto per maand
, afhankelijk van je ervaring.

Daarnaast:
32–40 uur
Hybride werken
Goede pensioenregeling
Reiskostenvergoeding
Laptop
Ruime mogelijkheden voor opleiding en certificering
Veel ruimte voor professionele ontwikkeling
Werken met moderne Microsoft-technologie
Een omgeving waarin innovatie daadwerkelijk onderdeel is van de cultuur

Misschien is dit het moment om verder te kijken

Als jij bij het lezen van C# → .NET → Azure → Cloud → AI → innovatie
denkt:
“Ja. Dit klinkt een stuk interessanter dan mijn huidige project.”

Dan wil ik je spreken.

Je hoeft niet overal expert in te zijn.

Je moet vooral een goede .NET Developer zijn, Nederlands spreken
en nieuwsgierig zijn naar wat er technisch nog meer mogelijk is.

Rotterdam

SENIOR .NET DEVELOPER

Vast dienstverband | 32–40 uur | Hybride

BOUW AAN SOFTWARE DIE ERTOE DOET

Voor een innovatieve organisatie met een sterke maatschappelijke focus zijn wij op zoek naar een ervaren .NET Developer
. Je werkt binnen een moderne softwareomgeving aan applicaties die dagelijks door grote groepen gebruikers worden gebruikt.

Je krijgt volop ruimte om mee te denken over technische oplossingen, softwarearchitectuur en de verdere ontwikkeling van het platform. Daarbij staat niet alleen goede code centraal, maar ook de impact die jouw werk heeft op de organisatie en haar gebruikers.

JOUW ROL ALS .NET DEVELOPER

Als .NET Developer ben je betrokken bij het ontwerpen, ontwikkelen, verbeteren en onderhouden van bedrijfskritische software
. Je werkt nauw samen met andere developers, productverantwoordelijken en technische specialisten.

Naast het ontwikkelen van kwalitatieve software denk je actief mee over schaalbaarheid, security, performance en maintainability
. Je krijgt de ruimte om technische keuzes te onderbouwen en verbeteringen daadwerkelijk door te voeren.

WAT GA JE DOEN?

.

jobs.title: Manager Software Engineering I Product Engineering Unit
jobs.description:
Je nieuwe baan

Wat ga je allemaal doen?
Als Manager Software Engineering geef je leiding aan een internationale softwareontwikkelafdeling van ruim 55 developers binnen de Product Engineering Unit van Blyce. De teams zijn verspreid over Europa, het Caribisch gebied en andere internationale locaties. Samen ontwikkel je innovatieve software die dagelijks impact heeft op miljoenen burgers wereldwijd en geef je richting aan de verdere groei, professionalisering en toekomst van de engineeringorganisatie.

Je rapporteert aan de Unit Manager Product Engineering en bent verantwoordelijk voor de mensen, de kwaliteit en de performance van de softwareontwikkelafdeling. In deze rol vorm je samen met de Manager Software Quality Engineering, Manager Platform Engineering en Manager Software Delivery het leiderschapsteam van de Product Engineering Unit. Je werkt nauw samen met de Delivery Coördinators voor de levering van producten en projecten bij klanten.
Je stuurt meerdere development teams, technical leads en senior engineers aan en creëert de structuur, samenwerking en executiekracht die nodig zijn om een groeiende internationale organisatie succesvol verder te ontwikkelen. Daarbij zorg je ervoor dat engineering, testing, delivery en deployment als één geheel opereren.

In deze rol ligt de nadruk voor circa 70% op people leadership en voor 30% op proces en technologie. Je coacht medewerkers, ontwikkelt talent, bouwt high performing teams en zorgt ervoor dat de juiste mensen op de juiste plek zitten. Tegelijkertijd ben je technisch geloofwaardig genoeg om richting te geven aan belangrijke thema’s zoals softwarekwaliteit, testautomatisering, platformmodernisering, security, DevOps, CI/CD en AI-gedreven softwareontwikkeling. Blyce beweegt zich daarbij vanuit een installed base in low code richting C#/.NET en React.

Jouw belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden:

Leidinggeven aan en ontwikkelen van software engineers, teamleads en senior developers. Op dit moment bestaat de afdeling uit 55 developers en groeit deze geleidelijk door naar circa 65 medewerkers (eind 2027). Je denkt mee over de toekomstige organisatiestructuur, rapportagelijnen en onboarding, met als doel een beheersbare span of control van circa 5 tot 7 directe rapportages.
Verhogen van softwarekwaliteit, voorspelbaarheid en leverbetrouwbaarheid.
Professionaliseren van engineeringprocessen, standaarden en kwaliteitsbewaking.
Bevorderen van samenwerking tussen Development, Testing, Delivery en Platform Engineering.
Verminderen van technical debt en bijdragen aan de verdere modernisering van het platform.
Verantwoord inzetten van AI binnen de softwareontwikkelcyclus.
Vertalen van de bedrijfsstrategie naar concrete verbeteringen binnen Software Engineering.
Bouwen aan een schaalbare engineeringorganisatie die klaar is voor verdere internationale groei.

Over het bedrijf

Waar kom je te werken?
Blyce ontwikkelt en levert bedrijfskritische software voor kleinschalige overheden en publieke organisaties met name in het Caribisch gebied en de Pacific. Met haar oplossingen helpt Blyce overheden om belastinginkomsten efficiënter te innen, zodat financiële middelen beschikbaar komen voor maatschappelijke voorzieningen zoals zorg, onderwijs en infrastructuur. Een mooi succesverhaal is Anguilla, waar de belastingopbrengsten in drie jaar tijd zijn verdubbeld. Daarnaast wordt momenteel een kantoor in Kuala Lumpur opgezet om een betere wereldwijde tijdzonedekking te realiseren.

De impact van het werk is daardoor direct zichtbaar. Zo hebben overheden dankzij de software van Blyce hun belastingopbrengsten aanzienlijk kunnen vergroten, waardoor investeringen mogelijk werden in publieke voorzieningen en economische ontwikkeling.

Blyce bevindt zich bovendien in een interessante groeifase. De organisatie groeit internationaal, breidt haar technologie verder uit en maakt de transitie van een projectgedreven naar een productgedreven organisatie. Dat betekent meer standaardisatie, moderne technologieën, schaalbare softwareplatformen en multidisciplinaire productteams.

Wat Blyce onderscheidt, is de combinatie van maatschappelijke relevantie, internationale dynamiek en de mogelijkheid om daadwerkelijk invloed uit te oefenen op de toekomst van de softwareontwikkelingsafdeling. Hier ben je geen manager in een grote corporate structuur, maar een zichtbare leider die impact maakt op mensen, technologie én organisatie.

Wat we jou bieden

Een salaris tussen € 6.080 en € 8.100 bruto per maand, aangevuld met uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden, waaronder vakantiegeld, een extra maandvergoeding, een jaarlijkse bonus, een goede pensioenregeling en hybride werken.
Een sleutelrol binnen een internationaal softwarebedrijf met maatschappelijke impact, waarvan overheden dagelijks afhankelijk zijn.
De kans om een snelgroeiende internationale softwareontwikkelorganisatie verder vorm te geven en klaar te maken voor de toekomst.
Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, ondernemerschap en leiderschap, met doorgroeimogelijkheden richting een bredere management- of directierol binnen de Product Engineering Unit.
Een organisatie die volop investeert in innovatie, AI en moderne softwareontwikkeling, waarbij jij actief richting geeft aan deze ontwikkelingen.
Een internationale en multiculturele werkomgeving met volop mogelijkheden voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling, samenwerking en teamactiviteiten.

Wat we van jou verwachten

Wij zoeken een ervaren engineering manager die developers weet te inspireren, teams verder brengt en tegelijkertijd structuur, kwaliteit en resultaat realiseert.

Daarnaast breng je mee:
Ervaring met het aansturen van meerdere softwareontwikkelteams binnen een complexe of internationale organisatie.
Aantoonbare ervaring met coaching, performance management en teamontwikkeling.
Een sterke technische basis binnen moderne softwareontwikkelomgevingen.
Kennis van onderwerpen als enterprise software, cloud-native architecturen, API's, DevOps, CI/CD, security en softwarekwaliteit, evenals van C#/.NET en React.
Ervaring met het verbeteren van engineeringprocessen en delivery performance.
Affiniteit met AI en de toepassing daarvan binnen softwareontwikkeling.
Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om verschillende stakeholders te verbinden.
Een uitstekende beheersing van de Engelse taal. Nederlands is een pre.

Je bent een natuurlijke leider die rust brengt, draagvlak creëert en teams succesvol door verandering begeleidt. Je combineert strategisch inzicht met pragmatische executiekracht en weet mensen mee te krijgen in een gezamenlijke ambitie: het bouwen van software die dagelijks impact heeft op miljoenen burgers wereldwijd.

Procedure

De procedure bestaat uit een kennismaking met Executive Search Consultants Fleur van Maasdam, Johan van den Akker en Miana van der Kolk, gevolgd door twee gesprekken met opdrachtgever Blyce en een TMA-analyse.

jobs.title: Software Development Manager
jobs.description:
As Software Development Manager, you hold a pivotal people-first role within our development organization, reporting directly to the CTO. Rather than writing code or architecting systems, your mission is to support the people who do - leading a diverse group of 10–15 engineers as a dedicated coach. Together with your team, you build a thriving engineering culture that blends hard and soft skills. And you don't stop at day-to-day coaching: you look for ways to remove friction and help the team work smarter, including with AI.

Time to grow. Time to thrive.

We are Nmbrs
. We build smart business software that removes unnecessary complexity for SMEs and the professionals who support them. Nmbrs brings together four established product organisations - Payroll, Accounting, Invoicing and Reporting - with teams across the Netherlands, Sweden and Portugal.

We are one brand with a shared ambition, while continuing to work from the expertise and strengths of our individual organisations. We join forces where it makes sense, while keeping teams, expertise and decision-making close together.

For this role, you'll join Nmbrs Accounting in Rotterdam
, working closely with the colleagues in your local team while being part of the wider Nmbrs organisation.

Your role

As Software Development Manager, you're a valued member of our development team, holding a pivotal people-first position and reporting directly to the CTO. Unlike a traditional Tech Lead, your mission isn't to write code or architect systems - it's to support the people who do.
You lead a diverse group of 10–15 FTEs (e.g. front-end developers, QA, and more), acting as a dedicated coach to foster a thriving engineering culture that blends hard and soft skills.

In practice, you will:
Mentor & manage performance:
Provide day-to-day mentorship and performance management for your group of engineers, tailoring your approach to each role — a QA specialist needs different coaching than a developer.
Optimize Developer Experience (DX):
Take a proactive role in reviewing and refining our software engineering processes to remove friction and make our developers' lives easier.
Drive innovation as an AI evangelist:
Act as a key advocate for AI and agentic-supported coding, helping the team embrace and integrate modern tools to work smarter.
Bridge strategy and execution:
Keep a keen eye on the overall roadmap and planning, working across teams to spot (in)efficiencies and ensure our engineering engine runs smoothly.
Cultivate visibility:
Support developers in improving their communication and "internal brand," ensuring their hard work is recognized and aligned with the company's goals.

Your impact

Your work determines whether our engineers can do their best work, not just their busiest work. When you remove friction from a process or coach someone through a tough performance conversation, it's the reason a developer stays focused on solving real problems instead of fighting the system around them. When you help the team adopt AI-driven tools well, it's the difference between a slow, incremental improvement and a genuine step-change in how fast we ship.

You're also shaping how engineering leadership works at Nmbrs Accounting: reporting directly to the CTO, your read on the roadmap, team efficiency, and culture directly influences how the wider engineering organization performs and feels to work in.

You bring

You're likely a former Developer or Technical Team Lead who made the conscious, passionate choice to step into people management. You know that managing a QA specialist requires a different approach than coaching a developer.

Proven experience mentoring and managing people in diverse technical roles
(e.g. QA, front-end, back-end).
A solid grasp of the .NET ecosystem and various frontend frameworks
(Vue.js, React, etc.) - you won't be coding, but you speak the team's language.
A conceptual understanding of AWS infrastructure and Azure DevOps pipelines
, so you understand your team's blockers.
Openness to AI-driven development tools and modern methodologies
that support and empower your developers' daily work.
Professional proficiency in English
, spoken and written.

Bonus points:

A strong command of Dutch.

You don't need to tick every possible box. If you recognise yourself in the role and believe you can make an impact, we'd like to hear from you.

What we offer

Personal development:
A generous training budget, available directly after your probation period, for specialized certifications, courses, and training to solidify your technical expertise.
Time off and flexibility:
28 vacation days (and the option to buy 5 extra days), plus the possibility of Workation
: up to 5 weeks per year of remote work.
Well-being & focus:
Access to lifestyle coaches, healthy lunches, and other initiatives that contribute to your well-being and focus, including the possibility to lease a bike via Lease-a-Bike.

Financial security:
A salary range of € 6000 to €7000 gross per month
(excluding holiday allowance), depending on your experience. With attractive benefits, including full pension coverage

Optimal workplace:
The best hardware, including a home-office budget
to set up your remote workspace.
Plenty of opportunities:
Enjoy the speed and autonomy of an innovative tech-collective backed by the stability, vast resources, and global career network of the Visma Group.

Team & culture:
Participate in team-building days and other Nmbrs events that strengthen the close team spirit in a diverse and international environment.

What does the application process look like?

Apply:
Apply now! We will contact you as soon as possible.
Get to know us:
Meet us through our Talent Acquisition Team.
Second interview:
Take a deep dive with our Development Manager.
Final interview:
Finalize the process with our CPO and Manager People & Culture.
Offer:
If there's a match - you'll receive an offer!

Because our domain serves multiple departments across the organisation, you'll work with a wide range of stakeholders and contribute to products that make a real impact.

Thanks to your efforts, existing and new information systems are tested for desired functionalities. In this way, you directly contribute to a happy, healthy and sporty Netherlands. As a Test Engineer you score by:

Review specifications and translate them into manual and automated test cases

Working together, winning together

Nederlandse Loterij is the reliable gambling organisation in the Netherlands. It has 8 strong brands. We are the market leader, experts and stand for responsible, fair and safe gambling. Almost all of our revenue goes to a happy, healthy and sporty Netherlands. In addition to being a gambling organisation with a social approach, we are an employer. We work with more than 500 top talents within our organisation.

Because we work together and win together, there's always something to celebrate. No two days are the same. One day you'll be improving automated tests, the next you'll be solving complex challenges together with your teammates. We enjoy working hard, learning from one another and having fun along the way. Our bi-weekly functional day gives us the opportunity to innovate, exchange knowledge and continue growing as a team.

Your talent

Besides your technical expertise, you're a team player who enjoys collaborating with others and contributing to a positive working environment. You communicate openly, take ownership of your work, and aren't afraid to speak up when you believe something can be improved.

You're curious, eager to learn and continuously looking for ways to improve yourself, the team and the quality of the product. You value collaboration, appreciate different perspectives and enjoy working in an international team where everyone's contribution is equally important.
Most importantly, you're someone who likes solving challenges together and making a real impact.

jobs.title: Research Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Tilburg University | Library & IT Services

is looking for a

Research Software Engineer

Department: IT Development, Team Tilburg AI
On site: Tilburg
Contract size: 0,7 – 1.0fte fte (28 - 40 hours per week)
Full-time gross monthly salary: €3.873 - €5.264
Contract duration: 12 - 48 months
Intended start date: November 1st 2026

Would you like to build open-source software that helps researchers make their work more transparent, verifiable, and reusable?

Tilburg University is looking for a Research Software Engineer for ReproHub
, a large-scale open science infrastructure project funded by OpenScienceNL/NWO. In this role, you will work with researchers, research software engineers, library experts, student developers, Tilburg University’s AI development and cloud team (tilburg.ai), and national partners such as ODISSEI.

ReproHub develops infrastructure for researchers working with secondary and sensitive data. The project builds on existing Dutch open science infrastructure, including ODISSEI and Tilburg Science Hub, and aims to strengthen reproducibility, transparency, and public trust in science. 

Your position

As a research software engineer based at Library & Information Services at Tilburg University, you will contribute to the technical development and integration of ReproHub, a large-scale open science infrastructure project recently funded by OpenScienceNL/NWO. Specifically, you will be part of the project’s technical development team and help translate stakeholder needs into reliable, maintainable, and secure software. 

ReproHub (see project proposal for details) consists of four connected deliverables: 
ReproBuddy: an AI tool based on open-source LLMs to improve reproducibility packages using commonly used workflows in the social sciences  
ReproRun: a system to validate research results and provide certificates 
OpenScienceRadar: a browser extension that makes open resources from public databases visible alongside search results (e.g., in Google Search) 
OpenScienceHub.nl: scaling Tilburg Science Hub to become a national platform with accessible educational material on Dutch and European open science infrastructure

Important activities include: 
Developing frontend and backend components for ReproHub’s tools and services; 
designing, building, and maintaining APIs and integrations between the different components; 
Contributing to API-based integration of LLM functionality, including context-retrieval approaches and open-source large language models; 
Helping build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, containerized deployment workflows, and Kubernetes-based deployment; 
Developing and improving user interfaces for researchers, research support staff, and other users; 
Reviewing code, auditing pull requests, and maintaining technical documentation; 
Collaborating with student assistants and supporting them in writing high-quality, maintainable code; 
Translating stakeholder needs into technical choices, prototypes, and production-ready solutions; 
Contributing to software quality, security, privacy, reproducibility, and responsible AI practices. 

Your profile

Ability to work and think at an academic or bachelor level
At least 1 year of relevant experience as a full-stack developer, software engineer, research software engineer, or similar.
Minimum CEFR level C1 English and B2 Dutch.
Comfortable building web applications with Python and modern frontend technologies such as React, Next.js, or comparable frameworks, and has experience with Git-based workflows, code review, and writing clean, maintainable code.
Experience with API-based integration of LLM functionality, ideally including retrieval-augmented generation or related context-retrieval approaches, working with open-source large language models, and connecting AI components to web applications or research tools.
Experience with, or willingness to learn, technical infrastructure such as Docker, CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes, cloud deployment, monitoring, and secure software development practices.
Understanding the importance of software quality, security, privacy, reproducibility, and responsible technology use, especially in research and open science contexts.
Enjoys working in a multidisciplinary team with researchers, developers, library experts, IT colleagues, and student assistants, and can translate user needs into practical technical solutions.
Is accurate, curious, pragmatic, and communicative; takes ownership of technical work while remaining open to feedback from users and colleagues.
Experience with open-source projects, research data workflows, browser extension development, university IT environments, or Dutch language skills is an advantage.

Our offer

Tilburg University offers excellent benefits in a pleasant working environment:
Employment of 0.7 – 1.0 fte (28 - 40 hours per week).
Salary between €3.873 - €5.264 gross per month for full-time employment (UFO-profile Engineering & Application Manager 4, salary scale 9). Tilburg University uses a neutral remuneration system based on relevant work experience.
This is a vacancy whose work is temporarily externally funded by NWO, You will be given a temporary contract for the duration of 12 months, which can be continued for a maximum duration of up to 48 months. 
Vacation pay of 8% and a year-end bonus of 8.3%.
Over 8 weeks of vacation leave.
Hybrid working with home working allowance (€2 p/day) and internet allowance (€25 p/month).
Reimbursement of sustainable commuting: walking, cycling, and public transport.
Options model for additional leave, pension, bicycle or personal training.
Moving allowance (subject to conditions).
30% rule for international employees (if applicable).
Pension through ABP.
Ample training offer: personal development, leadership, education, research or language courses.
Inclusive work culture: everyone welcome, equal opportunities.
A green, inviting campus that’s easily accessible by public transport.

For more information, please see our website and the CLA Dutch Universities.

Want to know more?

Would you like to know more before applying? Feel free to contact Coen van Houwelingen at c.h.vanhouwelingen@tilburguniversity.edu.

Want to apply?

We kindly invite you to apply before October 14th
; this can only be done online
. Address your cover letter to Coen van Houwelingen and attach your resume. We look forward to your response.

The selection committee consists of:
Coen van Houwelingen, Teamlead Software Development & Labsupport 
Hannes Datta, associate professor Tilburg School of Economics and Management (TiSEM)
Shrabastee Banerjee, assistant professor, TiSEM
Jessica Verheijen, community manager/data steward, Research Support, Library

You will ideally start working for Tilburg University on November 1st.

This vacancy has been published internally for 7 days, prior to being published externally. In case of equal suitability, our preference is for an internal candidate.

Due to safety considerations, a Certificate of Good Conduct (VOG) is part of the selection procedure.

About Tilburg University 

Tilburg University is the university in the humanities and social sciences. Ever since our foundation in 1927, we have been committed to a just, inclusive, and sustainable society. With leading research and inspiring education, we contribute to the interpretation and, where possible, solutions to current societal issues, from climate change to digitalization
Our community is personal, engaged, and small-scale. On our green, compact, and vibrant campus there is room for encounter, collaboration, reflection, and personal growth. Read more about Tilburg University.
Working at Tilburg University means working in an inclusive team with attractive employment conditions. At Tilburg University, you will receive ample opportunities to strengthen your talents and develop your career, in a warm working atmosphere where we attach great importance to the following values: curious, connected, caring, and courageous.

About the Library & IT Services Division (LIS)

The Library & IT Services Division (LIS) stands for the realization of state-of-the-art information provision; IT services; and library services for education, research, and business operations of Tilburg University. LIS positions itself as an advisor and service provider. From that position, we offer modern provisions in the field of information and information and communication technology. The Division is also responsible for academic information and library services. The Division has approximately 200 employees and consists of 6 organizational units; IT Services, IT Renewal, Projects & Information Services, CIO office, University Library and the university newspaper Univers. Read more about Library & IT Services | Tilburg University.

About Tilburg.AI

Tilburg.ai is Tilburg University’s innovation and development hub for AI applications within the university. Tilburg.ai also contributes to guidelines for AI usage and the promotion of AI literacy among students and staff.

Tilburg.ai operates according to a core principle: building with and for the Tilburg University community. The team works actively with students, faculty, researchers, and support staff to fully leverage the expertise within the university and align with organizational needs.
The foundation for AI innovation is a secure IT infrastructure. To achieve this, the Tilburg.ai team works alongside experts from Library and IT Services.
One of the main applications developed and managed by Tilburg.ai is Tilburg University’s own chatbot platform, Tilly.

Mit deinem Blick für das Wesentliche moderne Architekturansätze wie Microservices oder API-basierte Systeme sinnvoll einbringen.
Last, but not least beim Aufbau und der Weiterentwicklung unserer DevOps- und CI/CD-Strukturen supporten.

Das bringst du mit – dein Profil

Idealerweise eine Ausbildung oder ein Studium mit IT-Bezug – was zählt: Du brennst für IT und Softwarearchitektur
Ein Muss: Berufspraxis als Softwarearchitekt (m/w/d), Solution Architect (m/w/d) oder Lead Developer (m/w/d)
Sehr gute Kenntnisse in C# und .NET (Core/6/7/8)
Sehr gutes Verständnis moderner Softwarearchitekturen (Microservices, Event-Driven, API-Design, Messaging) sowie fundiertes Know-how in Security-Konzepten
Erfahrung in Cloud-Plattformen (AWS, Azure oder Google Cloud), in Container-Technologien (Docker, Kubernetes) und in Datenplattformen, Datenbanken sowie IoT-Architekturen
Kenntnisse in DevOps, CI/CD und Infrastructure as Code (z. B. Terraform, Bicep, GitOps) sowie Expertise im Monitoring, Logging und Tracing Spaß daran, technische Themen verständlich zu vermitteln und in (komplexen) Architekturen zu denken

Zeit für dich: 30 Tage Urlaub im Jahr

jobs.location: Landau in der Pfalz, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany
jobs.description:
Role Overview

So arbeiten wir – bitte aufmerksam lesen

Diese Stelle passt nicht zu jedem, und das ist Absicht. Damit du einschätzen kannst, ob sie zu dir passt:

Du baust die Schienen, nicht nur die Züge. Während die anderen KI-Rollen an konkreten Use-Cases arbeiten, verantwortest du das Querschnittliche: Infrastruktur, Frameworks, wiederverwendbare Bausteine, Guardrails. Deine Arbeit zahlt sich darin aus, dass andere schneller und sicherer liefern können.
Effizienz ist dein ständiger Maßstab. KI-Consumption – Token, Compute, API-Kosten – wächst schnell und unbemerkt. Du behältst sie im Blick, triffst fundierte Make-or-Buy-Entscheidungen (lokal vs. Cloud, selbst bauen vs. einkaufen) und kannst sie begründen.
Du wirst öfter "nein" sagen als "ja". Nicht jede schöne Idee braucht eigene Infrastruktur, und nicht jedes Modell muss selbst gehostet werden. Du erkennst, wann der pragmatische Weg der bessere ist – und vertrittst das auch gegenüber begeisterten Kolleginnen und Kollegen.
Jedes Teammitglied handelt sehr autonom. Du setzt dir deinen eigenen Maßstab und prüfst deine eigenen Ergebnisse kritisch, bevor jemand anderes es tut. Austausch und Feedback gibt es selbstverständlich – aber die Qualitätssicherung deiner Arbeit beginnt bei dir.
Du bist der Spezialist für dein Gebiet. Unser Team ist bewusst interdisziplinär aufgestellt, mit kaum Überlappungen zwischen den Disziplinen. Du hast Spezialisten für Frontend, Backend, UX und KI-Anwendungen an deiner Seite – aber Plattform, Betrieb und Effizienz sind dein Feld, und du verantwortest es fachlich selbst.
Wir entwickeln AI-gestützt – konsequent. Tools wie Claude Code oder Cursor sind bei uns Alltag, nicht Experiment. Das verschiebt den Schwerpunkt der Arbeit: weniger Code selbst tippen, mehr Architektur vorgeben und Ergebnisse kritisch prüfen. Du musst nicht jede Zeile selbst geschrieben haben – aber du stehst für jede Zeile gerade, die du ablieferst.
Wöchentliche Freiräume sind fest eingeplant – rund 10 % deiner Arbeitszeit. Zeit für fachliche Weiterentwicklung, eigene Ideen und kreativen Austausch ist bei uns Teil der Arbeitswoche – kein Nice-to-have, das im Tagesgeschäft verdampft.
Ergebnisgetrieben und prozessual schlank. Wir brauchen schnelle, pragmatische Lösungen, die im Alltag funktionieren – keine über Monate ausgefeilten 100%-Systeme. Die Plattform wächst mit den realen Bedürfnissen, nicht mit theoretischen.

Wenn du am produktivsten bist, wenn dir jemand eine fertige Architektur und ein abgestecktes Backlog vorlegt, wirst du bei uns nicht glücklich. Wenn dich reizt, ein Fundament aus dem Nichts zu bauen, auf dem andere aufbauen – dann lies weiter.

Unser Stack

Wir implementieren produktnah überwiegend in C# / .NET. Python nutzen wir, wo es sinnvoll ist – für Prototypen, KI-spezifische Werkzeuge, Datenarbeit und Tooling. Der Schwerpunkt liegt aber klar auf C#. Unsere Frontends bauen wir in React – für diese Rolle kein Muss, aber nützlich. Für KI-Betrieb und -Infrastruktur erwarten wir Vertrautheit mit gängigen Inferenz- und Orchestrierungs-Frameworks sowie mit Containerisierung.

Your Tasks

Die technische Plattform für unsere KI-Anwendungen konzipieren, aufbauen und betreiben: Modell-Hosting, Inferenz, API-Gateways/Routing, wiederverwendbare Bausteine
Lokale / self-hosted LLMs evaluieren, einrichten und betreiben – inklusive Quantisierung, GPU-Dimensionierung und Performance
KI-Consumption und -Kosten transparent machen und aktiv steuern; fundierte Make-or-Buy- und Lokal-vs.-Cloud-Entscheidungen treffen und begründen
Frameworks, Tools und Standards für das Team auswählen und etablieren – Guardrails, die KI-Entwicklung schneller und sicherer machen
Erfolgreiche Prototypen der anderen KI-Rollen in einen tragfähigen, betreibbaren Zustand bringen – bis hin zur Übergabe an R&D oder in den produktiven Betrieb
CI/CD, Monitoring und Betriebsthemen für KI-Lösungen verantworten
Ergebnisse und Empfehlungen gegenüber Fach- und Business-Teams präsentieren – auf dem jeweiligen technischen Niveau deines Gegenübers

Your Profile

Tiefes Veständnis und praktische Erfahrung im Betrieb von KI-/LLM-Anwendungen in einem Unternehmen: Inferenz-Frameworks (z. B. vLLM, Ollama, llama.cpp, TGI), API-Gateways/Routing (z. B. LiteLLM), RAG- und Embedding-Infrastruktur
Operative, im Unternehmenskontext angewandte Erfahrung mit lokalen Modellen / Self-Hosting von LLMs – inklusive Quantisierung und Ressourcendimensionierung
Mehrjährige, fundierte praktische Erfahrung innerhalb eines Unternehmens in der Entwicklung von Softwarelösungen, davon ein solider Teil in C# / .NET – mit erkennbarer technischer Tiefe
Erfahrung mit Containerisierung (Docker), CI/CD und Betriebsthemen
Ein waches Auge für Kosten und Effizienz – du kannst KI-Consumption messen, einordnen und optimieren
Gute Übersicht über aktuelle Trends, verfügbare Off-the-shelf-Lösungen und neue Entwicklungen im KI-Umfeld – du weißt, wann man baut und wann man kauft
Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (Teamsprache ist Deutsch) und gute Englischkenntnisse
Überwiegende Arbeit im Homeoffice, Bereitschaft zu regelmäßigen Reisen in unser HQ in Landau (ca. 5–10 % der Arbeitszeit)

Must have

Praktische Erfahrung innerhalb eines Unternehmens im Betrieb von KI-/LLM-Anwendungen: Inferenz-Frameworks (z. B. vLLM, Ollama, llama.cpp, TGI), API-Gateways/Routing (z. B. LiteLLM), RAG- und Embedding-Infrastruktur
Erfahrung mit Containerisierung (Docker), CI/CD und Betriebsthemen
Du kannst "nein" sagen, ohne Türen zu schließen und ein Scheitern eingestehen, auch wenn du schon Aufwand investiert hast

Nice to have

Erfahrung in der fachlichen Führung oder Anleitung von Entwicklern
Gute Python-Kenntnisse für Tooling und Prototyping
Erfahrung mit Datenaufbereitung und -pipelines (ETL/ELT)
React / moderne Web-Frontends
Erfahrung mit GPU-Infrastruktur und Kostenoptimierung im Cloud-Umfeld

That sounds like you?

Du denkst in Systemen und Fundamenten, nicht nur in einzelnen Lösungen – und baust so, dass andere darauf aufbauen können.
Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Verhältnismäßigkeit – du baust die Infrastruktur, die das Problem braucht, nicht die größtmögliche. Und du erkennst, wann der pragmatische Weg der richtige ist.
Du kannst "nein" sagen, ohne Türen zu schließen – und ein Scheitern eingestehen, auch wenn du schon Aufwand investiert hast.
Du prüfst deine eigenen Ergebnisse kritisch, bevor jemand anderes es tut.
Ein offenes Auge für Defizite und Potenziale, technisch wie organisatorisch

Reasons to become part of AMDT

Transformative Möglichkeiten und integrative Kultur: Werde Teil eines dynamischen, sich weiterentwickelnden Unternehmens, in dem Wachstum gefördert wird, deine Beiträge geschätzt werden und du in einer vielfältigen, unterstützenden Gemeinschaft zusammenarbeiten und dich entfalten kannst.
Flexible Arbeitsmöglichkeiten: Arbeite so, wie es für dich am besten ist – remote, hybrid oder in unserem hochmodernen Büro.
Zukunftssicherheit: Wir investieren in deine Zukunft und leisten einen Beitrag von 20 % zu einem umfassenden betrieblichen Alterversversongung.
Zusätzliche Krankenversicherung: Genieße zusätzliche Sicherheit mit einer Krankenzusatzversicherung, die dein Wohlbefinden über das Grundlegende hinaus unterstützt.
Unternehmensvorteile: Profitiere von exklusiven Rabatten auf ausgewählte Marken, um deinen Alltag zu bereichern.

Meilensteine feiern: Freue dich über Geschenke zu wichtigen Lebensereignissen wie Heirat, Geburt eines Kindes oder deinem Jubiläum bei uns.

AMDT is the global market and technology leader for versioning and backup solutions in industrial automation. With its octoplant software platform, the company secures the automation of production processes through strong end-point management, where it consistently records and monitors changes to configurations, programming and project statuses in production. Operating as a trusted partner, you will spend 2 to 3 days per week embedded on-site with our enterprise clients. In this role, you will not just propose architectures; you will actively build, prototype, and physically incubate them.
By combining practical, hands-on engineering with out-of-the-box thinking, you will play a critical role in identifying the right modern toolsets and fast-tracking the AI Cloud adoption journey for our customers.

• On-Site Migration & Platform Planning: Spend 2–3 days per week on-site with clients mapping legacy workloads, architecting secure enterprise landing zones, and designing comprehensive migration strategies.
• Hands-on Prototyping & Automation: Actively build, configure, and automate infrastructure components using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to incubate projects, moving them from architectural diagrams to live, provisioned environments.

Joining Endava, you'll work exclusively with WTW to help embed AI-enabled engineering practices, modern ways of working and deep insurance technology expertise, contributing to the next generation of products and services for insurers worldwide. Working as part of a dedicated team established through a Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT) model, you'll collaborate closely with WTW while building your career as an Endava employee, supporting the long-term success of this strategic partnership.

About the Role

As a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer, you will join an experienced cross-functional engineering team responsible for designing, developing and evolving the Authentication and Authorization capability used across multiple products and engineering teams.

This is not a traditional application development role. Instead, you will help build a reusable identity platform that enables other engineering teams to adopt standardised authentication and authorisation services while improving security, developer experience and operational efficiency.

The capability provides shared identity and access management services that help applications authenticate users securely, authorise access to business resources and integrate with enterprise identity providers.

Built on Auth0, Fine-Grained Authorization (FGA) and modern Azure services, it includes reusable SDKs, reverse proxy services and developer tooling that make secure integration simpler across ICT’s technology landscape.

You will work closely with architects, product teams, platform engineers and business stakeholders helping deliver secure, scalable and high-quality technology solutions that create value for WTW and its customers. You will be expected to work with a high degree of autonomy, take ownership of significant work packages and make sound technical decisions within the agreed platform direction.

What Success Looks Like

In this role you will:

Help deliver secure, reusable authentication and authorization services used by multiple product teams.
Build high-quality .NET APIs, Angular administration tools and integration services that are maintainable and easy to operate.
Improve the reliability, scalability and security of shared identity services through well-tested engineering changes.
Support platform adoption by improving SDKs, documentation, developer tooling and integration patterns.
Contribute to automation, CI/CD and cloud platform improvements that make delivery faster and more predictable.
Collaborate with architects, product owners, QA, DevOps and consuming product teams to solve identity and access management challenges.
Actively learn, share knowledge and contribute to a positive engineering culture within the Quartz team.

Key Responsibilities

Identity Platform Development

Design, develop and maintain authentication and authorization services using modern .NET technologies.
Develop reusable platform services supporting secure authentication and authorization across multiple business applications.
Build scalable REST APIs and integration services used throughout the organisation.
Develop and maintain Angular-based administration portals supporting user, group and permission management.
Contribute to the evolution of Fine-Grained Authorization (FGA) capabilities and centralized access management services.

Platform Services & Developer Experience

Develop reusable SDKs, libraries and APIs that simplify integration with the enterprise identity platform.
Build developer tooling that improves onboarding and adoption of shared authentication services.
Improve developer experience by simplifying authentication, authorization and platform integration.
Produce and maintain technical documentation supporting engineering teams consuming the platform.
Help minimise breaking changes by designing stable, reusable platform interfaces.
Take ownership of technical designs and implementation approaches for assigned capabilities, identifying dependencies, risks and trade-offs and following work through to a production-ready outcome.
Lead focused technical work packages and provide practical guidance to other engineers contributing to the same capability.

Cloud & Platform Engineering

Develop cloud-native services running on Microsoft Azure.
Build and maintain reverse proxy capabilities using Azure API Management.
Support Infrastructure as Code implementation using OpenTofu/Terraform.
Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation using Azure DevOps.
Support continuous improvements in platform scalability, security and operational resilience.

Engineering Excellence

Write unit, integration and automated tests ensuring platform quality and reliability.
Participate in peer reviews, architecture discussions and technical design sessions.
Promote engineering best practices including Clean Code, automated testing and secure software development.
Collaborate with Product Owners, Architects, QA Engineers and Platform Engineers to deliver high-quality platform capabilities.
Support less experienced engineers through constructive reviews, knowledge sharing and technical mentoring.

Operations & Collaboration

Participate in third-line production support and on-call rotation.
Investigate production issues and contribute to platform reliability improvements.
Work closely with multiple product teams integrating with the platform.
Share knowledge and contribute to establishing long-term Endava ownership of the Authentication & Authorization capability.

Qualifications

Software Engineering

6+ years of commercial software development experience using C# and modern .NET.
Strong experience designing and developing REST APIs.
Experience building scalable enterprise applications or shared platform services.
Strong knowledge of object-oriented programming and modern software design principles.

Identity & Security

Strong understanding of OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC) and JWT.
Good understanding of modern authentication and authorization concepts.
Experience integrating applications with enterprise identity providers.
Understanding of secure API design and identity-based access control.

Cloud & Platform Engineering

Experience developing cloud-native applications on Microsoft Azure.
Experience with Azure DevOps, Git and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience using Infrastructure as Code with Terraform or OpenTofu.
Understanding of Azure API Management or similar API Gateway technologies.

Front-End Development

Experience developing Angular applications using TypeScript.
Experience building administrative or developer-facing web applications.

Engineering Practices

Experience writing automated tests (unit, integration and API testing).
Experience working in Agile Scrum teams.
Strong communication and collaboration skills.
Ability to work effectively across multiple product teams.
Ability to influence technical outcomes across team boundaries, communicate delivery risks and contribute to decisions affecting shared platform consumers.

Auth0

Google Zanzibar authorization model
Azure API Management (APIM)
SCIM integrations
Identity Federation Datadog
Playwright

Experience working with enterprise shared services

jobs.description:
Description & Requirements

Who we are looking for

📌 This is a future-oriented recruitment process. While we may not have an immediate opening, we're building a network of talented engineers interested in future opportunities with Deloitte. We expect demand to grow in the coming months, so we'd love to get to know great candidates in advance.

We are looking for an experienced AI-native Full-Stack or Backend Engineer
who combines strong software engineering fundamentals with advanced practical experience in AI-assisted and agentic development.

You will work with clients, architects, product teams, and business stakeholders to turn complex and often ambiguous problems into production-ready solutions. AI-native engineering is a core capability of this role
, with AI integrated across the SDLC while maintaining high standards of quality, security, and maintainability.

The role is technology-agnostic. You should be comfortable working across different technology stacks, rapidly understanding unfamiliar systems, and selecting the right approach for the problem.

Core Qualities:

AI-native engineering

You use AI and coding agents as an integral part of software engineering and understand the advanced practices required to make agentic development effective, reliable, and scalable across the SDLC.

Technology-agnostic problem solving

You have strong engineering fundamentals and can quickly become productive across unfamiliar languages, frameworks, platforms, and architectures.

End-to-end ownership

You take responsibility for outcomes across the complete lifecycle — from understanding the business problem and designing the solution to implementation, deployment, and production operation.

Systems thinking

You reason about complete systems, including applications, APIs, data, integrations, infrastructure, security, observability, and operational constraints.

Customer-focused collaboration

You work effectively with clients and multidisciplinary teams, translating ambiguous business needs into practical technical solutions and communicating decisions and trade-offs clearly.

Curiosity and adaptability

You enjoy solving unfamiliar problems, learning new technologies, and continuously improving how software is designed and delivered.

Required experience and engineering capabilities:

Advanced and proven experience designing, leading, and controlling agentic software development as a primary way of delivering complex software.
You should be able to demonstrate how you structure the work of AI coding agents across the SDLC — providing them with the right specifications, context, tools, environments, orchestration, guardrails, and feedback mechanisms — to reliably deliver production-quality software while retaining engineering oversight and accountability.
Approximately 5+ years of professional software engineering experience
, preferably including consulting, client-facing engineering, solution engineering, or similar roles.
Strong backend or full-stack engineering experience
in one or more ecosystems such as Java, C#, Python, Node.js/TypeScript, Go, or similar, combined with the ability to work effectively outside a primary technology stack.
Experience designing and delivering APIs, integrations, distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and data-intensive applications
.
Strong knowledge of relational and non-relational databases
and experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
Strong understanding of software architecture, security, scalability, reliability, performance, and maintainability
.
Hands-on experience with Git, automated testing, CI/CD, containers, observability, and modern software delivery practices
.
Ability to independently investigate unfamiliar systems
, operate effectively with incomplete or evolving requirements, and rapidly become productive in new technical environments.
Strong problem-solving, client communication, and stakeholder-management skills
, including the ability to explain technical decisions and trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences.

Additional experience that will help you succeed:

Frontend experience with React, Angular, Vue, or similar frameworks.
Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, serverless architectures, microservices, and infrastructure as code.
Knowledge of enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, Microsoft platforms, Creatio, or comparable systems.
Experience delivering AI agents, copilots, workflow automation, or intelligent enterprise applications.
Familiarity with API management, enterprise integration platforms, event streaming, and advanced observability practices.

Your future role

Own solution delivery end-to-end:
work directly with clients to understand business problems, design solutions, and deliver production-grade applications, services, APIs, integrations, and data solutions.
Apply AI-native engineering across the SDLC:
use advanced agentic development practices to accelerate discovery, design, implementation, testing, review, debugging, documentation, and production support while maintaining engineering quality and security.

Selection process

What you only must do is to take the first step – press the apply button and send us your CV, go through all the stages of the recruitment process:

CV check and then HR screening

Technical interview
with our Architects
Meeting with Business
(optional, depends on case)

Then, last thing to do will be to sign a contract with us. Deloitte is simply your best choice.
🟢

Deep hands-on expertise with Semantic Model and LLMs
Understanding of Microsoft Azure AI services, particularly Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Agent Service, Microsoft Copilot Studio
Strong experience in opportunity identification for transformation, automation, and AI within enterprise environments.
Proficiency in data modeling, data integration, and ETL processes.
Strong programming skills in languages such as Python, SQL.
Understanding of data governance and data privacy principles.

Knowledge of Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocols is highly desirable.

Responsibilities as of day 1. You will have project ownership and autonomy to deliver change and results from the beginning
Dynamic and encouraging work environment. At P&G our employees are at the core, we value every individual and encourage initiatives, promoting agility and work/life balance

jobs.title: Senior Java Developer (Microservices)
jobs.description:
Project Description:

You will join a long-term, enterprise-scale project for a global client in the investment banking domain. The project focuses on building and evolving a set of mission-critical backend services that support complex business workflows, regulatory processes, and system integrations across the bank’s ecosystem.

The platform is based on a distributed microservices architecture, leveraging Spring Boot, event-driven communication, and BPM-driven process orchestration. The system operates in a cloud-enabled, containerized environment, with a strong emphasis on security, scalability, resiliency, and maintainability.

You will work closely with architects, QA engineers, DevOps, and business stakeholders in an agile setup, contributing not only code but also technical direction, best practices, and mentoring.

Responsibilities:

• Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade backend services using Java 11+ and Spring Boot
• Contribute to the design and evolution of distributed microservices architectures
• Implement and integrate REST and SOAP APIs and event-driven solutions using Kafka
• Develop and maintain business process workflows using a BPM engine (preferably Flowable)
• Ensure high standards of code quality by applying SOLID principles, Clean Code, and design patterns
• Write and maintain comprehensive unit and integration tests using JUnit, TestNG, Mockito, and WireMock
• Work with relational and document databases such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Azure Cosmos DB
• Implement security and authentication mechanisms using OAuth2, JWT, and Spring Security
• Collaborate with DevOps teams on containerization and deployment using Docker and Kubernetes
• Participate actively in agile ceremonies (refinement, planning, reviews, retrospectives)
• Provide technical guidance, perform code reviews, and advocate for engineering best practices
• Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including QA, DevOps, and product owners

Mandatory Skills Description:

- Solid experience in JVM programming languages (ideally Java11+) and design patterns
- Frameworks: Spring Boot
- Proven track record of enterprise level application development for 7+ years
- Understanding of distributed microservices architectures and communication patterns
- Experience with relational and document databases (PostgresSQL, MongoDB, Azure Cosmos)
- Testing Frameworks (JUnit, TestNG, Mockito, WireMock)
- Messaging & Integration (Kafka, REST, SOAP)
- Security & Authentication (OAuth2, JWT, Spring Security)
- Containerization & Orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
- Advocating engineering best practices (SOLID, Clean Code)
- Experience with Agile mode of working
- Excellent communication and collaboration skills
- Familiarity with Cloud based technologies

Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

- experience in or willing to learn Java reactive programming/ Spring Webflux
- springboot Microservices
- experience with NoSQL databases (ideally MongoDB or CosmosDB)
- familiarity with BPMN (eg Flowable)

English: B2 Upper Intermediate

jobs.description:
Description & Requirements

Who we are looking for

📌 This is a future-oriented recruitment process. While we may not have an immediate opening, we're building a network of talented engineers interested in future opportunities with Deloitte. We expect demand to grow in the coming months, so we'd love to get to know great candidates in advance.

We are looking for an experienced AI-native Full-Stack or Backend Engineer
who combines strong software engineering fundamentals with advanced practical experience in AI-assisted and agentic development.

You will work with clients, architects, product teams, and business stakeholders to turn complex and often ambiguous problems into production-ready solutions. AI-native engineering is a core capability of this role
, with AI integrated across the SDLC while maintaining high standards of quality, security, and maintainability.

The role is technology-agnostic. You should be comfortable working across different technology stacks, rapidly understanding unfamiliar systems, and selecting the right approach for the problem.

Core Qualities:

AI-native engineering

You use AI and coding agents as an integral part of software engineering and understand the advanced practices required to make agentic development effective, reliable, and scalable across the SDLC.

Technology-agnostic problem solving

You have strong engineering fundamentals and can quickly become productive across unfamiliar languages, frameworks, platforms, and architectures.

End-to-end ownership

You take responsibility for outcomes across the complete lifecycle — from understanding the business problem and designing the solution to implementation, deployment, and production operation.

Systems thinking

You reason about complete systems, including applications, APIs, data, integrations, infrastructure, security, observability, and operational constraints.

Customer-focused collaboration

You work effectively with clients and multidisciplinary teams, translating ambiguous business needs into practical technical solutions and communicating decisions and trade-offs clearly.

Curiosity and adaptability

You enjoy solving unfamiliar problems, learning new technologies, and continuously improving how software is designed and delivered.

Required experience and engineering capabilities:

Advanced and proven experience designing, leading, and controlling agentic software development as a primary way of delivering complex software.
You should be able to demonstrate how you structure the work of AI coding agents across the SDLC — providing them with the right specifications, context, tools, environments, orchestration, guardrails, and feedback mechanisms — to reliably deliver production-quality software while retaining engineering oversight and accountability.
Approximately 5+ years of professional software engineering experience
, preferably including consulting, client-facing engineering, solution engineering, or similar roles.
Strong backend or full-stack engineering experience
in one or more ecosystems such as Java, C#, Python, Node.js/TypeScript, Go, or similar, combined with the ability to work effectively outside a primary technology stack.
Experience designing and delivering APIs, integrations, distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and data-intensive applications
.
Strong knowledge of relational and non-relational databases
and experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
Strong understanding of software architecture, security, scalability, reliability, performance, and maintainability
.
Hands-on experience with Git, automated testing, CI/CD, containers, observability, and modern software delivery practices
.
Ability to independently investigate unfamiliar systems
, operate effectively with incomplete or evolving requirements, and rapidly become productive in new technical environments.
Strong problem-solving, client communication, and stakeholder-management skills
, including the ability to explain technical decisions and trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences.

Additional experience that will help you succeed:

Frontend experience with React, Angular, Vue, or similar frameworks.
Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, serverless architectures, microservices, and infrastructure as code.
Knowledge of enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, Microsoft platforms, Creatio, or comparable systems.
Experience delivering AI agents, copilots, workflow automation, or intelligent enterprise applications.
Familiarity with API management, enterprise integration platforms, event streaming, and advanced observability practices.

Your future role

Own solution delivery end-to-end:
work directly with clients to understand business problems, design solutions, and deliver production-grade applications, services, APIs, integrations, and data solutions.
Apply AI-native engineering across the SDLC:
use advanced agentic development practices to accelerate discovery, design, implementation, testing, review, debugging, documentation, and production support while maintaining engineering quality and security.

Selection process

What you only must do is to take the first step – press the apply button and send us your CV, go through all the stages of the recruitment process:

CV check and then HR screening

Technical interview
with our Architects
Meeting with Business
(optional, depends on case)

Then, last thing to do will be to sign a contract with us. Deloitte is simply your best choice.

who combines strong software engineering fundamentals with advanced practical experience in AI-assisted and agentic development.

, with AI integrated across the SDLC while maintaining high standards of quality, security, and maintainability.

AI-native engineering

Technology-agnostic problem solving

Advanced and proven experience designing, leading, and controlling agentic software development as a primary way of delivering complex software.

Approximately 5+ years of professional software engineering experience
, preferably including consulting, client-facing engineering, solution engineering, or similar roles.
Strong backend or full-stack engineering experience
in one or more ecosystems such as Java, C#, Python, Node.js/TypeScript, Go, or similar, combined with the ability to work effectively outside a primary technology stack.
Experience designing and delivering APIs, integrations, distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and data-intensive applications
.
Strong knowledge of relational and non-relational databases
and experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
Strong understanding of software architecture, security, scalability, reliability, performance, and maintainability
.
Hands-on experience with Git, automated testing, CI/CD, containers, observability, and modern software delivery practices
.
Ability to independently investigate unfamiliar systems
, operate effectively with incomplete or evolving requirements, and rapidly become productive in new technical environments.
Strong problem-solving, client communication, and stakeholder-management skills
, including the ability to explain technical decisions and trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences.

Additional experience that will help you succeed:

Frontend experience with React, Angular, Vue, or similar frameworks.
Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, serverless architectures, microservices, and infrastructure as code.
Knowledge of enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, Microsoft platforms, Creatio, or comparable systems.
Experience delivering AI agents, copilots, workflow automation, or intelligent enterprise applications.

work directly with clients to understand business problems, design solutions, and deliver production-grade applications, services, APIs, integrations, and data solutions.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer - Fintech Platform (m/f/n)
jobs.description:
Company Description

InPost Group is an innovative European out of home deliveries company, revolutionizing the way parcels are delivered to customers. With operations across several countries, our network of intelligent lockers provides customers with a fast, convenient, and secure delivery option. InPost Group is a publicly traded company, with a market capitalization of about $5 billion as of March 2023. With over 10,000 people worldwide, InPost Group is one of the largest out of home delivery providers in Europe, committed to providing sustainable and efficient delivery solutions to meet the evolving needs of customers in today's rapidly changing landscape.

We are a team that builds the best FMCG e-commerce in Poland.
We already have over 300,000 products
in our offer, we work with over 300 sellers
, and our mobile application has already been downloaded by almost 1.5 million users in Poland
. Due to the fact that our product consists of many elements that must work together efficiently and be managed effectively, we are looking for experienced consumer-focused (Web / Mobile App products) engineering leaders to join us in that journey
- heavily influence our future platform build, improve processes and help us deliver best customer experience in the market across all types of devices.

Job Description

InPost is building the FinTech platform that powers payments for one of Europe's largest logistics and e-commerce ecosystems. We're looking for a Principal Software Engineer to become our organisation-wide technical authority - someone who can arbitrate architecture decisions across Payments Core, Merchant, and Consumer domains, and who has genuinely shipped AI-assisted engineering workflows in production, not just talked about them.

As Principal Software Engineer, you'll work directly with the Head of FinTech Engineering and business leadership, translating critical business goals - new product lines, regulatory deadlines, growth targets - into architecture decisions and roadmap input. You'll be the final word on cross-domain technical questions that no single team or Staff Engineer can resolve alone.

→ Hybrid working model:
preferably 1 day per week in the Warsaw or Cracow office
.

Responsibilities:

Serve as the single cross-domain technical authority, arbitrating architecture decisions across Payments Core, Merchant, and Consumer platform areas
Partner directly with the Head of Engineering and business leadership to turn business strategy into technical roadmap input
Author Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and RFCs for organisation-wide decisions, with reasoning accessible to both engineers and business stakeholders
Own the agentic engineering harness at an organisational level — design, instrument, and continuously improve AI-assisted engineering workflows based on real production data
Identify and drive the adoption or deprecation of patterns across all teams, building the case and sequencing change without direct authority
Mentor Staff Engineers and Engineering Managers on architecture craft, technical communication, and agentic tooling

Qualifications

10+ years in software engineering, including 5+ years in cross-team technical leadership or architecture authority
5+ years designing distributed payments or fintech systems
3+ years of agentic/LLM engineering in production — shipped systems, not theoretical patterns
Deep knowledge of distributed systems architecture: event sourcing, CQRS, domain events, saga pattern
Experience designing APIs at an organisational boundary level — REST, async, and event-based contracts
Strong grasp of database trade-offs (relational, time-series, document, ledger-style) and cloud architecture evaluation (AWS/GCP/Azure) at organisation scale
Hands-on experience with multi-agent orchestration, tool-use patterns, context management, and evaluation harnesses for AI-assisted engineering workflows
Excellent technical writing for mixed audiences — ADRs and RFCs that work for engineers and business leadership alike
English proficiency at B2 or above
University degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field

Nice to have:

3+ years in platform or internal developer tooling engineering
1+ years of agentic/LLM system design experience
PCI DSS / PSD2 architecture compliance experience from the design phase
BNPL or lending domain architecture experience
Open-source contributions or external technical publishing
Experience building or scaling an internal developer platform
Formal mentorship of Staff-level or EM-track engineers
Polish language skills

Additional Information

Opportunity to work in a diverse, international, and cross-functional environment, along with leading experts.
You work and learn from a senior leader and their leadership team, expanding your experience and exposure in the e-commerce and logistics industries.
 InPost is a growing company that offers its people an increasing number of opportunities in several locations in Europe.
Fulfilling careers with a range of benefits for people and investing in providing training opportunities for their development.
You will feel a part of the InPost community that makes an impact on sustainability, convenient deliveries, and the circular economy every day.
Excellent working environment and flexible hours
We offer B2B type of contract

📍 hybrid work - 3 days/week from the office Fabryczna Office Park, Krakow

Project Description:

You will join a long-term, enterprise-scale project for a global client in the investment banking domain. The project focuses on building and evolving a set of mission-critical backend services that support complex business workflows, regulatory processes, and system integrations across the bank’s ecosystem.

The platform is based on a distributed microservices architecture, leveraging Spring Boot, event-driven communication, and BPM-driven process orchestration. The system operates in a cloud-enabled, containerized environment, with a strong emphasis on security, scalability, resiliency, and maintainability.

You will work closely with architects, QA engineers, DevOps, and business stakeholders in an agile setup, contributing not only code but also technical direction, best practices, and mentoring.

Responsibilities:

• Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade backend services using Java 11+ and Spring Boot
• Contribute to the design and evolution of distributed microservices architectures
• Implement and integrate REST and SOAP APIs and event-driven solutions using Kafka
• Develop and maintain business process workflows using a BPM engine (preferably Flowable)
• Ensure high standards of code quality by applying SOLID principles, Clean Code, and design patterns
• Write and maintain comprehensive unit and integration tests using JUnit, TestNG, Mockito, and WireMock
• Work with relational and document databases such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Azure Cosmos DB
• Implement security and authentication mechanisms using OAuth2, JWT, and Spring Security
• Collaborate with DevOps teams on containerization and deployment using Docker and Kubernetes

- Solid experience in JVM programming languages (ideally Java11+) and design patterns
- Frameworks: Spring Boot

- Understanding of distributed microservices architectures and communication patterns
- Experience with relational and document databases (PostgresSQL, MongoDB, Azure Cosmos)
- Testing Frameworks (JUnit, TestNG, Mockito, WireMock)
- Messaging & Integration (Kafka, REST, SOAP)
- Security & Authentication (OAuth2, JWT, Spring Security)

- Experience with Agile mode of working

jobs.description:
Vill du arbeta med modern .NET-utveckling i ett område där teknik, innovation och finans möts? Vi söker en .NET-utvecklare till vårt Open Banking-team, där du får vara med och utveckla nästa generations lösningar för säker och smidig delning av finansiell information.

Att jobba som .NET-utvecklare

Som .NET-utvecklare blir du en del av vårt Open Banking-team, där du utvecklar moderna lösningar som möjliggör säker och smidig integration mellan banker, fintechbolag och andra externa aktörer.

Open Banking ingår i affärsområde Kund och Vardagsbank – en portfölj där det händer mycket och där teknisk utveckling och nya möjligheter står i fokus. I takt med att regelverk och möjligheterna att dela finansiell information utvecklas får du vara med och bygga nästa generations lösningar och bidra till bättre kundupplevelser.

Tyngdpunkten i rollen ligger på backendutveckling, men du kommer även att arbeta med frontend. Rollen passar dig som vill arbeta med både nyutveckling och vidareutveckling i ett område som är i ständig förändring.

utveckla och vidareutveckla backendtjänster i .NET
bygga och förvalta API och integrationer mot externa aktörer
arbeta med nyutveckling av lösningar inom Open Banking
bidra till tekniska vägval, arkitektur och kvalitet i teamets lösningar
samarbeta nära utvecklare och andra kompetenser i teamet
vid behov även bidra inom frontendutveckling

För att lyckas i rollen

Vi söker dig som har flera års erfarenhet av systemutveckling och som är trygg inom C# och .NET. Du har ett starkt intresse för backendutveckling och tycker om att bygga stabila, säkra och långsiktigt hållbara lösningar.

Vi Ser Att Du Har

flera års erfarenhet av utveckling i C# och .NET
god erfarenhet av backendutveckling
erfarenhet av API och integrationer
erfarenhet av att arbeta med moderna utvecklingsmetoder och verktyg
god förståelse för kvalitet, säkerhet och testbar kod
goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska

Som person är du nyfiken och lösningsorienterad och tycker om att sätta dig in i både tekniska problem och verksamhetens behov. Du tar ansvar för ditt arbete och bidrar gärna med idéer och perspektiv kring hur lösningar och arbetssätt kan förbättras.

Eftersom du blir en del av ett team där ni tillsammans ansvarar för både utveckling och kvalitet ser vi också att du trivs med att samarbeta, dela kunskap och hitta lösningar tillsammans med andra.
