jobs.title: Erfaren C#-utvecklare till Captech
jobs.description:
Vill du arbeta nära användarna och ha stort utrymme att fatta tekniska beslut? Hos Captech ingår du i ett litet men erfaret utvecklingsteam som tillsammans formar lösningar och arbetssätt. Du bygger och vidareutvecklar affärskritiska system som används varje dag av hundratals personer inom företaget och av våra kunder.

Captech är en av Nordens största elektronikdistributörer. Vi grundades år 1996 i Göteborg, då som en butik med expertis inom datorer och PC-produktion. Sedan dess har vi haft en rejäl tillväxtresa, idag har vi kontor i Norge, Danmark och Finland, med huvudkontor och lager numera beläget i Mölndal.  

Vi tillhandahåller produkter inom IT, professionell Audio och Video, säkerhet och övervakning, samt konfigurationstjänster och PC-produktion. Våra kunder är enbart återförsäljare, både stora och små, främst i Norden men även i Europa.  

Captech har många grunder till sin framgång, en av dem är våra interna system och verktyg som får alla processer att lira. Vi bestämde oss tidigt för att vi har bäst förutsättningar att göra ett bra arbete när våra verktyg är anpassade efter våra egna behov, därför har vi utvecklat majoriteten av våra system helt själva, in-house.  

Det innebär att våra utvecklare arbetar nära användarna, förstår affärsbehoven och har möjlighet att påverka lösningar.

Om rollen

Behoven i verksamheten växer och vi vill driva fler initiativ. Därför utökar vi utvecklingsavdelningen, som i dag består av fyra utvecklare och en chef. Du arbetar med både nya och befintliga system som är centrala för verksamheten. Eftersom användarna finns nära får du snabb återkoppling på det du bygger.

Här finns ingen särskild hierarki där någon annan redan har bestämt hur lösningarna ska se ut. Vi diskuterar lösningar i teamet och litar på varandras omdömen. Du behöver kunna fatta egna beslut och prova nya vägar. Det är också självklart att vi hjälps åt när det behövs.

Några exempel på system vi ansvarar för:
-    Applikationer för sälj och inköp
-    Webshop
-    Kundintegrationer (API och EDI)
-    Integrationer mot lagersystem och speditörer

Vem vi söker

Vi söker dig som är trygg i din kompetens och tar ansvar för att arbetet går framåt. Du vågar fatta beslut och testa nya sätt, även när allt inte är givet från början. Du jobbar strukturerat, säger till när planen inte håller och samarbetar bra med både teamet och andra delar av organisationen.

Du är van att arbeta enligt etablerade metoder för planering och uppföljning. Att testa och kvalitetssäkra det du bygger är en naturlig del av ditt arbete.

Vi söker dig som har:
-    Ingenjörsexamen inom datateknik eller motsvarande utbildning
-    Minst fem års professionell erfarenhet av utveckling i C# och .NET
-    Gedigen erfarenhet av kvalitet och testning av egenutvecklad mjukvara
-    Erfarenhet av SQL
-    Erfarenhet av och förståelse för CI/CD
-    Erfarenhet av agila arbetsmetoder

Meriterande erfarenheter:
-    ASP.NET och/eller WPF/XAML
-    DevOps och monitorering
-    Fullstackutveckling
-    AI-assisterad utveckling och AI-verktyg
-    Entity Framework
Har du inte arbetat med desktopapplikationer tidigare kan du lära dig det hos oss.

Teknisk miljö
Vi arbetar främst i Microsoft-miljö. Merparten av våra backendtjänster körs on-prem.
Vår tekniska miljö:
-    Moderna versioner av .NET (8–10)
-    Git
-    Azure DevOps
-    MS SQL
-    ASP.NET
-    WPF/XAML

Att jobba på Captech

På Captech är vi måna om att våra medarbetare trivs och utvecklas. Som utvecklare hos oss blir du en del av ett team med nära samarbete, korta beslutsvägar och stor möjlighet att påverka. Vi värdesätter nyfikenhet och lärande. Du uppmuntras även att utforska nya tekniker och arbetssätt, dela kunskap med teamet och vara med och påverka hur vi utvecklar våra system framåt.

Vi arbetar från vårt kontor i Mölndal tre dagar i veckan, och två dagar i veckan finns möjlighet att arbeta hemifrån. Kontoret har goda förbindelser med kollektivtrafik, såväl som gott om parkeringsplatser inkl. laddplatser för dig som åker bil.

Villkor och förmåner

Du omfattas av Handelns tjänstemannaavtal. Vi erbjuder friskvårdsbidrag, möjlighet att leasa förmånscykel och rabatter hos samarbetspartners och butiker.

Varje nyanställning på Captech inleds med en provanställning.

jobs.description:
TRATON is a group of strong brands with a shared mission: transforming transportation together to create the future of sustainable transport solutions. Within TRATON, we include MAN, Scania, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International. As part of a global team of industry experts, you get to think bigger, experience more, and reach further. Together, we have the power to transform transportation - Let´s make a difference together. Find out more: www.traton.com 

Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do. 

Role Summary

This role is part of TRATON Group R&D, located in Södertälje, Sweden.

As a Full-Stack Software Developer
, you will join Team Jaguar, one of several cross-functional development teams working together to build the TRATON Workshop Suite (TWS)
– the digital workshop platform supporting technicians in servicing, maintaining and updating vehicles across the TRATON Group.

Team Jaguar is responsible for the Software Update domain
, developing user-facing functionality that enables workshop technicians to safely and efficiently update vehicle software. The team owns the functionality and user experience end-to-end, from the workshop application through backend and cloud services. To deliver the complete solution, we collaborate closely with other TWS teams and use shared capabilities such as product and vehicle communication services.

In this role, you will work across the full technology stack, primarily using C#/.NET, AWS and Angular
in a microservice-based architecture. The solutions you develop are ultimately used by workshop technicians in their daily work, giving the role a clear connection between the technology we build and the value it creates for our users.

You will be part of a team with shared responsibility for building, operating and continuously improving stable, secure and user-friendly solutions that support efficient workshop operations across the TRATON Group.

Job Responsibilities

Develop and maintain full-stack functionality within the Software Update domain, using C#/.NET, AWS and Angular across frontend, backend, microservices and APIs;
Build robust and user-friendly solutions that enable safe and reliable software updates of vehicles;
Take part in the complete software lifecycle – from requirements, design and implementation to testing, deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, support and maintenance;
Collaborate closely with developers, testers, Product Owner and Scrum Master within the team, as well as with other teams across TWS;
Troubleshoot complex technical issues across frontend, backend, cloud services and integrations;
Continuously improve system stability, observability, maintainability, quality and user experience;
Contribute to testing and validation in development environments, rigs and real vehicles;
Contribute actively to the team's way of working, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.

Who You Are

We believe you are a collaborative and curious full-stack software developer who enjoys solving real problems for end users and understanding the complete solution.

You have at least 3 years of relevant professional experience
and a solid foundation in software development. You don't need to have worked with every technology in our stack – what matters is that you have relevant experience, enjoy learning and can contribute effectively as part of a team.

You have experience with C#/.NET, cloud development such as AWS and microservice architectures
, combined with frontend development. Experience with Angular is preferred
, while experience with other modern frontend frameworks, such as React, is also valuable.

You do not need to be equally strong in frontend and backend development, but you should be comfortable working across both and willing to contribute wherever the team needs you.

For us, technical competence is only part of what makes a great developer. How you collaborate, communicate and contribute to the team is equally important.
We are looking for someone who enjoys working closely with others, shares knowledge, asks for help when needed and actively helps others succeed. We value shared ownership and believe that the best results are achieved together.

You are comfortable communicating with different audiences – from discussing technical details with fellow developers to explaining complex technical topics to stakeholders with different levels of technical knowledge. You can adapt your communication to your audience, making complex topics understandable without losing what is important. You listen to different perspectives and seek to understand the needs behind what we build.

You take initiative and ownership while staying aligned with the team. You are curious about the customer and want to understand not only how
something should be built, but why it matters to the people using it
.

Experience within automotive software, vehicle communication, distributed systems, DevOps, observability or similar technically complex environments is considered an advantage, but not a requirement. Most importantly, you are motivated to learn the domain, contribute to the team and grow together with us.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and value different experiences and perspectives. If you are excited about the role but don't meet every qualification listed, we still encourage you to apply.

This Is Us

Team Jaguar
is a cross-functional team of developers and testers responsible for the Software Update domain within the TRATON Workshop Suite
.

Our solutions enable workshop technicians to perform software updates on vehicles, making our work both technically challenging and directly connected to the end-user experience. We develop across frontend, backend and cloud services and collaborate closely with other TWS teams whose capabilities together enable the complete workshop solution.

Jaguar is one of several teams that together develop the TRATON Workshop Suite. We have clear ownership of our domain while depending on and contributing to the wider TWS ecosystem. Close collaboration across team boundaries is therefore a natural part of how we work.

Within Jaguar, we work closely together and share responsibility for what we build and operate. Different experiences, perspectives and strengths make the team better
, and we help each other solve problems, share knowledge and learn along the way. We want an environment where people feel comfortable asking questions, contributing ideas and challenging existing solutions constructively.

We strive to work in an agile and iterative way
, with close collaboration, shared ownership and continuous improvement. As a team, we plan, build, evaluate, learn and adjust together, continuously looking for ways to improve both our solutions and how we work.

Joining Team Jaguar means becoming part of a collaborative team where you can work across the full technology stack, broaden your skills across frontend, backend and cloud development
, and contribute to solutions with a clear impact on workshop operations.

As part of the wider TRATON Workshop Suite development organization
, you will also be exposed to different technical domains, technologies and challenges, creating opportunities to broaden your experience and continue developing over time. You will have opportunities to learn from others, share your own expertise and grow together with the team as we continue developing the TRATON Workshop Suite.

TRATON Offers

We offer a dynamic and engaging workplace where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. You will be part of a strong team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and close cooperation across functions.

With a structured development plan and a wide range of training opportunities, TRATON Group R&D supports your professional growth both locally and internationally.

Benefits include access to our health center in Gröndal or a wellness allowance, bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. We also arrange events for employees and their families, and for those living in Stockholm, convenient commuting is supported through direct Scania Job express buses to Södertälje.

Application

We look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties.

Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-10-19. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check is required for this role.

If you have questions or would like more information, please contact: Mattias Gustafsson, Unit Head - System Development Service Products - TGROSDS, mattias.gustafsson@scania.com

We look forward to your application!

jobs.title: Software Engineer / AI Engineer
jobs.description:
We're growing our engineering team and looking for both Software Engineers and AI Engineers to help build the next generation of Aleido's platform. Whether your strength is solid, scalable software or applying AI to real products, you'll join a team where AI isn't a side project. It's built into what we deliver and how we build it.

About The Role

You'll work on Aleido's modular platform for product information, used by some of the world's leading industrial companies to create, manage and deliver technical content. You'll own work from specification to deployment, contribute to technical decisions and help shape how we engineer as a team.

You'll join us in one of two directions:

As a Software Engineer, you'll focus on building high-quality features across the platform: APIs, cloud services and modular architecture on Azure and .NET.
As an AI Engineer, you'll focus on bringing AI into the platform and our products: LLM-powered features, agent integrations, automation and tooling that turns AI capabilities into measurable customer value.

Both directions share the same foundation and work closely together.

What You'll Do

Own development tasks from specification to deployment.
Write high-quality, scalable and maintainable code, using AI-assisted development to work faster without compromising quality.
Contribute to design and architecture discussions and propose technical solutions.
Perform thorough code reviews and contrubute to overall code validation and quality practices.
Collaborate closely with Product Owners and UX to refine requirements.
Support platform operations, monitoring and troubleshooting.
Improve workflows, documentation and engineering standards, including how we work with AI.
Stay curious about new technologies and help keep our solutions ahead of the curve.

Who You Are

We believe that you have:

A strong understanding of software engineering, cloud services and distributed systems.
Good experience with Azure, .NET or an equivalent modern tech stack.
An understanding of CI/CD pipelines, automated testing and observability.
A clear grasp of API design, modular architecture and platform patterns.
Hands-on experience using AI tools in your development work, and genuine interest in where this technology is heading.
Strong problem-solving and debugging skills, and a sense of ownership for what you deliver.
Clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Fluency in English, written and spoken.

For the AI Engineer direction, we also expect experience building with LLMs, AI services or frameworks (e.g. Anthropic, OpenAI or Azure AI services), and with integrating AI capabilities into .NET applications.

Nice to have

Experience with Azure cloud platform.
Familiarity of AI/ML-enabled systems, including information flow, uncertainty and error propagation, common failure modes, and approaches to troubleshooting and debugging.
Experience with agentic workflows, MCP or other AI integration patterns.
Understanding of business process mapping and optimization techniques.
Familiarity with content management, technical documentation or aftermarket information.

Who We Are

Aleido is a Swedish international company with a long heritage of driving the development of product information and learning solutions. Our customers develop complex products or systems, or seek knowledge and confidence to create lasting change, within a wide range of industries including automotive, telecom, advanced machinery, rail and medtech. We are almost a thousand colleagues in five countries. Together we bridge the gap between technology and the people who depend on it – by making the advanced simply understood.

You'll be part of a tight-knit and innovative team where your work truly makes a difference. We believe in empowering people, embracing creativity and constantly pushing the boundaries of what's possible with software and AI.

Att jobba som .NET-utvecklare

Som .NET-utvecklare blir du en del av ett tvärfunktionellt DevSecOps-team med ansvar för interna plattformar och verktyg. Tillsammans utvecklar och förvaltar ni lösningar som används av utvecklare i hela Skandia. Genom ett nära samarbete med andra team bidrar ni till effektiva, säkra och moderna utvecklingsflöden.

I Rollen Kommer Du Bland Annat Att

utveckla och vidareutveckla interna portaler och egenutvecklade lösningar
bygga integrationer mellan olika system, exempelvis Azure DevOps och ServiceNow
automatisera processer och arbetsflöden enligt principen Everything as Code
vidareutveckla och förbättra bygg-, test- och deployprocesser i Azure DevOps och Octopus Deploy
bidra till säkra och effektiva utvecklingsprocesser med fokus på kodkvalitet, säkerhet och automation

Vi arbetar agilt enligt SAFe och i nära samarbete med andra utvecklingsteam, där du bidrar till den fortsatta utvecklingen och förvaltningen av plattformen.

För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har:

flera års erfarenhet av utveckling i C# och .NET
erfarenhet av backendutveckling och systemintegrationer
goda kunskaper i Git, YAML och PowerShell
erfarenhet av agila arbetssätt, exempelvis SAFe
goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av Azure DevOps, Octopus Deploy, CI/CD eller testautomation.

Vem är du?

Vi tror att du är en nyfiken och lösningsorienterad person som trivs med att ta dig an tekniska utmaningar och hitta smarta lösningar. Du trivs med att samarbeta med andra, delar gärna med dig av din kunskap och bidrar till ett öppet och hjälpsamt teamklimat.

Du är nyfiken på ny teknik och har en vilja att kontinuerligt utveckla både dig själv och de lösningar du arbetar med.

Vad händer nu? 

I ansökan kommer vi att ställa ett antal urvalsfrågor som ligger till grund för första urvalet.

Läs mer om hela vår rekryteringsprocess här.

Om du har frågor kring rollen, vänligen kontakta rekryterande chef Izabella Rolnik på izabella.rolnik@skandia.se.

Om du har frågor kopplat till rekryteringsprocess, vänligen ta kontakt med Nina Fazeli på nina.fazeli@skandia.se.

Vi kommer att ta ett sommaruppehåll i rekryteringsprocessen och återupptar intervjuerna i augusti.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan, och trevlig sommar!

Mer om IT

Vi på Skandia IT är stolta över att vara en kundorienterad enhet som levererar effektiva och säkra lösningar för våra kunder. Med cirka 600 engagerade medarbetare är vi mitt i en spännande transformationsresa, där vi utvecklas tillsammans och har kul på vägen. Framåt tillsammans är vårt motto! 

Vi arbetar agilt och har sedan 2017 använt oss av SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) ramverket, där leverans och kundvärde alltid står i centrum. Våra tågledningar och team, jobbar verksamhetsbaserat med aktiviteter som sprintplanering, daily stand-ups, team-synk, code reviews och retrospektiv. 

Var 12:e vecka samlas vi alla i vår ljusa och inspirerande Ljusgård på kontoret i Stockholm för 2 planeringsdagar. Planeringsperioden består av 6 tvåveckorssprintar, där den sista sprinten är en innovationssprint. Här får du chansen att, själv eller tillsammans med ditt team, utveckla och förfina våra system.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Om oss

Hos Winassist utvecklar vi en affärskritisk produktplattform som används varje dag av tusentals personer inom fordons- och verkstadsbranschen. Våra lösningar hjälper våra kunder att planera arbetet, ta hand om kunder och driva sina verksamheter effektivt.

Vi söker nu en senior utvecklare till vårt Core-team som vill arbeta brett, från en stor etablerad kodbas och komplex affärslogik till nya tjänster och moderna molnlösningar.

Ditt uppdrag

Core-teamet ansvarar för stora delar av kärnan i Winassists produkt. Här finns både affärskritiska system som utvecklats och förfinats under många år och vår nya plattform.

Teknikmiljön är därför bred. En stor del av vår befintliga produkt är utvecklad i Delphi, medan vår nya backend huvudsakligen utvecklas i Kotlin. Parallellt förflyttar vi vår plattform från on-prem mot SaaS.

Som senior utvecklare i Core kommer du att arbeta med både dagens produkt och vår nya plattform. Det kan innebära att vidareutveckla befintlig funktionalitet, bygga nytt eller bedöma när ett behov bör lösas i den nya plattformen. En viktig del av rollen är att kunna navigera i den här förflyttningen, göra pragmatiska tekniska avvägningar mellan dagens behov och vår långsiktiga arkitektur samt vara med och påverka hur vi utvecklar plattformen framåt.

AI är också en viktig del av rollen. Vi använder redan AI i utvecklingsarbetet och söker någon som har kommit långt praktiskt och vill hjälpa både teamet och våra arbetssätt att ta nästa steg.

Du kommer bland annat att

Utveckla och vidareutveckla våra affärskritiska system i framför allt Kotlin och Delphi.
Sätta dig in i och lösa komplexa problem i stora etablerade kodbaser, affärslogik och datamodeller.
Ta ägarskap för komplexa tekniska problem, från analys och lösningsdesign till implementation, verifiering och produktion.
Bygga nya tjänster och ta ansvar för tekniska beslut kring systemdesign, API:er, integrationer och data.
Arbeta hela vägen från utveckling till deployment och drift, inklusive CI/CD, konfiguration, observability och felsökning i produktion.
Ta en drivande roll i hur vi använder AI och AI-agenter i utvecklingsarbetet och hjälpa teamet att utveckla sina arbetssätt inom området.
Arbeta tillsammans med andra utvecklare, Tech Lead, Engineering Manager, produkt och QA för att lösa problem hela vägen från behov till produktion.

Vem vi tror att du är

Du är en erfaren backend- eller fullstackutvecklare som gillar att förstå helheten, se samband och ta dig an tekniska utmaningar som kräver både analys och pragmatism. Du är självgående, nyfiken, har ett eget driv och är van att ta tekniskt ansvar, men ser också senioritet som något som handlar om att göra teamet bättre, inte bara lösa dina egna uppgifter.

Du behöver inte kunna alla tekniker vi använder idag. Viktigare är att du har en stark grund inom mjukvaruutveckling och systemdesign och är van att sätta dig in i nya tekniska områden.

För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du har gedigen erfarenhet av mjukvaruutveckling och flera av följande områden:

Backendutveckling i exempelvis Kotlin, Java, C#/.NET eller liknande.
Systemdesign, API:er, integrationer och databaser.
Cloud och DevOps, där du själv arbetat med vägen från kod till deployment och drift.
CI/CD, automatiserade tester och moderna utvecklingsflöden.
Större etablerade kodbaser och system med komplex affärslogik.
AI som en integrerad del av ditt utvecklingsarbete.

Erfarenhet av GCP, Kotlin, Kubernetes, Terraform, Delphi, SaaS eller fordonsbranschen är meriterande.

Du behöver inte ha arbetat med Delphi tidigare, men du behöver vara öppen för att arbeta med det som en del av rollen.

AI är extra viktigt för den här rollen

Vi söker inte bara någon som använder AI för code completion eller enskilda frågor.

Vi vill att du har praktisk erfarenhet av mer avancerade AI-drivna utvecklingsflöden, exempelvis AI-agenter där modeller får relevant kontext och verktyg för att analysera kod, genomföra förändringar och verifiera resultat. Erfarenhet av exempelvis MCP, tool use eller motsvarande är meriterande.

Du behöver inte vara AI/ML-specialist eller ha erfarenhet av att träna egna modeller. Det viktiga är att du har experimenterat praktiskt, förstår både möjligheter och begränsningar och vet hur AI-genererat arbete behöver verifieras.

Vi vill också att du tycker det är kul att dela med dig av det du kan och hjälpa andra utvecklare att utveckla hur de arbetar med AI.

Det här erbjuder vi

Hos Winassist får du det bästa av två världar. Vi är ett etablerat och lönsamt produktbolag med stark kundbas och hög efterfrågan på våra lösningar, samtidigt som vi är tillräckligt små för att ha korta beslutsvägar och stora möjligheter att påverka.

Du får:

Arbeta nära produkten och se effekten av det du bygger hos tusentals användare.
Vara med och forma vår resa mot SaaS, molntjänster och AI-drivna arbetssätt.
Ta stort tekniskt ansvar och påverka arkitektur, teknikval och arbetssätt.
Arbeta tillsammans med erfarna kollegor som gärna delar kunskap och hjälper varandra.

Här möts du av ett engagerat team med hög arbetsglädje, nära samarbete och högt i tak.

Vi erbjuder bland annat hybridarbete, friskvårdstimme, kostnadsfritt gym i huset, och konkurrenskraftig tjänstepension.

Rollen är baserad i Häggvik norr om Stockholm, med möjlighet till hybridarbete. För mer information om hur det är att arbeta hos oss och våra förmåner, se https://winassist.se/karriar/

Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig! Ansökan är öppen till och med 1 november.

Observera att detta är en rekrytering till en anställning hos Winassist. Vi tar inte emot ansökningar eller förslag från konsultbolag för denna tjänst.

jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer– Public 360° – Tieto Indtech (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Job Description

Senior Platform Engineer
– Public 360° – Tieto Indtech (m/f/d)

Tieto Public 360° – building secure, scalable digital services for the public sector across the Nordics.

About The Company

Tieto's Public 360° is a leading case management platform used across the Nordic public sector for over 20 years. Since 2014, the SaaS platform has been running on modernized Azure infrastructure with automated deployments while also supporting on-prem/hybrid/Domestic cloud installations.

The 360° platform currently powers three solutions:

Public 360° – Case and archive management

Plan & Build 360° – Building permit applications

eArchive 360° – Long-term data storage

The challenge

We're building on Public 360°'s modern foundation to expand across multiple cloud environments—strengthening Nordic digital sovereignty and enabling AI capabilities, all while maintaining the highest requirements for security and compliance.

The role

As a Senior Platform Engineer, you'll advance the technical capabilities of the 360° hosting platform. You'll design and operate cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes platforms, automation, and security systems that support continued growth and enable new AI-powered features.

Key Responsibilities

Build and operate the cloud platform foundation supporting Public 360° across Public Cloud and Domestic Cloud environments.
Deploy, manage, and continuously improve Kubernetes-based platforms and containerized workloads.
Drive automation through Infrastructure as Code (Bicep), GitOps, CI/CD, and self-service platform capabilities.
Establish secure and scalable platform services covering networking, identity, secrets management, monitoring, and operational governance.
Improve reliability and operational excellence through observability, automation, incident management, and best practices.
Support the modernization of Public 360° through cloud-native technologies, APIs, messaging, and microservices architectures.

Required Qualifications

Several years of experience in Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or similar roles.
Strong Azure and cloud-native platform experience.
Strong hands-on Kubernetes experience, including:
Cluster deployment, installation, and lifecycle management.
Operations, upgrades, troubleshooting, and maintenance.
Networking, security, and scalability.
Experience operating Kubernetes in cloud, on-premises, or domestic cloud environments.

Experience with Microsoft Azure services, particularly AKS, cloud networking, security monitoring, logging, and observability platforms.
Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Bicep, Terraform or similar), GitOps, and CI/CD using Azure DevOps and/or GitHub.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with sovereign, domestic cloud, hybrid cloud, or other highly regulated environments.
Familiarity with messaging technologies such as RabbitMQ, Kafka, or Azure Service Bus.
Experience with Keycloak or other identity and access management platforms.
Experience operating distributed systems, microservices architectures, or multi-region Kubernetes environments.
Exposure to AI platform infrastructure, intelligent automation, or GenAI technologies.

Tech we use

We are Azure-first and automation-driven, building and operating our platform using Kubernetes (AKS), Docker, containers, GitOps, and Infrastructure as Code with Bicep. Our engineering teams use Azure DevOps and GitHub Workflows for CI/CD and automation, supported by Azure networking and cloud security services. We focus heavily on observability and reliability, using Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, and Alloy for monitoring and telemetry. Authentication and authorization are managed through Keycloak, while RabbitMQ provides messaging capabilities across our platform. Our API and ingress layer is built on technologies such as APISIX and NGINX, with certificate management handled through OpenBao and cert-manager. Development is primarily done using .NET (C#), TypeScript/JavaScript, PowerShell, and Bash, with Visual Studio and Visual Studio Code as our primary development tools.

Why join us

Build technology that improves citizen services across the Nordic public sector.
Work with modern cloud technologies and large-scale enterprise software.
Join a highly skilled and collaborative engineering environment with significant influence on technical decisions.
Opportunity to shape the future platform capabilities supporting Public 360°.
Professional growth through international collaboration, technical leadership opportunities, and continuous learning.
A culture built on trust, transparency, ownership, and innovation.

Practicalities

Location and work setup:
Flexible/hybrid, ideally near one of our development hubs in Scandinavia (Oslo, Stockholm, Copenhagen, or Espoo).

Language requirements:
Fluent English required. Nordic language skills are considered an advantage.

Are you our new colleague?

We look forward to hearing from you! We will fill the position as soon as we find the right person, so we encourage you to apply today.

If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact the hiring managers Ida Sirevaag
(ida.sirevaag@tieto.com) or Geir Are Bjørnsrud
(geirare.bjornsrud@tieto.com).

Additional Information

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

Work closely with customers to understand their problems and rapidly design practical AI solutions

Build and deploy cloud-native applications, preferably on Azure
Apply modern software engineering practices (Git, CI/CD, quality-oriented development)
Use MLOps approaches to operationalize models, monitor them, and ensure they deliver value
Integrate with APIs and enterprise systems (REST, events, custom interfaces)
Work with databases, SQL, and pragmatic data engineering where required
Navigate between solution shaping, hands-on implementation, and light advisory, depending on the customer phase

What We’re Looking For

4+ years of experience in software or data applications, ideally with hands-on AI/ML components
Experience with AI agents and large language models (LLMs)

Strong skills in Python and modern engineering practices (Git, CI/CD, testing mindset)

Why Norrin? 

At Norrin, you'll join an international team
of 220 professionals working across Finland, Sweden, Thailand, Vietnam, and the United States. We invest in continuous learning
through training and certification opportunities, as well as our guild communities where knowledge is shared and built together. As a Microsoft and Databricks partner, we work with leading technologies and support you in continuously expanding your expertise. At Norrin, you'll have the opportunity to grow in a direction that matters to you. We believe that great work starts with a supportive environment. That's why we foster a culture built on openness, equality, and mutual respect
, with psychological safety at its core .
We're committed to promoting diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities in the tech industry.

Our hybrid working model
combines flexibility with collaboration, giving you the freedom to work remotely while bringing people together when it creates the most value. To support your well-being, we also offer wellbeing benefits
like insurance coverage and an annual wellness allowance. Depending on the role, our competitive compensation model

Integrationer för molnbaserade tjänster
Cloud DevOps och DevSecOps samt Lösningsarkitektur

Back-end erfarenhet inom följande: Python, TypeScript eller liknande
Front-end erfarenhet inom följande: Angular, Vue.js eller Jquery

Arbeta med de senaste teknologierna och påverka på nordisk nivå. Du samarbetar med andra specialister, kompetensväxlar och bidrar till att bygga AWS/GCP-kapabilitet i Norden – samtidigt som du påverkar några av världens största bolag.

Helsenorge videreutvikles kontinuerlig. Arbeidet omfatter både utvikling av ny funksjonalitet, videreutvikling og forvaltning av eksisterende løsninger, samt modernisering og arbeid med teknisk gjeld. Det er behov for en backend-/fullstack utvikler til et av produktteamene på Helsenorge.

Personvern og sekundærbruk
Person og tilgang

Fullmaktsløsning for uthenting av medisiner på apotek
Samtykkeløsning for forskningsprosjekter
Persontilpasning, blant annet med snarveier på forsiden på Helsenorge
Oversikt over helseopplysninger som deles
Tilgangsstyring og personvern knyttet til ulike oppdrag, blant annet helsekort for gravide og pasientens prøvesvar

jobs.title: Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
We make cargo talk. Why? Because a third of all food and pharma produce is wasted on the way to consumers, and we're out to change that. Our smart tracker Emma, made from recycled ocean plastic, travels with temperature-sensitive shipments for enterprise customers in food, pharma and seafood across 20+ countries. We're looking for a seasoned engineer to own the platform behind it, and to build it for ten times the fleet we run today.

What you'll do Own our Azure cloud platform end to end: architecture, ingestion, data, cost, and the calls about what we run and why.
Push AI-assisted development further than most dare. Claude writes most of our code and a human owns every merge. You'll define how far that goes for production infrastructure, and build the guardrails.
Scale ingestion and the data tier for a fast-growing fleet, without per-device cloud cost rising with it.
Make reliability unremarkable: no reading silently lost, late and backfilled data handled gracefully, and monitoring that spots trouble before a customer does.
Grow the data platform so questions about the fleet or a single shipment are answered in seconds, not filed as tickets.

Our stack A cloud-native platform on Azure: event-driven IoT ingestion, serverless services, and both operational and analytical data stores. CI/CD carries much of what we ship, a human reviews every change, and turning more of our infrastructure into code is a job we want you to own. AI runs through development, operations and analysis, and we are leaning into what is now just possible. We're ISO 27001 certified and our customers are audited, so security shapes real engineering decisions. We'll go through the details with you in the interview.

What you bring Deep experience in building and operating production cloud infrastructure: Azure, or another major cloud and the appetite to go Azure-deep.
Real conviction about AI-assisted development, with the judgement to know when to slow down and verify.
A curious, fast-learning mind. Being a jack-of-all-trades is a real plus here.
Fluency with infrastructure as code, CI/CD and observability.
Strong Postgres and SQL, and sound instincts for modelling time-series data at volume.

Nice to have: IoT or telemetry at fleet scale, cellular (LTE-M, NB-IoT), ISO 27001/SOC 2 environments, Python, and cloud cost engineering.

What we offer Competitive salary, good pension, and share options. Own a piece of what you build.
Flexible hours and location; a welcoming office at Kjelsås Stasjon with parking and good transit connections. Our team tends to spend about half their time at the HQ.
Your choice of tools, plus best-in-class AI tools with generous quotas.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Senior Platform Engineer
– Public 360° – Tieto Indtech (m/f/d)

Tieto Public 360° – building secure, scalable digital services for the public sector across the Nordics.

About The Company

Tieto's Public 360° is a leading case management platform used across the Nordic public sector for over 20 years. Since 2014, the SaaS platform has been running on modernized Azure infrastructure with automated deployments while also supporting on-prem/hybrid/Domestic cloud installations.

The 360° platform currently powers three solutions:

Public 360° – Case and archive management

Plan & Build 360° – Building permit applications

eArchive 360° – Long-term data storage

The challenge

We're building on Public 360°'s modern foundation to expand across multiple cloud environments—strengthening Nordic digital sovereignty and enabling AI capabilities, all while maintaining the highest requirements for security and compliance.

The role

As a Senior Platform Engineer, you'll advance the technical capabilities of the 360° hosting platform. You'll design and operate cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes platforms, automation, and security systems that support continued growth and enable new AI-powered features.

Key Responsibilities

Build and operate the cloud platform foundation supporting Public 360° across Public Cloud and Domestic Cloud environments.
Deploy, manage, and continuously improve Kubernetes-based platforms and containerized workloads.
Drive automation through Infrastructure as Code (Bicep), GitOps, CI/CD, and self-service platform capabilities.
Establish secure and scalable platform services covering networking, identity, secrets management, monitoring, and operational governance.
Improve reliability and operational excellence through observability, automation, incident management, and best practices.
Support the modernization of Public 360° through cloud-native technologies, APIs, messaging, and microservices architectures.

Required Qualifications

Several years of experience in Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or similar roles.
Strong Azure and cloud-native platform experience.
Strong hands-on Kubernetes experience, including:
Cluster deployment, installation, and lifecycle management.
Operations, upgrades, troubleshooting, and maintenance.
Networking, security, and scalability.
Experience operating Kubernetes in cloud, on-premises, or domestic cloud environments.

Experience with Microsoft Azure services, particularly AKS, cloud networking, security monitoring, logging, and observability platforms.
Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Bicep, Terraform or similar), GitOps, and CI/CD using Azure DevOps and/or GitHub.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with sovereign, domestic cloud, hybrid cloud, or other highly regulated environments.
Familiarity with messaging technologies such as RabbitMQ, Kafka, or Azure Service Bus.
Experience with Keycloak or other identity and access management platforms.
Experience operating distributed systems, microservices architectures, or multi-region Kubernetes environments.
Exposure to AI platform infrastructure, intelligent automation, or GenAI technologies.

Tech we use

We are Azure-first and automation-driven, building and operating our platform using Kubernetes (AKS), Docker, containers, GitOps, and Infrastructure as Code with Bicep. Our engineering teams use Azure DevOps and GitHub Workflows for CI/CD and automation, supported by Azure networking and cloud security services. We focus heavily on observability and reliability, using Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, and Alloy for monitoring and telemetry. Authentication and authorization are managed through Keycloak, while RabbitMQ provides messaging capabilities across our platform. Our API and ingress layer is built on technologies such as APISIX and NGINX, with certificate management handled through OpenBao and cert-manager. Development is primarily done using .NET (C#), TypeScript/JavaScript, PowerShell, and Bash, with Visual Studio and Visual Studio Code as our primary development tools.

Why join us

Build technology that improves citizen services across the Nordic public sector.
Work with modern cloud technologies and large-scale enterprise software.
Join a highly skilled and collaborative engineering environment with significant influence on technical decisions.
Opportunity to shape the future platform capabilities supporting Public 360°.
Professional growth through international collaboration, technical leadership opportunities, and continuous learning.
A culture built on trust, transparency, ownership, and innovation.

Practicalities

Location and work setup:
Flexible/hybrid, ideally near one of our development hubs in Scandinavia (Oslo, Stockholm, Copenhagen, or Espoo).

Language requirements:
Fluent English required. Nordic language skills are considered an advantage.

Are you our new colleague?

We look forward to hearing from you! We will fill the position as soon as we find the right person, so we encourage you to apply today.

If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact the hiring managers Ida Sirevaag
(ida.sirevaag@tieto.com) or Geir Are Bjørnsrud
(geirare.bjornsrud@tieto.com).

Additional Information

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

With over $300M in ARR and a network connecting hundreds of thousands of buyers and suppliers, Basware sits at the centre of financial automation for some of the world’s largest organisations.

We are now in a pivotal phase of our product evolution — deeply embedding AI and machine learning across the platform to deliver smarter, faster, and more autonomous financial workflows. This role sits at the heart of that transformation.

As Portfolio Architect

Strategic Partnership

Etsimme nyt Power Platform Developeria
tiimiin, jossa tarjoamme mahdollisuuden työskennellä monipuolisissa ja merkityksellisissä projekteissa, jotka muovaavat toimialoja ja parantavat ihmisten arkea.

Mikä on Tech Consulting?

Tech Consulting on digitaalisen suunnittelun ja ohjelmistokehityksen yksikkö, jossa autamme asiakkaitamme kasvamaan yhdistämällä liiketoimintamuotoilun, teknologisen osaamisen ja modernin ohjelmistokehityksen parhaat käytännöt.

Mitä tulet tekemään tässä roolissa?

Tässä roolissa yrittäjähenkisyys ja oma-aloitteisuus ovat avainasemassa. Pääset rakentamaan roolistasi omanlaisesi osana tiimiämme, ja painopisteesi voi olla esimerkiksi myynnin tukemisessa, asiakasdialogissa, teknisten ratkaisujen määrittelyssä, backlogien jalostamisessa tai jatkuvan parantamisen edistämisessä.

Työskentelemme usein funktioittain asiakkaiden sijaan, ja odotamme sinulta uusia näkökulmia sekä halua kehittää toimintatapojamme. Asiakastyössä autat ohjaamaan keskustelua pitkäjänteisen ja ketterän tuotekehityksen suuntaan sen sijaan, että keskityttäisiin pelkästään aikataulukysymyksiin.

Liityt tiimiin, jossa osaamisen jakaminen, yhteistyö ja asiakkaista huolehtiminen ovat vahvasti läsnä. Näkemystäsi arvostetaan, ja toivomme sinun olevan tärkeä osa yhteistä menestystämme!

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

Vähintään 2 vuoden kokemus Microsoft Power Platform -ratkaisujen suunnittelusta ja toteutuksesta
Vahva osaaminen Power Platformista (Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, Power Pages, Copilot Studio)
Dynamics 365 -kokemus katsotaan eduksi
Power Platform / Dynamics -sertifikaatit plussaa

Kokemusta tekoälyn hyödyntämisestä kehityksessä ja asiakasratkaisuissa
Hyvät viestintätaidot ja kyky selittää teknisiä ratkaisuja ei-teknisille sidosryhmille
Sujuva suomi ja englanti
Soveltuva korkeakoulututkinto (esim. tietojenkäsittely, ohjelmistotekniikka)

Miksi liittyä kasvavaan tiimiimme?

Tiedolla rakennamme teknologiaa, joka toimii ihmisten hyväksi. Tech Consultingissa työskentelet teknologian, innovaation ja yhteiskunnallisen vaikuttavuuden rajapinnassa.

Saat tueksesi Suomen laajimman IT-osaajaverkoston sekä kulttuurin, joka kannustaa yhteistyöhön, uteliaisuuteen ja jatkuvaan oppimiseen. Meillä kasvu ei pysähdy.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

Merkityksellistä työtä yhteiskunnallisesti kriittisten digitaalisten ratkaisujen parissa
Pohjoismaisen, vastuullisen ja luottamukseen perustuvan työyhteisön
Mahdollisuuksia kehittää osaamistasi eri toimialoilla, teknologioissa ja rooleissa
Joustavat työskentelytavat, hyvinvointia tukevat edut sekä inhimillisen työkulttuurin

Miten haet mukaan?

Lähetä hakemuksesi urasivujemme kautta ja tule mukaan rakentamaan Microsoft-ratkaisujen tulevaisuutta eri toimialoilla!

Huomioithan, että emme käsittele hakemuksia heinäkuun aikana. Palaamme rekrytointiprosessiin elokuun alussa, joten jätä hakemuksesi jo nyt, jotta ehdit mukaan hakuun!

jobs.title: DevEx Engineer
jobs.location: Vejle, Region of Southern Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
Join AutoProff – Help Shape the Future of Automotive Tech!
🚀

We’re looking for a DevEx Engineer
to join our Empower platform squad “Taycan”
. The squad is split between our HQ in Vejle and our Copenhagen office, so the role can be based in either location.

The Taycan squad helps engineers spend more time delivering product value and less time solving the same technical problems. We build shared capabilities that make the preferred engineering path easier to use.

As our new DevEx Engineer
, you’ll work on the shared tooling, libraries and development patterns used by engineering squads across AutoProff. From scaffolding and shared libraries to patterns such as Outbox, Sagas and messaging, you’ll help make software development simpler and more consistent – so our product squads can spend less time solving the same technical problems and more time building great products.

You’ll work closely with platform engineers, service owners and engineers across our product squads, building solutions that are used across the engineering organisation rather than within just one product area.

Help build shared capabilities and DevEx foundations that enable teams to work effectively with agentic AI.

Use agentic AI in your own DevEx work and share practical learning with engineering teams.

We foster a developer-friendly culture with room to explore new technologies and ways of working. You’ll have access to modern AI-powered tools, join hackathons and take part in internal developer forums where we share ideas and discuss architecture, technology and engineering challenges.

Let's dive into your key responsibilities, you will

Build and evolve shared libraries, scaffolding templates, and CI/CD tooling that remove recurring friction for product squads.
Build paved paths for messaging patterns like Outbox and Sagas, observability, and rehydration/recovery tooling.
Support developers in adopting shared standards for tracing, service integration, and AWS infrastructure.
Work with engineers across product squads to understand recurring friction and turn it into DevEx priorities.
Help squads adopt platform practices that make service ownership, operation, and reuse easier.
Support developers in adopting shared standards for tracing, service integration, AWS infrastructure, and secure, reliable defaults

The need-to-have

Strong engineering experience in .NET / C#.
Proficiency in AWS services (e.g., ECS, Lambda, SQS, S3) and infrastructure-as-code (CDK/Terraform).
Familiarity with microservices, event-driven architecture, and distributed-systems patterns such as Outbox, Sagas, and CDC.
Hands-on experience building shared libraries, observability tooling, and reusable APIs.
Excellent collaboration and communication skills, able to support squads, gather feedback, and drive adoption.

The nice-to-have skills

Experience in platform engineering or developer enablement roles.
Familiarity with internal documentation practices, onboarding tooling, and automated scaffolding.
Hands-on work with service event rehydration, incident recovery tooling, or metadata standards.
Practical experience using LLMs, generative AI, or agentic AI in software development.

We’re eager to hear from you! If this sounds like a great match and sparks your interest, don’t wait, apply today!

About AutoProff

AutoProff was founded in 2013 by the experienced car dealer Jesper Ratza in Denmark. The aim was to digitalize B2B used car trading, helping car dealers increase sales and improve profits.

in August 2022, AutoScout24, the leading specialized pan-European online car marketplace, acquired a majority stake in AutoProff. The partnership has supported the rapid expansion of AutoProff's solutions across Europe and enables the creation of Europe's first fully integrated C2B-B2B-B2C dealing solution for used cars.

At AutoProff, we specialize in providing online B2B used-car dealing solutions designed to improve the buying and selling experience for professional car dealers and their customers.

We are the emerging European leader with more than 150,000 B2B used cars on our online trading platforms annually.

With a focus on effective solutions, digitization and customer service, we are committed to being the home of B2B car dealing for European car dealers.

jobs.title: Software Quality Engineer
jobs.description:
Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Quality Engineer to ensure software reliability, test automation, and continuous quality improvement across the software development lifecycle.

The role requires strong analytical skills, hands-on test automation experience, and close collaboration with product, engineering, and business teams to implement effective testing strategies.

The successful candidate will work in an Agile and DevOps-driven environment, focusing on fast feedback loops, risk-based testing, automation, and high software quality.

Responsibilities

Collaborate with Product Owners and Business Analysts to define clear and testable user story acceptance criteria.
Work closely with Software Engineers to improve automated test coverage and prevent defects from reaching production.
Analyse complex software systems and develop comprehensive, risk-based testing strategies.
Develop, maintain, and enhance test automation frameworks using industry-standard tools.
Design and execute test suites covering functional, regression, exploratory, integration, and performance testing.
Apply a risk-based approach to test automation, prioritising critical business functions and high-impact areas.
Conduct time-boxed exploratory testing to identify edge cases, usability issues, and potential defects.
Maintain stable regression test suites integrated with nightly QA builds.
Continuously improve smoke tests within CI/CD environments to support early defect detection.
Lead system integration testing with relevant system owners to validate cross-system functionality and interactions.
Coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) with business stakeholders to ensure requirements and acceptance criteria are met.
Manage the defect lifecycle, test artefacts, test results, and repositories to ensure effective tracking and reporting.
Drive continuous improvement of Agile testing practices, tools, processes, and methodologies.
Support application performance engineering or application security testing as a secondary area of responsibility.

Experience & Skills

Core Testing Expertise
Strong knowledge of test automation strategies and risk-based testing.
Experience designing and executing test cases, test plans, and comprehensive test suites.
Hands-on experience with manual and automated testing across web, mobile, and API-based applications.
Experience with cross-browser, cross-platform, and responsive UI testing.

Test Automation & CI/CD
Hands-on experience with automation frameworks such as Selenium, Playwright, Robot Framework, Cypress, SikuliX, or EggPlant.
Proficiency in test scripting or automation programming using Python, Java, JavaScript, or C#.
Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Bamboo, or similar tools.
Ability to design maintainable, scalable, and reusable test automation frameworks and suites.

Agile & DevOps Testing
Strong understanding of Agile testing methodologies, including TDD, BDD, and exploratory testing.
Experience working in Agile environments such as Scrum, Kanban, or XP.
Familiarity with shift-left testing practices and early defect detection.
Experience testing applications deployed in Docker and Kubernetes environments.

Security & Performance Testing
Experience with performance testing tools such as JMeter, Gatling, k6, or Locust is an advantage.
Knowledge of application security testing using tools such as OWASP ZAP, Burp Suite, SAST, or DAST is an advantage.
Experience with API security testing and authentication mechanisms such as OAuth and JWT is an advantage.

Test Management & Qualifications
Experience managing defects and test repositories using tools such as JIRA, TestRail, or Micro Focus ALM.
Certified Software Testing Professional (CSTP), Certified Software Quality Analyst (CSQA), or equivalent certification is an advantage.
Degree or Diploma in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

nShift
is the leading global provider of cloud delivery management solutions (SaaS), we enable the frictionless shipment and return of almost one billion shipments across 190 countries each year. We are headquartered in London and Oslo and have over 460 employees across offices in Sweden, Finland, Norway, Denmark, the United Kingdom, Poland, the Netherlands, Belgium, and Romania.

Our software is used by many of the world leading e-commerce, retail, manufacturing, and 3PL shippers due to us having over 1000 carriers integrated into our platform, nearly 3 times more than our competitors!

If you buy goods online, there is a strong chance that nShift has powered that delivery, so come and join us as we shape the future of shipping, one frictionless journey at a time.

About You

You're an engineering leader who still enjoys being close to the code. You care about your people as much as about the product, and you're comfortable balancing delivery, quality, and team growth.

You are someone who:

Builds and leads a high-performing team of developers and testers, with clear expectations and regular feedback
Knows the status of every commitment the team has made, and acts early when something slips
Holds a high bar for the team's work and your own, raised through clear expectations and direct feedback
Communicates openly and clearly with the team, stakeholders, and management, including when the message is difficult
Acts in the best interest of the company and the team when making tough decisions

Purpose of role

At nShift, the Engineering Manager's primary task is to lead, hold accountable, and deliver through a group of talented developers and testers, ensuring they thrive in a collaborative, high-performing environment.

You are part of the product trio together with the Product Manager and the Designer, aligning business goals, customer needs, and technical solutions. You are the team's voice to the wider organization and bring company priorities back to the team clearly and honestly.

Your role includes:

Collaborating with the product trio to balance feature delivery with quality
Supporting team development and maintaining a high-performing culture
Communicating company goals and representing the team within the organization
Owning delivery predictability and the team's say/do ratio, alongside technical excellence

What You'll Be Doing

Technology

Ensure that daily work aligns with the tech vision, guiding principles, and minimum quality standards, including monitoring code quality through tools like SonarQube.
Take part in design and architecture discussions, and review code regularly enough to have an informed view of quality and risk.
Challenge estimates and technical approaches, drawing on your own engineering experience.
Make sure that the technology managed by the team is resilient, secure, and up to date.
Promote internal education, collaboration, and knowledge-sharing across platforms and teams.

Process

Challenge your team to enhance their working methods, proactively addressing opportunities and obstacles with a critical mindset.
Ensure that your team follows established processes, such as Kanban, Scrum and test management, in service of predictable delivery, and advocate for adopting best practices and tools.
Own the team's delivery commitments. Track planned versus delivered work each sprint and quarter, report honestly on the gap, and drive corrective action.
Identify blockers, dependencies and risks early, and resolve or escalate them before they affect delivery.

People Management

Administer and oversee personal development plans, salary structures, and recruitment processes.
Create opportunities for team members to stay motivated through mentorship, coaching, or delegating tasks to encourage professional growth.
Set clear expectations for each engineer and manage performance against them, setting an example for your team to follow.
Build and maintain a robust team with overlapping skills and knowledge, avoiding critical dependencies on single individuals.

What You Will Bring

This is a hands-on management role
: you will know what your team is building, why it is late when it is late, and what you are doing about it. For our Data Exchange team, we are seeking candidates who embody the following characteristics:

Technical Proficiency: A strong hands-on background in C# is required, with a proven history of technical expertise in software development
. Experience with front-end development frameworks is a plus, but not mandatory.

Delivery Ownership:
A track record of teams that ship what they commit to, and comfort using metrics such as cycle time, sprint predictability, and say/do ratio to run the team.

Professional:
You understand that it’s a part of a manager’s role to look out for the interest of the company, and you are prepared to manage difficult tasks with this in mind.

Exacting Standards:
Maintaining high standards is vital as you consistently aim for excellence in both personal performance and the work produced by your team.

Effective Communication:
Proficiency in both written and spoken English is essential for ensuring seamless communication within the team and with stakeholders.

Requirements

The technologies this team uses are:

C#, .NET, .NET Core, React native, Vue.js
PostgreSQL
Docker, Bitbucket
AWS, IaC
SonarQube, JFrog

Education And Experience

BS degree in Computer Science or related field
Minimum of 5 years as a hands-on engineer, plus 2-3 years of management experience

Language Skills

Fluency in English is mandatory (written and spoken)

About Infiterra

Join our mission to grow and transform the subscription economy by simplifying subscription service delivery.

Infiterra
enables IT distributors, Managed Service Providers (MSPs), and telcos to succeed in the subscription economy. Our subscription commerce platform automates and unifies subscription workflows - from quote to bill- driving operational efficiency, billing accuracy, and scalable growth.

Recognized as a global leader in subscription commerce, Infiterra combines innovation, performance excellence, and trusted expertise to help partners transform and grow.

Join Infiterra and help power the future of subscription e-commerce.

Infiterra’s B2B SaaS platform helps IT Distributors and Managed Service Providers (MSPs) automate and grow their subscription business. With 100+ customers in 75 countries, we're recognized for innovation and global impact—and we’re just getting started. We foster a collaborative and growth-oriented culture, allowing you to be part of a dynamic, forward-thinking team.

The role in a nutshell 🔍

As a .NET Software Engineer, you'll be part of our agile team, working in the Scrum framework to deliver new features and improve existing ones in our subscription e-commerce platform, the multi-tenant B2B engine that powers global distributors. You'll own whole features within a product domain, from design to production, and work alongside experienced engineers who'll support your growth. From building scalable services to integrating major Software Vendors with our platform, your work will directly shape what our customers use every day.

🎯 Your goal?

To design and deliver reliable, well-tested features that simplify subscription services delivery, following our coding and architectural standards.

You'll be hands-on with .NET (legacy full .NET Framework 4.8 and .NET 10 (latest)), C#, SQL, and domain and service-oriented approaches. You'll work closely with POs, BAs, QA, and DevOps in an agile environment, so that features are delivered smoothly and predictably.

You won’t just code features. You'll own your features end-to-end: design, build, test, release, and keep them healthy in production.

🙋‍♀️ Our Ideal Candidate Profile

You’re a curious and analytical engineer who sees the big picture but sweats the details. You enjoy diving into system architecture, making thoughtful trade-offs, and writing clean, testable code.

You thrive in a fast-paced environment where innovation meets stability. You’re not just a builder. You’re a problem solver who looks for ways to make systems more efficient, scalable, and maintainable.

You value teamwork and knowledge-sharing, but you’re also confident in owning features independently. You’re someone who wants to grow while helping the team grow.

Why You’ll Love It Here 💙

Work on a platform that directly impacts customers across 75+ countries.
Hands-on exposure to APIs, billing systems, and large-scale/high-traffic B2B commerce.
A collaborative engineering culture with peer-led code reviews and knowledge-sharing.
Opportunities to shape system architecture and technical direction.
Friendly, dynamic team with room to grow and learn.
Remote-first: work from anywhere, with optional, ad hoc in-person meet-ups arranged around team members' availability.

What You'll Do

Feature Ownership: Own the end-to-end delivery of whole features within a domain, designing and delivering them independently to our coding and architectural standards.
Technical Debt: Manage your own technical debt through refactoring.
Automated Testing: Write robust automated tests.
Code Reviews: Review your peers' pull requests.
Observability: Build observability into your features, with guidance from DevOps.
Dependencies: Surface cross-team dependencies early.
Clear Communication: Explain technical trade-offs clearly to Product and Quality.
AI-assisted Engineering: Use approved AI tools across implementation, testing, debugging and refactoring, while remaining accountable for correctness and maintainability.

Success looks like: predictable delivery, stable production, more tech debt paid down than introduced in your area, and low escaped defects and rework on the changes you own. All of this comes from strong feature ownership, systems thinking, valuable code-review contributions and dependability.

What You'll Bring

Hands-on .NET engineering experience, typically gained over 3+ years of professional work. We look for proven depth rather than years alone, and assess this case by case.
Experience with .NET Framework 4.8 and/or .NET 10, and C#.
Solid experience with distributed systems and relational databases (SQL Server: queries, stored procedures, performance basics).
Good understanding of HTTP, JSON, and RESTful API principles.
Hands-on experience with test automation (unit and integration testing).
Comfortable working in a CI/CD toolchain (e.g. Azure DevOps).
Understanding of SOLID principles and design patterns, and the ability to apply them where appropriate.
Experience using AI-assisted coding tools responsibly, with the habit of checking what they produce.
Commitment to knowledge-sharing and collaborative teamwork.
University degree in Computer Science or any related field.
Fluency in the Greek and English languages, both oral and written.

Benefits & Perks 🎁

Work-from-anywhere scheme (travel and work).
Flexible working hours.
Health and life insurance program.
Learning & development budget.
Tech-driven, friendly team with an international mindset.

About us

Founded in 2015 in Athens, Greece, Welcome redefines the way people travel by going above and beyond the commoditized transfer service and being the first company to deliver a complete, personalised, in-destination travel experience. From the moment a traveler arrives at a new destination, until their return journey home, Welcome accommodates all their travel needs, including transfers, sightseeing trips, and local information, in the easiest, friendliest, and most personalised way possible. Welcome's drivers are experts in the area and share their local know-how to make travellers feel at home wherever they are. The company has also introduced contactless rides, thorough cleaning protocols, and protective equipment to make every journey safe.
Being a travel tech startup, Welcome continues to grow and scale its operations and is quickly becoming a global category leader for in-destination travel services.
One of the highest-rated global transportation companies with a rating of 4.9/5 stars.
Expanded from 200 destinations last year to 350, achieving our ambitious 2024 growth target.
Over 4,000 travel partners including 2,500 hotels, numerous vacation rentals, and travel agents, adding 50+ new ones every month.
Over 2.5 million happy travellers every year.

⭐️ If you want to dive deeper into the awesomeness of Welcome's culture, click
on this link
 to check our TikTok account.⭐️

The Team

We are a group of vibrant, diverse people who love travelling and never settle on quality. Each one of us didn't join Welcome by chance and believes deeply in what Welcome is trying to achieve, so we work relentlessly to make that happen. We challenge common logic, focus on design, put simplicity and usability first, and create memorable experiences. We keep learning and exploring better ways to serve our community and grow personally and professionally in our respective fields. We stay humble along the way, with a "pay it forward" mentality, but with big and bold goals.
As a Senior Platform Engineer
at Welcome Pickups ,
you will keep the platform behind our product reliable, fast, scalable and secure, so travellers, drivers and partners can count on our services every day. Much of what we do runs in the background: matching rides to drivers, pricing, notifications, partner syncs and payouts. If the platform slows down or stops, rides don't get assigned and travellers end up waiting at arrivals. This is a hands-on role that works across all our product teams. You will make key architecture and infrastructure decisions, set the standards everyone builds to, and own the technical roadmap together with the Product Manager of the Core team. The role is about helping product teams move fast without breaking things, not slowing them down.
What you'll work with

A large Ruby on Rails application, with Sidekiq and RabbitMQ
A large, fast-growing PostgreSQL/PostGIS database, plus Elasticsearch and Redis
Azure as our main cloud, with AWS S3 and Google Cloud
Cloud66, Cloudflare, CircleCI and Docker
New Relic and Rollbar for monitoring, and Mixpanel for product analytics
30+ external services, including Checkout.com, Twilio, Braze and hotel booking systems

Responsibilities

Reliability & Uptime

Define and track reliability targets (SLAs/SLOs) for our core flows: bookings, ride matching and payments.
Set up and run the incident process and on-call, and reduce recovery times.
Improve monitoring and alerting across the platform (New Relic, Rollbar).

Performance, Scalability & Data

Lead architecture decisions for scaling our backend systems and services.
Find and fix performance bottlenecks across the application, background jobs and database.
Improve the performance of our large, fast-growing PostgreSQL database:
tune slow queries and indexes
plan data growth and archiving
manage replication, backups and restore drills
change large tables without downtime

Make sure the platform handles peak season and partner growth smoothly.

Infrastructure, Security & Compliance

Define and evolve our infrastructure strategy on Azure, and balance performance, reliability and cost.
Define and enforce security best practices: access control, secrets management, and the security of our build and release pipeline.
Prepare the platform for compliance: payment-data rules (PCI), GDPR, and over time SOC 2 / ISO 27001.

Developer Experience

Improve internal tooling, CI/CD and deployment workflows so engineers can ship faster and safer.

Technical Roadmap & Collaboration

Keep the backlog of technical work (upgrades, technical debt, performance, security) organised and ranked in Jira, and prioritise it together with the Product Manager.
Write technical docs, runbooks and development plans, and break them into Jira tickets with clear requirements.
Participate in team ceremonies (grooming, planning, kick-off meetings, retrospectives & demos).

Requirements

8+ years of software engineering experience, with strong backend and systems experience.
BS/MS degree in Computer Science or a related subject.
Proven experience operating and scaling production systems.

Technical Skills
Strong understanding of system design, distributed systems and performance trade-offs.
Strong PostgreSQL skills on large databases: query and index tuning, replication, large-table migrations, backups.
Experience with cloud infrastructure (Azure preferred), Docker and infrastructure-as-code.
Experience with Redis, Elasticsearch and a message broker (RabbitMQ or similar) at production scale.
Experience with observability, monitoring and incident management.
Strong security fundamentals: access control, networking, secrets.
CI/CD experience, including zero-downtime deploys.
Organised and a clear writer, comfortable working in Jira.
A hands-on mindset: able to go from strategy to implementation.

Additional experience considered a plus
Experience with Ruby on Rails, Sidekiq, Puma and PostGIS, or similar.
Exposure to compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001).
Experience with AWS or Google Cloud alongside Azure.
Experience moving a long-running application to containers or Kubernetes.
A travel, mobility or marketplace background with real-time operations.

The tools you need to perform your daily tasks successfully

jobs.description:
Join Proton and build a better internet where privacy is the default

Proton was founded in 2014 by scientists from CERN on a simple truth: privacy is a fundamental human right
. Since then, we’ve built the world’s largest encrypted email service (Proton Mail) and expanded into Proton VPN, Proton Drive, Proton Pass, and Proton Calendar, tools used by millions globally to protect their freedom, fight censorship, and keep their data safe. In some situations, Proton has literally helped save lives.

We are profitable and independent with no VC control. Our 500+ team members across 50+ countries come from leading organizations and elite academic backgrounds. We move fast, keep hierarchy light, and prioritize impact over optics. If you want to do meaningful work with exceptionally high-caliber people, this is it. Join us and do work you can truly be proud of. Check our open-source projects here!

The role:

As an engineer on our small Windows VPN team, you will be responsible for designing, building, maintaining, and evolving Proton’s applications on Windows. You will be involved in the entire application lifecycle, from feature design and implementation to CI/CD configuration, deployment, monitoring, and operational incident response. You will collaborate closely with product managers and engineers across the company to deliver privacy‑preserving products used by millions of people worldwide.

Our codebase is primarily written in .NET and WinUI (C#/XAML), and we are building and integrating cross‑platform logical core libraries written in Rust.

Software quality is central to this role. You will help define, maintain, and improve our testing stack, which includes unit tests, integration tests, and automated GUI tests (using FlaUI).

What we are looking for:

Strong experience in C# and .NET development.
Strong experience building and maintaining Windows desktop applications using frameworks such as WinUI, WPF, or similar.
Solid understanding of MVVM architecture, dependency injection, asynchronous programming (async/await), and event‑based messaging patterns.
Proven ability to write maintainable, well‑tested, and scalable codebases.
Demonstrated experience driving change within an organization and leading complex technical projects
A strong understanding of software architecture and engineering best practices.
An appreciation for user experience and design quality.
Rust experience is not required but is a significant plus.
Working knowledge of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, routing concepts) and an interest in VPN technologies and protocols.
Experience with code debugging, profiling, and performance optimization on Windows.
Familiarity with Git-based workflows, CI/CD pipelines (GitLab) and modern collaborative development practices.
Experience with gradual rollout, and observability tooling (telemetry, metrics, monitoring and alerting).

Even if you don’t meet every requirement listed above, if you’re passionate about privacy and believe you could be a great fit, we encourage you to apply.

What We Offer

Work that Matters: millions of people trust Proton with their privacy. We answer only to our users — not advertisers, not investors with conflicting agendas, not governments. The work you do here is real, and the impact is measurable. (read more about our impact here)
A great Team: Our team is diverse, collaborative, and tight-knit with people coming from all walks of life, including many of the world’s top academic institutions and organizations, such as MIT, Harvard, Stanford, Caltech, Cambridge, and ETH.
Technology: you'll get the right hardware and the right software you need to do your best work.
Learning & Development: we invest in your growth because sharp people make us better. Proton is one of the fastest ways to accelerate your career because you'll be thrown into real challenges, with real ownership, from day one.
Employee Benefits: your wellbeing isn't an afterthought. We offer strong health coverage, solid retirement options, generous leave, and wellness support so you can bring your best self to work every day
Stock Options: at Proton, we all have the opportunity to be owners of the company. From day one, you have a real stake in what we're building. When Proton wins, you win.
In-Person Collaboration: Amazing things happen when passionate, smart, and purposeful people get together in the same room. With offices across Geneva, Zürich, Barcelona, London and more, you'll spend most of your time collaborating face-to-face with people who genuinely care about what they're building
Food: Lunch and snacks are on us every day in our offices so you can focus on the work and not on what's for lunch.
Transport: getting to the office shouldn't cost you. We cover public transport, bike allowances, or parking, whichever works for you.
Flexible Working: you own your schedule. Set hours that work for you and your team — because outcomes matter more than when the clock says you started.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

At Proton, we believe diversity drives innovation and strengthens our mission to provide privacy as a default for all. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where all individuals, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, age, sexual orientation, physical ability, or socio-economic background, feel valued and empowered. We strive to create equal opportunities, promote open dialogue, and support continuous learning to ensure every voice is heard and respected.

If you need any extra support or reasonable adjustments during the hiring process, please let your talent partner know.

When you apply for a position, refer a candidate, or are considered for a role at Proton Technologies AG (Proton, we, us, or our), your information is stored in Greenhouse, in accordance with their Service Privacy Policy. This information is used to evaluate your suitability for the posted position. We also retain this information for consideration for future roles that you may apply for or that we believe may align with your background and skills.

If we no longer have a legitimate business need to process your information, we will either delete or anonymize it. Should you have any inquiries about how we use or manage your information, or if you wish to access, correct, or delete your data, please contact our privacy team at careers@proton.ch.

Proton does not accept unsolicited resumes from any sources other than directly from candidates. We will not pay a fee for any placement resulting from an unsolicited offer, even if the candidate is subsequently hired by Proton.
