jobs.title: Senior Product Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Join us at Wolters Kluwer and be part of a dynamic global technology company that makes a difference every day. We’re innovators with impact. We provide expert software and information solutions that the world’s leading professionals rely on, in the moments that matter most.

We are currently looking for a Senior Product Software Engineer
to join our team.

Mission:

Take your software engineering career to the next level as a Senior Product Software Engineer. You will play a key role in designing, developing, and troubleshooting software programs. Your technical skills and innovative mindset will contribute to the continuous improvement of our products, making a significant impact on user experience and satisfaction.

Responsibilities:

Software Development: Participate in designing, developing, and maintaining complex software applications to meet project requirements.
Design Collaboration: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define design specifications and details, taking into account diverse perspectives.
Effective Communication: Regularly communicate project updates, progress, and challenges to stakeholders and team members.
Technical Documentation: Prepare detailed technical specifications and requirements documents to guide the development process.
Performance Optimization: Identify bottlenecks and optimize software programs to improve overall performance and efficiency.
Application Design: Participate in the design of innovative and user-friendly software applications that align with customer needs and industry standards.
Testing Strategies: Create comprehensive testing routines and procedures to ensure the reliability and accuracy of software applications.
Applied Problem Solving: Utilize mathematical principles and statistical approaches to solve intricate problems in scientific or applied fields within software projects.
Issue Resolution: Collaborate with others to troubleshoot and resolve complex information technology issues that may arise during development.
Data Preparation: Prepare and preprocess data for analysis, ensuring its accuracy and readiness for use in software applications.
Technical Support: Provide technical support to end-users, including assistance with software maintenance, troubleshooting, and usage queries.

Skills:

Software Engineering: The ability to design, develop, and maintain software systems and applications by applying principles and techniques of computer science, engineering, and mathematical analysis. This includes the capacity to understand user requirements, create and test the software, and resolve any software-related issues.
Software Development: The ability to design, write, test, and implement software programs, applications, and systems. This includes understanding various programming languages, software architecture, and software testing methods. It also involves problem-solving capabilities to fix software issues and improve functionality.
Programming: The ability to design, write, test, debug, and maintain the instructions, also known as code, that a computer must follow to execute a task. This skill often involves various programming languages such as C# and Angular.
Problem Solving: The ability to understand a complex situation or issue and devise a solution by defining the problem, identifying potential strategies, and ultimately choosing and implementing the most effective course of action.
Analysis: The ability to examine complex situations or problems, break them down into smaller parts, and understand how these parts work together.
Testing: The skill of evaluating a system or process, often in software or product development. It involves the ability to identify problems, measure effectiveness, and ensure quality or functionality.
Agile: The ability to swiftly and effectively respond to changes, with an emphasis on continuous improvement and flexibility. In the context of project management, it denotes a methodology that promotes adaptive planning and encourages rapid and flexible responses to changes.
Source Code Repository: The ability to effectively use a source code repository, a file archive, and a web hosting facility where a large amount of source code, for software or for web pages, is kept, either publicly or privately. This skill involves the ability to manage and track changes to code, identify and fix issues, merge code from different branches, and collaborate with other developers.
Non-Relational Database: The ability to design, implement, and manipulate a non-relational database (MongoDB).
APIs: The ability to design, develop, and manage Application Programming Interfaces, which constitute the set of protocols and tools used for building application software. Technical Skills

You are familiar with front-end technologies, such as TypeScript, NodeJS, and React.

Soft Skills

Excellent communication and presentation skills in English, with the ability to clearly explain complex technical concepts to diverse stakeholders.
Strong collaboration skills to work effectively with product management, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams.

What’s Waiting For You

Work that matters

The technology we build at Materialise pushes the boundaries. You’ll find pride in building something that matters, whether you designed it, printed it, or shipped it. No matter your role, we unlock new possibilities to build a better and healthier world every day.

At Materialise, we expect you to think about the customer, not just the task. You push for better solutions and care about the difference your work makes.

When you join Materialise, you join a group of colleagues invested in you, not just your work. From your own team to a department across the world, you’ll find a sense of belonging with people who help without being asked, challenge you, and have your back.

At the same time, we expect you to invest in the people around you — not just your own work — to make the group stronger than the sum of its parts.

An environment of trust

At Materialise, we expect you to deliver on that trust and keep your commitments.

A career ready to build

When you see opportunities for your career to grow at Materialise, we encourage you to go for them. People shape a fulfilling career at their own pace here.

At Materialise, we expect you to take initiative in your own development. Don’t wait for someone else to plan your career. Step into the space and make it count.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Architect (Solution Architect)
jobs.description:
Sobre el puesto

Buscamos un/a Senior Technical Architect (Solution Architect) para incorporarse a un importante grupo internacional con sede en Madrid (modelo híbrido, 2 días/semana en oficina). Formarás parte del área de arquitectura, dando soporte a proyectos de transformación cloud, IA y sistemas agénticos, API management, seguridad IT y workplace, en un entorno multirregional y regulado.
Serás responsable de la arquitectura de solución de los proyectos asignados de principio a fin: desde la evaluación inicial hasta la implementación y la puesta en producción, asegurando que el diseño final sea coherente, seguro y alineado con los principios de arquitectura del grupo.
¿Qué harás?

Liderar las actividades de arquitectura de solución en proyectos y cambios relevantes, desde el assessment inicial hasta el production readiness
Clarificar alcance, drivers de negocio, restricciones, activos existentes, productos del grupo y principios de arquitectura con los stakeholders del proyecto
Elaborar vistas current-state, target-state y de transición adaptadas a cada proyecto
Definir componentes de aplicación, integraciones, APIs, flujos de datos, identidades, trust boundaries, modelo de despliegue y dependencias operativas
Identificar y documentar opciones de solución, trade-offs, costes, riesgos, deuda técnica y decisiones recomendadas
Definir requisitos no funcionales medibles junto a especialistas de seguridad, datos, infraestructura, DevOps, operaciones y negocio
Preparar dossiers de arquitectura y materiales para el Architecture Review Board / Design Authority, gestionando comentarios, ADRs y trazabilidad de acciones
Coordinar las aportaciones de los distintos especialistas y garantizar la coherencia end-to-end del diseño
Dar soporte a los equipos de desarrollo, integración, testing, release y cutover con guía de implementación
Revisar evidencias de implementación, excepciones y cambios as-built, escalando desviaciones relevantes a través de la gobernanza establecida
Diseñar remediaciones a nivel de proyecto cuando la deuda técnica o incumplimientos afecten a la solución
Entregar la arquitectura as-built y la información de traspaso a los equipos de aplicación, operaciones y repositorios
¿Qué buscamos?

Entre 8 y 15 años de experiencia en arquitectura de solución, arquitectura de aplicaciones o ingeniería de software senior, incluyendo al menos 5 años siendo responsable de diseños end-to-end llevados a implementación
Experiencia en arquitectura de solución end-to-end: aplicación, integración, datos, seguridad, cloud/infraestructura y operaciones
Capacidad para traducir requisitos funcionales y restricciones en una arquitectura implementable, con análisis de opciones y trade-offs documentados
Dominio de patrones de integración API, service-oriented y event-driven: contratos de interfaz, dependencias y flujos de datos
Experiencia en arquitectura de soluciones en Azure, incluyendo identidad y accesos (Entra ID, service principals, managed identities, RBAC, Key Vault)
Security by design: autenticación, autorización, gestión de secretos, cifrado, segmentación de red, logging y gestión de vulnerabilidades y amenazas
Definición de requisitos no funcionales: disponibilidad, resiliencia, rendimiento, escalabilidad, recuperabilidad, observabilidad y mantenibilidad
Conocimiento de DevOps y SDLC: Git, CI/CD, estrategia de entornos, infraestructura/configuración como código, testing y release readiness
Modelado y documentación de arquitectura: vistas de contexto, contenedores/componentes, integración, despliegue y secuencia
Capacidad para definir requisitos de production readiness y verificar que la solución entregada se mantiene alineada con la arquitectura aprobada
Se valorará

Ownership de arquitectura en proyectos complejos de aplicación o transformación en grandes organizaciones
Experiencia en seguros, servicios financieros u otros entornos regulados
Preparación y defensa de dossiers de arquitectura ante un Design Authority o Architecture Review Board
Integración de cloud, SaaS, productos de grupo y sistemas on-premise en entornos multi-equipo o multi-proveedor
Nivel de inglés profesional, imprescindible
Disponibilidad para acudir a la oficina de Madrid 2 días/semana
¿Qué ofrecemos?

✅ Horario flexible
✅ Modelo de trabajo híbrido, favoreciendo el equilibrio entre vida personal y profesional
✅ Salario competitivo y plan de retribución flexible
✅ Seguro médico privado
✅ Presupuesto anual para formación y desarrollo profesional
✅ Cursos de idiomas
✅ Participación en comunidades tecnológicas y eventos del sector
✅ Seguimiento continuo y acompañamiento profesional
✅ Plan de desarrollo y crecimiento adaptado a tus objetivos
Sobre nosotros

En InnoIT creemos que el talento se desarrolla en un entorno donde aprender, innovar y disfrutar del camino van de la mano.
🚀 Únete a nuestro equipo, participa en proyectos innovadores y sigue creciendo junto a profesionales apasionados por la tecnología.
Más info:
👉 https://www.inno-it.es/
👉 InnoIT Consulting Barcelona Meetup: https://www.meetup.com/es-ES/Meetup-de-InnoIT-Consulting-en-Barcelona/
👉 InnoIT Consulting Madrid Meetup: https://www.meetup.com/es-ES/meetup-de-innoit-consulting-en-madrid/
Diversidad, Equidad e Inclusión

En InnoIT promovemos activamente la diversidad, la equidad y la inclusión. Damos la bienvenida a personas con todo tipo de perfiles, experiencias y trayectorias profesionales, y fomentamos especialmente la participación de colectivos tradicionalmente infrarrepresentados en el sector tecnológico. Evaluamos todas las candidaturas de manera objetiva y justa, garantizando la igualdad de oportunidades durante todo el proceso de selección. Asimismo, nos comprometemos a realizar los ajustes razonables necesarios para asegurar una experiencia accesible e inclusiva.
No discriminamos por razón de género, edad, origen, nacionalidad, orientación sexual, identidad o expresión de género, religión, discapacidad o cualquier otra condición protegida por la legislación vigente. Trabajamos para construir un entorno laboral diverso, respetuoso e inclusivo, donde todas las personas tengan las mismas oportunidades de crecimiento, desarrollo y reconocimiento profesional.
Si te apasiona diseñar arquitecturas end-to-end que conectan negocio y tecnología, y quieres tener un rol clave en la transformación cloud e IA de una organización internacional, ¡queremos conocerte!

jobs.title: Solution Engineer
jobs.description:
Company Description

Creating a future worth living for future generations gets us out of bed every morning. Depending on the project, we are consultants, implementers, or both for sustainable, innovative and economical solutions for real estate, industry, energy and infrastructure. Our more than 6,500 employees at over 80 locations worldwide support our customers in interdisciplinary teams. Our thinking is both visionary and realistic. We work independently and as part of a team. With passion and the latest technologies. We unite. Join us at Dreso and let’s create a world we want to live in.

Job Description

We help our clients turn data into measurable value. From data platforms and analytics to AI-powered applications, we develop smart solutions for complex projects across industry, real estate, and infrastructure.

As a Solution Engineer
, you play a key role at the interface between our clients, solution architects, and product developers. You translate business needs into viable data and AI solutions, guide their implementation, and make sure they deliver real value in client projects.

Your Responsibilities

Act as the trusted point of contact for clients on Smart, Data & AI topics, from first needs assessment through to solution rollout.
Analyze business processes and translate client requirements into functional and technical requirements, use cases, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
Work with solution architects to design data architectures, data models, analytics solutions, and AI use cases that fit the client's context.
Support the implementation of data, analytics, and AI solutions together with developers, architects, and data engineers.
Assess requirements against existing standard solutions, configuration options, and the need for new development.
Plan and facilitate workshops, demos, user acceptance tests, and solution validations with clients and project teams.
Support clients with adoption, training, and change management activities and feed project learnings back into solution development.
Communicate complex technical and analytical topics clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of Smart, Data & AI offerings, methodologies, and best practices.
Take ownership beyond advisory services by actively leading and supporting the delivery and deployment of solutions, ensuring concepts are successfully translated into operational outcomes for clients.

Qualifications

Completed degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Data Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a comparable qualification.
At least 5 years of professional experience in consulting, business analysis, solution engineering, or solution design within data, analytics, or AI-related projects.
Proven experience working in a client-facing role between business stakeholders and technical teams.
Strong understanding of data platforms, data modeling, ETL/ELT processes, analytics solutions, BI concepts, and the fundamentals of machine learning and generative AI.
Experience in requirements engineering, process analysis, user stories, acceptance criteria, and workshop facilitation.
Familiarity with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.
Understanding of data governance, security, roles, and permission concepts.
Hands-on experience with Python, SQL, data analysis, or AI technologies is considered a strong advantage.
Strong analytical thinking, a structured approach to problem-solving, and the confidence to challenge requirements constructively.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills in English and German.

Additional Information

To ensure your work-life balance, we offer the option of mobile working
We promote your professional and personal development through individual training and further education at the Drees & Sommer Academy
We support your health with a bonus for sports enthusiasts. We offer the possibility of subscribing to a private health insurance policy
Employees benefit from tax advantages related to their commuting expenses for the office
Fiscal advantages for employees expenses in meal costs during worktime. Employee referral program with attractive bonus scheme
Supporting career and family by receiving tax benefits for kindergarten expenses

jobs.title: WinCC Platform Engineer - Siemens WinCC / Industrial Automation - Pharma Sector
jobs.description:
Can you imagine defining the global architecture behind industrial HMI platforms used across manufacturing environments? 🏭🌍

Join our expert team to work on a Pharmaceutical Manufacturing program, contributing to the development and standardization of global industrial automation platform services.

You will apply your knowledge of Siemens WinCC Unified, UMC and Active Directory
to build secure, scalable and supportable OT architectures across multiple manufacturing environments.

At ERNI, you are never just a number. Even if you work on an external project, you will feel part of the team and always supported.

How do we make this happen? 🤔

With people. Besides your team and manager, you will have several support figures like a godparent, who will help you with the practical and administrative aspects of daily life during your first 6 months.

And the second most important person after you, your mentor, who will guide you through your entire onboarding and career at ERNI. You will have regular 1:1 meetings with them, and recurrently, you will work on your development plan to define your short-, medium-, and long-term goals.

At ERNI, we highly value experience and technical knowledge. As a senior profile, you will have the space to continue growing, whether by deepening your technical skills or having greater influence on project decisions, with autonomy and the opportunity to share knowledge with other experts.

And if you are interested in mentoring, there is also space for that: supporting other ERNIans while still focusing on the technical excellence that sets us apart.

What You Will Bring 🤝

Knowledge of Siemens WinCC Unified Engineering, Unified Runtime and Unified PC Runtime.
Strong hands-on experience with UMC, UMC Ring Server architectures and centralized user management.
Experience integrating Microsoft Active Directory and troubleshooting authentication, Kerberos, LDAP, certificates and PKI.
Strong knowledge of Windows Server, industrial networking and secure OT architectures.
Experience defining engineering standards, platform architectures and migration strategies for industrial HMI environments.

You will be responsible for designing, implementing and continuously improving standardized WinCC Unified platform architectures. You will deploy and support UMC Ring Server infrastructures, integrate centralized identity services and resolve complex infrastructure and authentication issues. You will also define engineering standards and support migrations from legacy HMI platforms and MTP-based automation architectures.

What if the project ends?😅

We work on a wide variety of projects, technologies, and sectors, allowing you to keep growing in different environments. If a project ends or you feel ready for a new challenge, we will find another one that aligns with your professional development.

Our working model 👩‍🔬

We ask you to be available for key meetings. Need to leave for a doctor’s appointment or to pick up your child from school? No problem. We trust you to deliver quality work within your 40-hour workweek.

Our model is hybrid: we usually go to the office 2 days a week, though this depends on the project and team, but we love seeing each other’s faces; the best stories always happen in the office!

You Will Also Enjoy

🎓 We cover your certifications and reward technical achievements up to €1,500.

🏥 Private health insurance.

💯 Full coverage for sick leave

🧘‍♀️ Free emotional, legal, and family support.

🏋️‍♀️ Gym discounts or sports compensation.

💳 Flexible remuneration: meals, transport, childcare, etc.

🤝 Referral bonuses: up to €6,000 per candidate and €5,000 per client.

🌴 23 working days of vacation.

🗣️ Free language courses: English, Spanish, Catalan and German.

And the salary? 💸

We will discuss it during the first call. If it is important to you, feel free to ask! 💬

In addition, we provide products and services to protect life’s other most important assets: our homes and digital identities. Today, Solera processes over 300 million digital transactions annually for approximately 235,000 partners and customers in more than 90 countries. Our 6,500 team members foster an uncommon, innovative culture and are dedicated to successfully bringing the future to bear today through cognitive answers, insights, algorithms and automation. For more information, please visit solera.com.

The Role

The Senior Engineer role will play a crucial part in Solera’s day-to-day operations and initiatives. The successful candidate will possess a deep level of technical experience surrounding identity and access management, focused on production application services support, including Windows and Linux Operating systems, and various proprietary software platforms. While the role is very certainly one that centralizes around management, deep technical experience, and repeated examples of success in a senior level technical position are required for success.

What You’ll Do

Work on a support team supporting application products gobally.

Responsible for the monitoring, measuring, performance, availability, security, recovery, and throughput of application services.

Provide 24x7 On-call support on a rotational basis and effectively diagnose / triage / fix systems during outages.

Ensure design, infrastructure, process/operational documentation is up-to-date.

Facilitate production deployments.

What You’ll Bring

A passion for excellence in delivery of service to customers and colleagues alike

A drive to improve operational processes and procedures.

Strong familiarity with broad range of technologies: Windows/Linux, multi-tier web applications, middleware (web/app servers, containers, message queues, etc), containers, databases, networking, Citrix/VDI, etc

Strong affinity to automate repetitive tasks, leaning out processes that drive down outages and deliver quick results.

Familiarity with Public & Private Cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP), VMware virtualized systems environments.

Knowledgeable of source control management and CI/CD.

Good understanding of application architecture, databases, knowledge of java, .net, python preferred.

Networking architecture understanding (F5, haproxy)

jobs.description:
Who We Are

Solera is a global leader in data and software services that strives to transform every touchpoint of the vehicle lifecycle into a connected digital experience. In addition, we provide products and services to protect life’s other most important assets: our homes and digital identities. Today, Solera processes over 300 million digital transactions annually for approximately 235,000 partners and customers in more than 90 countries. Our 6,500 team members foster an uncommon, innovative culture and are dedicated to successfully bringing the future to bear today through cognitive answers, insights, algorithms and automation. For more information, please visit solera.com.

The Role

We are looking for an experienced Software Development Manager who can act as a strong leader and provide guidance to multiple squads of Software Development Engineers. Our Manager will have a passion for building complex web and enterprise applications. As the leader of the squads, you will be creating clear objectives and deliverables with an emphasis on scalability, maintainability, security, and performance. Solera needs a leader that can ensure high-quality applications and on-time delivery of software that supports our growing business. Our innovative leader will work in an Agile environment that mentors and fosters team collaboration.

What You’ll Do

Lead multiple software development squads toward the best technical solution for functionalities required within the product.
Define expectations and develop metrics to monitor results.
Troubleshoot and resolve the team’s technical impediments.
Provide leadership, direction, and guidance to the team.
Coach, train and provide regular feedback to the team.
Coordinate with other Dev Managers and the Architecture Team when defining new designs and solutions.
Suggest initiatives to improve current processes and technologies.
Analyze system specifications and translate system requirements to manageable & measurable tasks
Identify and correct code smells, eliminate bugs and fix technical bottlenecks
Help maintain code quality, organization, and architecture
Perform code reviews to improve team code writing
Coordinate with Engineering leadership, Product Management, Agile and Design Teams
Coordinate team deployments and setup/maintain CICD pipelines

What You’ll Bring

5 years of experience in hands on Software Development life cycle: Coding, peer reviewing attending production issues.
Minimum 3 years of Management/Technical Lead experience.
Java, REST, SOAP, Performance tuning of Applications.
Prior work experience in and understanding of Agile.
Strong knowledge on CI/CD tools and workflows.
Experience in Agentic AI tooling in the development process preferred but not required
Domain-Driven Design and Micro-service architectures.
SQL Server, NoSQL, ang/or Oracle Databases.
API design
Strong knowledge in Business-Driven Design and Test Driven Development.
Developing middleware applications using a variety of modern technologies with relational, non-relational data bases and cloud hosted applications.
Performance engineering and educating teams on non-functional requirements to achieve web-scale
Middleware and Security experience, fixing vulnerabilities.
A strong background in the PaaS space preferred.

jobs.description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.

Job Summary

We’re building foundational infrastructure to secure AI agents—including their identities, access patterns, and interactions with sensitive systems and data.

This includes designing intelligent, dynamic mechanisms for ephemeral access control, secrets management, and agent and user identity tailored to the

modern agent ecosystem.

As a Principal Engineer, you’ll take ownership of these critical systems, designing and implementing how agents establish identity, receive dynamic access,

securely interact with sensitive systems, and leave verifiable audit trails. You’ll shape the long-term architecture, anticipate technical risks, and evolve

systems that span both machine- and human-facing workflows.

This is a rare opportunity to combine hands-on engineering with technical leadership—writing critical code, mentoring engineers, sharing knowledge, and

driving best practices—while building a platform from the ground up at the cutting edge of AI, identity, and security.

Responsibilities

Own and guide the technical direction of core platform domains, including agent identity, authentication, authorization, and secrets management,
shaping architectures that span multiple services and teams while balancing scalability, reliability, and security.
Lead by example through high-impact implementation, mentoring engineers, and helping them navigate complex technical tradeoffs.
Proactively identify critical technical problems or gaps, and drive solutions from concept through delivery.
Establish and promote engineering best practices, ensuring high standards for code quality, security, and operational excellence.
Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to engineers, architects, product managers, and stakeholders, influencing decisions, fostering
alignment, and driving cross-team collaboration.
Document key decisions, patterns, and practices to elevate team knowledge and ensure consistency across the platform.
Advocate for continuous improvement and operational efficiency, helping the team work smarter while maintaining a secure, high-quality platform.

Qualifications

You bring 8+ years of experience in backend and systems with a track record of owning large-scale or security-critical systems end-to-end.
You’ve designed and operated distributed, cloud-based architectures that are secure, scalable, and reliable, and you’re comfortable working with AWS, GCP, or Azure.
You have experience or a strong interest in identity, authentication, authorization, and secrets management, and you’re excited to apply these principles to AI and agent frameworks—this will give you an edge.

jobs.description:
About The Team

Breakneck Studio
– an incubator and accelerator scaling digital and e-commerce brands at high velocity. It’s home to our Co-Found program, where ambitious founders take products from zero to market in months, not years. This is where you get hands-on, zero-to-scale experience you won’t find in a regular job.

We are looking

We are a fast-scaling travel startup with strong product-market fit, a generational traveltech company looking to disturb this sleepy industry. We are two-sided: travelers get a consumer product that helps them plan and book trips, and advisors get a SaaS-style subscription with certification and qualified leads in the offer.

We’re looking for the first developers to join a fast-growing travel startup that’s already found strong product-market fit and is now ready to scale.

This is not a role for someone who wants to manage agencies, coordinate stakeholders, or spend weeks building presentations. We’re looking for a builder – someone who can design a schema for breakfast, build a sandbox environment for lunch, load test it before dinner, and wake up excited to get it ready for prod the upcoming week.

You’ll work directly with the founder and early team, own growth from day one, and help shape what the product looks like as the company scales. Work-life balance can look different in a fast-moving company that’s on a mission to make a real impact.

Ready to apply?

Jump to the application form and start your journey with us.

Apply Now

Get ready to

Design, build, and own integrations with third-party booking systems such as suppliers, booking platforms, and partner APIs, covering everything from modern REST/OAuth APIs to legacy SOAP services.
Architect the webhook ingestion and worker queue infrastructure that keeps bookings, availability, and status updates flowing reliably at scale.
Design database schemas in Supabase (PostgreSQL) that model complex booking data cleanly and hold up as volume grows.
Build sandbox and testing environments so integrations can be developed, validated, and debugged safely before they reach production.
Load test and harden services, finding bottlenecks and failure points before customers do.
Take integrations from prototype to production: monitoring, alerting, retries, idempotency, and graceful handling of flaky third-party systems.

Strong software engineering fundamentals, with deep experience in Authentication & Identity and Backend Software Engineering (PostgreSQL, PHP/Laravel, Node.js/TypeScript).
Expert-level understanding of API authentication across many integration styles, including:
OAuth 2.0 (authorization code, client credentials, PKCE, refresh token rotation) and OIDC
SOAP APIs, including WS-Security, XML signatures and certificate-based authentication
REST API auth patterns such as API keys, HMAC request signing, JWT and mutual TLS

Proven experience designing secure, scalable webhook systems: signature verification, idempotency, replay protection, deduplication, ordering, rate limiting and dead-letter handling.
Hands-on experience building asynchronous job processing with AWS SQS workers, Temporal workflows, or an equivalent durable execution or queue system, including retries, backoff and failure recovery.
Experience integrating with a wide variety of third-party systems, including poorly documented or legacy APIs, and building abstractions that make new integrations faster to add.
Secure handling of credentials and secrets at scale, such as token storage, encryption, rotation and per-tenant isolation.
Strong TypeScript skills, as it is the team’s primary development language.
Solid grasp of engineering best practices, automation and observability, using tools such as Datadog for monitoring and alerting on integration health.
Comfortable in an agile, collaborative environment, communicating clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including external partners’ engineering teams.

For our Vilnius office, we follow a 4 days onsite, 1 day remote
hybrid model. For roles based outside Vilnius, the work arrangement -onsite, hybrid, or remote-depends on the specific position.

Drive global impact

jobs.title: Solutions Developer
jobs.description:
About Mixvoip
We are Mixvoip, a Luxembourg-based company providing Cloud Telephony, Connectivity, Cybersecurity, and Managed IT Services to businesses and public organizations.
We design, operate, and support many of our solutions ourselves. When we see an inefficient process, a missing integration, or an opportunity to create a better customer experience, we like to build something that solves it.
That’s where you come in.
About the role
You will join Mixvoip’s IT Services team as a Solutions Developer.
Your role sits between software development, infrastructure, automation, and product design.
You will build internal tools that make our teams more efficient, automate repetitive processes, connect systems through APIs, and contribute to customer-facing products.
Projects can be very different from one another. You might build a small automation in Python, a backend service in Rust or C#, a React interface, an integration between several platforms, or a complete solution combining software, infrastructure, authentication, APIs, and physical devices.
We are therefore not looking for someone attached to one specific framework.
We are looking for someone who can understand a problem, choose an appropriate technical approach, prototype quickly, and turn the result into something secure, reliable, understandable, and maintainable.
AI-assisted development is part of how we work. You should be comfortable using coding assistants and development agents such as Codex, Claude, or similar tools to explore codebases, build features, refactor, test, document, and accelerate development.
The important part is not how much code AI can generate for you. It is whether you understand what is being built and remain responsible for the architecture, security, quality, and operation of the final solution.
Key responsibilities
Design and develop internal applications, automation, and operational tools

Contribute to customer-facing products and new commercial solutions

Translate operational or business needs into practical software solutions

Prototype ideas quickly and turn successful prototypes into production-ready systems

Work across technologies such as Rust, Python, C#, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Vite, and similar tools

Build and integrate APIs, webhooks, databases, internal systems, and third-party services

Design frontend, backend, and service components when required

Apply appropriate software architecture and design patterns without unnecessary complexity

Implement authentication, authorization, and secure handling of application data

Write maintainable, testable, and understandable code

Review both human-written and AI-generated code critically

Build automated tests and contribute to CI/CD and deployment processes

Deploy and operate applications in Linux, Windows, containerized, cloud, or on-premises environments

Troubleshoot across application and infrastructure layers, including logs, networking, databases, APIs, permissions, and services

Implement appropriate logging, monitoring, and health checks

Document architecture, dependencies, APIs, deployment procedures, and important technical decisions

Identify manual or repetitive work that could be simplified through software or automation

Work closely with systems engineers, network engineers, support teams, and other colleagues across Mixvoip

What do we need from you?
Strong software development fundamentals

Professional experience building applications, tools, automation, platforms, or software products

Experience with more than one programming language or technology stack

Strong knowledge of at least one backend language such as Rust, Python, C#, or similar

Experience with modern web development using TypeScript, React, Next.js, Vite, or comparable technologies

Good understanding of APIs, HTTP, authentication, webhooks, databases, and system integrations

Good understanding of software architecture and common design patterns

Experience with Git, code reviews, testing, and collaborative development workflows

Good understanding of application security

Good infrastructure fundamentals, including networking, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, operating systems, permissions, and reverse proxies

Comfortable working with Linux and the command line

Familiarity with containers and modern deployment practices

Strong experience using AI coding assistants and development agents in real development work

Ability to review AI-generated solutions critically and recognize when they are incorrect, insecure, or unnecessarily complex

Ability to learn unfamiliar technologies quickly

Good documentation habits

Professional proficiency in English

You do not need to be an expert in every technology we use.
Strong fundamentals, adaptability, and good engineering judgment matter more to us than knowing a specific framework by heart.
What would make you stand out?
Experience with Rust, Python, C#, or .NET

Advanced TypeScript and React experience

Experience building internal tools or operational platforms

Experience turning manual business processes into software and automation

Experience developing customer-facing software products

Experience integrating hardware, meeting room equipment, embedded devices, or IoT systems

Experience with PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Redis, message queues, or event-driven architectures

Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, or infrastructure-as-code

Experience operating applications in both cloud and on-premises environments

Knowledge of OAuth2, OpenID Connect, SAML, LDAP, Active Directory, or Entra ID

Experience integrating Microsoft 365, Teams, Exchange, calendars, or meeting room technologies

Good understanding of enterprise IT infrastructure and networking

Experience with monitoring, observability, secrets management, and secure software development

Contributions to open-source projects or personal technical projects

French, German, and/or Luxembourgish

Why Mixvoip?
At Mixvoip, you will work on software that solves real problems.
An internal tool might remove hours of repetitive work every week. An integration might eliminate an entire manual process. A prototype might become a product offered to our customers.
You will work close to the people who use what you build, and across telecom, cloud, networking, cybersecurity, managed IT, software, and sometimes hardware.
This also means you can work on a solution end to end: from the initial idea and architecture to the code, infrastructure, deployment, and operation.
We encourage experimentation and rapid prototyping, while expecting production systems to be secure, reliable, and maintainable.
You will have freedom in how you solve problems, together with responsibility for the technical decisions you make.
A new way to apply: Join Mixvoip’s success story
We would like to see more than your CV.
Record a brief video with your smartphone and tell us about something you have built. It can be a commercial product, an internal tool, an automation, a personal project, or something completely different.
Tell us what problem you were trying to solve, how you approached it, and what technical decisions you made.
Please remember to attach your CV in PDF format too.
Instead of a conventional motivational letter, we would also like you to use an AI tool of your choice.
For this role, show us how you use an AI coding assistant or development agent to solve a technical problem. We are interested in how you guide the tool, what you verify yourself, and how you apply your own engineering judgment.
PS: Want to know who you’ll be working with? Meet me, Antoine CAVELIER
I’ve been with Mixvoip for 8 years, and my role is to help businesses make better use of their IT.
With the IT Consulting team, we support customers who often have very different realities. Some have an internal IT department and need a reliable technical partner. Others rely on us for almost everything related to their infrastructure, users, security, cloud services, networks, and day-to-day IT operations.
That variety is what makes this job interesting. One day, you may be working on Microsoft 365. Another day, you may be helping with virtualization, servers, storage, backups, Wi-Fi, Linux systems, scripts, migrations, or a customer project that does not fit neatly into one category.
I like people who are curious, structured, and honest about what they know and what they still need to learn. In consulting, nobody knows everything. What matters is the ability to understand the problem, ask the right questions, investigate properly, communicate clearly, and take ownership until things move forward.
I care a lot about practical solutions. Our customers are SMEs. They need systems that work, advice they can understand, and partners they can trust. Good consulting is not only about technical knowledge. It is also about listening, explaining, documenting, prioritizing, and staying calm when something goes wrong.
I also believe that modern IT work should make good use of the right tools, including AI. Not to replace thinking, but to speed up research, scripting, documentation, troubleshooting, and daily operations.
If you enjoy broad technical challenges, customer contact, autonomy, terminal work, small automation tasks, and the idea of helping many different businesses improve their IT step by step, then you could be a great fit for the team.

new_jobs.location: Landau in der Pfalz, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany
new_jobs.description:
Role Overview

So arbeiten wir – bitte aufmerksam lesen

Diese Stelle passt nicht zu jedem, und das ist Absicht. Damit du einschätzen kannst, ob sie zu dir passt:

Du baust die Schienen, nicht nur die Züge. Während die anderen KI-Rollen an konkreten Use-Cases arbeiten, verantwortest du das Querschnittliche: Infrastruktur, Frameworks, wiederverwendbare Bausteine, Guardrails. Deine Arbeit zahlt sich darin aus, dass andere schneller und sicherer liefern können.
Effizienz ist dein ständiger Maßstab. KI-Consumption – Token, Compute, API-Kosten – wächst schnell und unbemerkt. Du behältst sie im Blick, triffst fundierte Make-or-Buy-Entscheidungen (lokal vs. Cloud, selbst bauen vs. einkaufen) und kannst sie begründen.
Du wirst öfter "nein" sagen als "ja". Nicht jede schöne Idee braucht eigene Infrastruktur, und nicht jedes Modell muss selbst gehostet werden. Du erkennst, wann der pragmatische Weg der bessere ist – und vertrittst das auch gegenüber begeisterten Kolleginnen und Kollegen.
Jedes Teammitglied handelt sehr autonom. Du setzt dir deinen eigenen Maßstab und prüfst deine eigenen Ergebnisse kritisch, bevor jemand anderes es tut. Austausch und Feedback gibt es selbstverständlich – aber die Qualitätssicherung deiner Arbeit beginnt bei dir.
Du bist der Spezialist für dein Gebiet. Unser Team ist bewusst interdisziplinär aufgestellt, mit kaum Überlappungen zwischen den Disziplinen. Du hast Spezialisten für Frontend, Backend, UX und KI-Anwendungen an deiner Seite – aber Plattform, Betrieb und Effizienz sind dein Feld, und du verantwortest es fachlich selbst.
Wir entwickeln AI-gestützt – konsequent. Tools wie Claude Code oder Cursor sind bei uns Alltag, nicht Experiment. Das verschiebt den Schwerpunkt der Arbeit: weniger Code selbst tippen, mehr Architektur vorgeben und Ergebnisse kritisch prüfen. Du musst nicht jede Zeile selbst geschrieben haben – aber du stehst für jede Zeile gerade, die du ablieferst.
Wöchentliche Freiräume sind fest eingeplant – rund 10 % deiner Arbeitszeit. Zeit für fachliche Weiterentwicklung, eigene Ideen und kreativen Austausch ist bei uns Teil der Arbeitswoche – kein Nice-to-have, das im Tagesgeschäft verdampft.
Ergebnisgetrieben und prozessual schlank. Wir brauchen schnelle, pragmatische Lösungen, die im Alltag funktionieren – keine über Monate ausgefeilten 100%-Systeme. Die Plattform wächst mit den realen Bedürfnissen, nicht mit theoretischen.

Wenn du am produktivsten bist, wenn dir jemand eine fertige Architektur und ein abgestecktes Backlog vorlegt, wirst du bei uns nicht glücklich. Wenn dich reizt, ein Fundament aus dem Nichts zu bauen, auf dem andere aufbauen – dann lies weiter.

Unser Stack

Wir implementieren produktnah überwiegend in C# / .NET. Python nutzen wir, wo es sinnvoll ist – für Prototypen, KI-spezifische Werkzeuge, Datenarbeit und Tooling. Der Schwerpunkt liegt aber klar auf C#. Unsere Frontends bauen wir in React – für diese Rolle kein Muss, aber nützlich. Für KI-Betrieb und -Infrastruktur erwarten wir Vertrautheit mit gängigen Inferenz- und Orchestrierungs-Frameworks sowie mit Containerisierung.

Your Tasks

Die technische Plattform für unsere KI-Anwendungen konzipieren, aufbauen und betreiben: Modell-Hosting, Inferenz, API-Gateways/Routing, wiederverwendbare Bausteine
Lokale / self-hosted LLMs evaluieren, einrichten und betreiben – inklusive Quantisierung, GPU-Dimensionierung und Performance
KI-Consumption und -Kosten transparent machen und aktiv steuern; fundierte Make-or-Buy- und Lokal-vs.-Cloud-Entscheidungen treffen und begründen
Frameworks, Tools und Standards für das Team auswählen und etablieren – Guardrails, die KI-Entwicklung schneller und sicherer machen
Erfolgreiche Prototypen der anderen KI-Rollen in einen tragfähigen, betreibbaren Zustand bringen – bis hin zur Übergabe an R&D oder in den produktiven Betrieb
CI/CD, Monitoring und Betriebsthemen für KI-Lösungen verantworten
Ergebnisse und Empfehlungen gegenüber Fach- und Business-Teams präsentieren – auf dem jeweiligen technischen Niveau deines Gegenübers

Your Profile

Tiefes Veständnis und praktische Erfahrung im Betrieb von KI-/LLM-Anwendungen in einem Unternehmen: Inferenz-Frameworks (z. B. vLLM, Ollama, llama.cpp, TGI), API-Gateways/Routing (z. B. LiteLLM), RAG- und Embedding-Infrastruktur
Operative, im Unternehmenskontext angewandte Erfahrung mit lokalen Modellen / Self-Hosting von LLMs – inklusive Quantisierung und Ressourcendimensionierung
Mehrjährige, fundierte praktische Erfahrung innerhalb eines Unternehmens in der Entwicklung von Softwarelösungen, davon ein solider Teil in C# / .NET – mit erkennbarer technischer Tiefe
Erfahrung mit Containerisierung (Docker), CI/CD und Betriebsthemen
Ein waches Auge für Kosten und Effizienz – du kannst KI-Consumption messen, einordnen und optimieren
Gute Übersicht über aktuelle Trends, verfügbare Off-the-shelf-Lösungen und neue Entwicklungen im KI-Umfeld – du weißt, wann man baut und wann man kauft
Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (Teamsprache ist Deutsch) und gute Englischkenntnisse
Überwiegende Arbeit im Homeoffice, Bereitschaft zu regelmäßigen Reisen in unser HQ in Landau (ca. 5–10 % der Arbeitszeit)

Must have

Praktische Erfahrung innerhalb eines Unternehmens mit lokalen Modellen / Self-Hosting von LLMs – inklusive Quantisierung und Ressourcendimensionierung
Praktische Erfahrung innerhalb eines Unternehmens im Betrieb von KI-/LLM-Anwendungen: Inferenz-Frameworks (z. B. vLLM, Ollama, llama.cpp, TGI), API-Gateways/Routing (z. B. LiteLLM), RAG- und Embedding-Infrastruktur
Erfahrung mit Containerisierung (Docker), CI/CD und Betriebsthemen
Du kannst "nein" sagen, ohne Türen zu schließen und ein Scheitern eingestehen, auch wenn du schon Aufwand investiert hast

Nice to have

Erfahrung in der fachlichen Führung oder Anleitung von Entwicklern
Gute Python-Kenntnisse für Tooling und Prototyping
Erfahrung mit Datenaufbereitung und -pipelines (ETL/ELT)
React / moderne Web-Frontends
Erfahrung mit GPU-Infrastruktur und Kostenoptimierung im Cloud-Umfeld

That sounds like you?

Du denkst in Systemen und Fundamenten, nicht nur in einzelnen Lösungen – und baust so, dass andere darauf aufbauen können.
Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Verhältnismäßigkeit – du baust die Infrastruktur, die das Problem braucht, nicht die größtmögliche. Und du erkennst, wann der pragmatische Weg der richtige ist.
Du kannst "nein" sagen, ohne Türen zu schließen – und ein Scheitern eingestehen, auch wenn du schon Aufwand investiert hast.
Du prüfst deine eigenen Ergebnisse kritisch, bevor jemand anderes es tut.
Ein offenes Auge für Defizite und Potenziale, technisch wie organisatorisch

Reasons to become part of AMDT

Transformative Möglichkeiten und integrative Kultur: Werde Teil eines dynamischen, sich weiterentwickelnden Unternehmens, in dem Wachstum gefördert wird, deine Beiträge geschätzt werden und du in einer vielfältigen, unterstützenden Gemeinschaft zusammenarbeiten und dich entfalten kannst.
Flexible Arbeitsmöglichkeiten: Arbeite so, wie es für dich am besten ist – remote, hybrid oder in unserem hochmodernen Büro.
Zukunftssicherheit: Wir investieren in deine Zukunft und leisten einen Beitrag von 20 % zu einem umfassenden betrieblichen Alterversversongung.
Zusätzliche Krankenversicherung: Genieße zusätzliche Sicherheit mit einer Krankenzusatzversicherung, die dein Wohlbefinden über das Grundlegende hinaus unterstützt.
Unternehmensvorteile: Profitiere von exklusiven Rabatten auf ausgewählte Marken, um deinen Alltag zu bereichern.
Kontinuierliches Lernen: Nutze Preply für einfaches Sprachenlernen und unterstütze so deine persönliche und berufliche Entwicklung.
Meilensteine feiern: Freue dich über Geschenke zu wichtigen Lebensereignissen wie Heirat, Geburt eines Kindes oder deinem Jubiläum bei uns.

Contact us

Wenn Du Fragen zu der Stelle haben solltest, wende Dich bitte an unser Recruiting-Team (Chiara & Dirk) unter hiring@amdt.com mit Verweis auf den Titel der Stelle

About Us

AMDT is the global market and technology leader for versioning and backup solutions in industrial automation. With its octoplant software platform, the company secures the automation of production processes through strong end-point management, where it consistently records and monitors changes to configurations, programming and project statuses in production. This minimizes downtime, increases efficiency, quality and safety standards, and saves costs as well as resources. new_jobs.description:
Description & Requirements

Who we are looking for

📌 This is a future-oriented recruitment process. While we may not have an immediate opening, we're building a network of talented engineers interested in future opportunities with Deloitte. We expect demand to grow in the coming months, so we'd love to get to know great candidates in advance.

We are looking for an experienced AI-native Full-Stack or Backend Engineer
who combines strong software engineering fundamentals with advanced practical experience in AI-assisted and agentic development.

You will work with clients, architects, product teams, and business stakeholders to turn complex and often ambiguous problems into production-ready solutions. AI-native engineering is a core capability of this role
, with AI integrated across the SDLC while maintaining high standards of quality, security, and maintainability.

The role is technology-agnostic. You should be comfortable working across different technology stacks, rapidly understanding unfamiliar systems, and selecting the right approach for the problem.

Core Qualities:

AI-native engineering

You use AI and coding agents as an integral part of software engineering and understand the advanced practices required to make agentic development effective, reliable, and scalable across the SDLC.

Technology-agnostic problem solving

You have strong engineering fundamentals and can quickly become productive across unfamiliar languages, frameworks, platforms, and architectures.

End-to-end ownership

You take responsibility for outcomes across the complete lifecycle — from understanding the business problem and designing the solution to implementation, deployment, and production operation.

Systems thinking

You reason about complete systems, including applications, APIs, data, integrations, infrastructure, security, observability, and operational constraints.

Customer-focused collaboration

You work effectively with clients and multidisciplinary teams, translating ambiguous business needs into practical technical solutions and communicating decisions and trade-offs clearly.

Curiosity and adaptability

You enjoy solving unfamiliar problems, learning new technologies, and continuously improving how software is designed and delivered.

Required experience and engineering capabilities:

Advanced and proven experience designing, leading, and controlling agentic software development as a primary way of delivering complex software.
You should be able to demonstrate how you structure the work of AI coding agents across the SDLC — providing them with the right specifications, context, tools, environments, orchestration, guardrails, and feedback mechanisms — to reliably deliver production-quality software while retaining engineering oversight and accountability.
Approximately 5+ years of professional software engineering experience
, preferably including consulting, client-facing engineering, solution engineering, or similar roles.
Strong backend or full-stack engineering experience
in one or more ecosystems such as Java, C#, Python, Node.js/TypeScript, Go, or similar, combined with the ability to work effectively outside a primary technology stack.
Experience designing and delivering APIs, integrations, distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and data-intensive applications
.
Strong knowledge of relational and non-relational databases
and experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
Strong understanding of software architecture, security, scalability, reliability, performance, and maintainability
.
Hands-on experience with Git, automated testing, CI/CD, containers, observability, and modern software delivery practices
.
Ability to independently investigate unfamiliar systems
, operate effectively with incomplete or evolving requirements, and rapidly become productive in new technical environments.
Strong problem-solving, client communication, and stakeholder-management skills
, including the ability to explain technical decisions and trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences.

Additional experience that will help you succeed:

Frontend experience with React, Angular, Vue, or similar frameworks.
Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, serverless architectures, microservices, and infrastructure as code.
Knowledge of enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, Microsoft platforms, Creatio, or comparable systems.
Experience delivering AI agents, copilots, workflow automation, or intelligent enterprise applications.
Familiarity with API management, enterprise integration platforms, event streaming, and advanced observability practices.

Your future role

Own solution delivery end-to-end:
work directly with clients to understand business problems, design solutions, and deliver production-grade applications, services, APIs, integrations, and data solutions.
Apply AI-native engineering across the SDLC:
use advanced agentic development practices to accelerate discovery, design, implementation, testing, review, debugging, documentation, and production support while maintaining engineering quality and security.

Selection process

What you only must do is to take the first step – press the apply button and send us your CV, go through all the stages of the recruitment process:

CV check and then HR screening

Technical interview
with our Architects
Meeting with Business

InPost Group is an innovative European out of home deliveries company, revolutionizing the way parcels are delivered to customers. With operations across several countries, our network of intelligent lockers provides customers with a fast, convenient, and secure delivery option. InPost Group is a publicly traded company, with a market capitalization of about $5 billion as of March 2023. With over 10,000 people worldwide, InPost Group is one of the largest out of home delivery providers in Europe, committed to providing sustainable and efficient delivery solutions to meet the evolving needs of customers in today's rapidly changing landscape.

We are a team that builds the best FMCG e-commerce in Poland.
We already have over 300,000 products
in our offer, we work with over 300 sellers
, and our mobile application has already been downloaded by almost 1.5 million users in Poland
. Due to the fact that our product consists of many elements that must work together efficiently and be managed effectively, we are looking for experienced consumer-focused (Web / Mobile App products) engineering leaders to join us in that journey
- heavily influence our future platform build, improve processes and help us deliver best customer experience in the market across all types of devices.

Job Description

InPost's FinTech Platform team is looking for a Staff Engineer to define the technical direction for one of our platform areas - Payments Core, Merchant, or Consumer. You'll multiply team output through architecture clarity, engineering standards, and cross-team technical leadership, while helping evolve our agentic engineering harness in a data-driven way.

You'll own the evolution of fundamental technology decisions across your area - ensuring they're sound, defensible, and viable for the long term - and act as the technical throughline between engineering teams, product strategy, and the organisation's wider architecture standards.

→ Hybrid working model:
preferably 1 day per week in the Warsaw or Cracow office
.

Responsibilities:

Define and maintain the backend technical architecture for your area: domain boundaries, event contracts, state machine patterns, data consistency models, and cross-service API design across multiple teams
Author Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and RFCs, facilitating technical decision-making across teams with documented reasoning and clear trade-off analysis
Evaluate and decide on fundamental technology trade-offs: database selection, cloud services, message broker topology, and consistency models appropriate for financial data
Own the evolution of the agentic development harness - instrument it, measure adoption and friction, and drive improvements with data
Drive org-wide technical change: identify patterns to adopt or deprecate broadly, build the case, and see adoption through across teams without direct authority
Provide technical input into product strategy; mentor Staff-track engineers through design reviews, pairing, and technical writing feedback

Qualifications

8+ years in software engineering, including 2+ years in cross-team technical leadership or architecture authority
3+ years designing distributed payments or fintech systems
Hands-on experience with multiple tech stacks and expertise in backend
Solid grounding in distributed systems architecture - event sourcing, CQRS, domain events, saga pattern - and state machine / financial entity lifecycle design
Experience designing APIs at service-boundary level - REST, async, and event-based contracts
Comfort with database trade-off reasoning (relational, time-series, document, ledger-style) and cloud architecture evaluation (AWS/GCP/Azure)
Experience designing or evolving an agentic engineering harness — instrumentation, adoption measurement, iteration
Working knowledge of LLM tool-use patterns and context management in engineering workflows
Excellent technical writing - ADRs, RFCs, and design docs for multiple audiences
English proficiency at B2 or above

Nice to have:

2+ years in platform or internal developer tooling engineering
1+ years of agentic/LLM system design experience
2+ years in BNPL or lending domain architecture

new_jobs.title: AI-Native Full-Stack / Backend Engineer (Forward Deployed Engineering)
new_jobs.description:
Description & Requirements

Who we are looking for

📌 This is a future-oriented recruitment process. While we may not have an immediate opening, we're building a network of talented engineers interested in future opportunities with Deloitte. We expect demand to grow in the coming months, so we'd love to get to know great candidates in advance.

We are looking for an experienced AI-native Full-Stack or Backend Engineer
who combines strong software engineering fundamentals with advanced practical experience in AI-assisted and agentic development.

You will work with clients, architects, product teams, and business stakeholders to turn complex and often ambiguous problems into production-ready solutions. AI-native engineering is a core capability of this role
, with AI integrated across the SDLC while maintaining high standards of quality, security, and maintainability.

The role is technology-agnostic. You should be comfortable working across different technology stacks, rapidly understanding unfamiliar systems, and selecting the right approach for the problem.

Core Qualities:

AI-native engineering

You use AI and coding agents as an integral part of software engineering and understand the advanced practices required to make agentic development effective, reliable, and scalable across the SDLC.

Technology-agnostic problem solving

You have strong engineering fundamentals and can quickly become productive across unfamiliar languages, frameworks, platforms, and architectures.

End-to-end ownership

You take responsibility for outcomes across the complete lifecycle — from understanding the business problem and designing the solution to implementation, deployment, and production operation.

Systems thinking

You reason about complete systems, including applications, APIs, data, integrations, infrastructure, security, observability, and operational constraints.

Customer-focused collaboration

You work effectively with clients and multidisciplinary teams, translating ambiguous business needs into practical technical solutions and communicating decisions and trade-offs clearly.

Curiosity and adaptability

You enjoy solving unfamiliar problems, learning new technologies, and continuously improving how software is designed and delivered.

Required experience and engineering capabilities:

Advanced and proven experience designing, leading, and controlling agentic software development as a primary way of delivering complex software.
You should be able to demonstrate how you structure the work of AI coding agents across the SDLC — providing them with the right specifications, context, tools, environments, orchestration, guardrails, and feedback mechanisms — to reliably deliver production-quality software while retaining engineering oversight and accountability.
Approximately 5+ years of professional software engineering experience
, preferably including consulting, client-facing engineering, solution engineering, or similar roles.
Strong backend or full-stack engineering experience
in one or more ecosystems such as Java, C#, Python, Node.js/TypeScript, Go, or similar, combined with the ability to work effectively outside a primary technology stack.
Experience designing and delivering APIs, integrations, distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and data-intensive applications
.
Strong knowledge of relational and non-relational databases
and experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
Strong understanding of software architecture, security, scalability, reliability, performance, and maintainability
.
Hands-on experience with Git, automated testing, CI/CD, containers, observability, and modern software delivery practices
.
Ability to independently investigate unfamiliar systems
, operate effectively with incomplete or evolving requirements, and rapidly become productive in new technical environments.
Strong problem-solving, client communication, and stakeholder-management skills
, including the ability to explain technical decisions and trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences.

Additional experience that will help you succeed:

Frontend experience with React, Angular, Vue, or similar frameworks.
Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, serverless architectures, microservices, and infrastructure as code.
Knowledge of enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, Microsoft platforms, Creatio, or comparable systems.
Experience delivering AI agents, copilots, workflow automation, or intelligent enterprise applications.
Familiarity with API management, enterprise integration platforms, event streaming, and advanced observability practices.

Your future role

Own solution delivery end-to-end:
work directly with clients to understand business problems, design solutions, and deliver production-grade applications, services, APIs, integrations, and data solutions.
Apply AI-native engineering across the SDLC:
use advanced agentic development practices to accelerate discovery, design, implementation, testing, review, debugging, documentation, and production support while maintaining engineering quality and security.

Selection process

What you only must do is to take the first step – press the apply button and send us your CV, go through all the stages of the recruitment process:

CV check and then HR screening

Technical interview
with our Architects
Meeting with Business
(optional, depends on case)

Then, last thing to do will be to sign a contract with us. Deloitte is simply your best choice.

new_jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer - Fintech Platform (m/f/n)
new_jobs.description:
Company Description

InPost Group is an innovative European out of home deliveries company, revolutionizing the way parcels are delivered to customers. With operations across several countries, our network of intelligent lockers provides customers with a fast, convenient, and secure delivery option. InPost Group is a publicly traded company, with a market capitalization of about $5 billion as of March 2023. With over 10,000 people worldwide, InPost Group is one of the largest out of home delivery providers in Europe, committed to providing sustainable and efficient delivery solutions to meet the evolving needs of customers in today's rapidly changing landscape.

We are a team that builds the best FMCG e-commerce in Poland.
We already have over 300,000 products
in our offer, we work with over 300 sellers
, and our mobile application has already been downloaded by almost 1.5 million users in Poland
. Due to the fact that our product consists of many elements that must work together efficiently and be managed effectively, we are looking for experienced consumer-focused (Web / Mobile App products) engineering leaders to join us in that journey
- heavily influence our future platform build, improve processes and help us deliver best customer experience in the market across all types of devices.

Job Description

InPost is building the FinTech platform that powers payments for one of Europe's largest logistics and e-commerce ecosystems. We're looking for a Principal Software Engineer to become our organisation-wide technical authority - someone who can arbitrate architecture decisions across Payments Core, Merchant, and Consumer domains, and who has genuinely shipped AI-assisted engineering workflows in production, not just talked about them.

As Principal Software Engineer, you'll work directly with the Head of FinTech Engineering and business leadership, translating critical business goals - new product lines, regulatory deadlines, growth targets - into architecture decisions and roadmap input. You'll be the final word on cross-domain technical questions that no single team or Staff Engineer can resolve alone.

→ Hybrid working model:
preferably 1 day per week in the Warsaw or Cracow office
.

Responsibilities:

Serve as the single cross-domain technical authority, arbitrating architecture decisions across Payments Core, Merchant, and Consumer platform areas
Partner directly with the Head of Engineering and business leadership to turn business strategy into technical roadmap input
Author Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and RFCs for organisation-wide decisions, with reasoning accessible to both engineers and business stakeholders
Own the agentic engineering harness at an organisational level — design, instrument, and continuously improve AI-assisted engineering workflows based on real production data
Identify and drive the adoption or deprecation of patterns across all teams, building the case and sequencing change without direct authority
Mentor Staff Engineers and Engineering Managers on architecture craft, technical communication, and agentic tooling

Qualifications

10+ years in software engineering, including 5+ years in cross-team technical leadership or architecture authority
5+ years designing distributed payments or fintech systems
3+ years of agentic/LLM engineering in production — shipped systems, not theoretical patterns
Deep knowledge of distributed systems architecture: event sourcing, CQRS, domain events, saga pattern
Experience designing APIs at an organisational boundary level — REST, async, and event-based contracts
Strong grasp of database trade-offs (relational, time-series, document, ledger-style) and cloud architecture evaluation (AWS/GCP/Azure) at organisation scale
Hands-on experience with multi-agent orchestration, tool-use patterns, context management, and evaluation harnesses for AI-assisted engineering workflows
Excellent technical writing for mixed audiences — ADRs and RFCs that work for engineers and business leadership alike
English proficiency at B2 or above
University degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field

Nice to have:

3+ years in platform or internal developer tooling engineering
1+ years of agentic/LLM system design experience
PCI DSS / PSD2 architecture compliance experience from the design phase
BNPL or lending domain architecture experience
Open-source contributions or external technical publishing
Experience building or scaling an internal developer platform
Formal mentorship of Staff-level or EM-track engineers
Polish language skills

Additional Information

Opportunity to work in a diverse, international, and cross-functional environment, along with leading experts.
You work and learn from a senior leader and their leadership team, expanding your experience and exposure in the e-commerce and logistics industries.
 InPost is a growing company that offers its people an increasing number of opportunities in several locations in Europe.
Fulfilling careers with a range of benefits for people and investing in providing training opportunities for their development.
You will feel a part of the InPost community that makes an impact on sustainability, convenient deliveries, and the circular economy every day.
Excellent working environment and flexible hours
We offer B2B type of contract

new_jobs.title: .NET utvecklare - Open Banking
new_jobs.description:
Vill du arbeta med modern .NET-utveckling i ett område där teknik, innovation och finans möts? Vi söker en .NET-utvecklare till vårt Open Banking-team, där du får vara med och utveckla nästa generations lösningar för säker och smidig delning av finansiell information.

Att jobba som .NET-utvecklare

Som .NET-utvecklare blir du en del av vårt Open Banking-team, där du utvecklar moderna lösningar som möjliggör säker och smidig integration mellan banker, fintechbolag och andra externa aktörer.

Open Banking ingår i affärsområde Kund och Vardagsbank – en portfölj där det händer mycket och där teknisk utveckling och nya möjligheter står i fokus. I takt med att regelverk och möjligheterna att dela finansiell information utvecklas får du vara med och bygga nästa generations lösningar och bidra till bättre kundupplevelser.

Tyngdpunkten i rollen ligger på backendutveckling, men du kommer även att arbeta med frontend. Rollen passar dig som vill arbeta med både nyutveckling och vidareutveckling i ett område som är i ständig förändring.

Du Kommer Bland Annat Att

utveckla och vidareutveckla backendtjänster i .NET
bygga och förvalta API och integrationer mot externa aktörer
arbeta med nyutveckling av lösningar inom Open Banking
bidra till tekniska vägval, arkitektur och kvalitet i teamets lösningar
samarbeta nära utvecklare och andra kompetenser i teamet
vid behov även bidra inom frontendutveckling

För att lyckas i rollen

Vi söker dig som har flera års erfarenhet av systemutveckling och som är trygg inom C# och .NET. Du har ett starkt intresse för backendutveckling och tycker om att bygga stabila, säkra och långsiktigt hållbara lösningar.

Vi Ser Att Du Har

flera års erfarenhet av utveckling i C# och .NET
god erfarenhet av backendutveckling
erfarenhet av API och integrationer
erfarenhet av att arbeta med moderna utvecklingsmetoder och verktyg
god förståelse för kvalitet, säkerhet och testbar kod
goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska

Erfarenhet av frontendutveckling är meriterande.

Vem är du?

Som person är du nyfiken och lösningsorienterad och tycker om att sätta dig in i både tekniska problem och verksamhetens behov. Du tar ansvar för ditt arbete och bidrar gärna med idéer och perspektiv kring hur lösningar och arbetssätt kan förbättras.

Eftersom du blir en del av ett team där ni tillsammans ansvarar för både utveckling och kvalitet ser vi också att du trivs med att samarbeta, dela kunskap och hitta lösningar tillsammans med andra.

Vad händer nu?

I ansökan kommer vi att ställa ett antal urvalsfrågor som ligger till grund för första urvalet.

Läs mer om hela vår rekryteringsprocess här.

Om du har frågor kring rollen, vänligen kontakta rekryterande chef Monika Olsén på monika.olsen@skandia.se.

Om du har frågor kopplat till rekryteringsprocess, vänligen ta kontakt med Nina Fazeli på nina.fazeli@skandia.se.
