new_jobs.title: Software Engineer / AI Engineer
new_jobs.description:
We're growing our engineering team and looking for both Software Engineers and AI Engineers to help build the next generation of Aleido's platform. Whether your strength is solid, scalable software or applying AI to real products, you'll join a team where AI isn't a side project. It's built into what we deliver and how we build it.

About The Role

You'll work on Aleido's modular platform for product information, used by some of the world's leading industrial companies to create, manage and deliver technical content. You'll own work from specification to deployment, contribute to technical decisions and help shape how we engineer as a team.

You'll join us in one of two directions:

As a Software Engineer, you'll focus on building high-quality features across the platform: APIs, cloud services and modular architecture on Azure and .NET.
As an AI Engineer, you'll focus on bringing AI into the platform and our products: LLM-powered features, agent integrations, automation and tooling that turns AI capabilities into measurable customer value.

Both directions share the same foundation and work closely together.

What You'll Do

Own development tasks from specification to deployment.
Write high-quality, scalable and maintainable code, using AI-assisted development to work faster without compromising quality.
Contribute to design and architecture discussions and propose technical solutions.
Perform thorough code reviews and contrubute to overall code validation and quality practices.
Collaborate closely with Product Owners and UX to refine requirements.
Support platform operations, monitoring and troubleshooting.
Improve workflows, documentation and engineering standards, including how we work with AI.
Stay curious about new technologies and help keep our solutions ahead of the curve.

Who You Are

We believe that you have:

A strong understanding of software engineering, cloud services and distributed systems.
Good experience with Azure, .NET or an equivalent modern tech stack.
An understanding of CI/CD pipelines, automated testing and observability.
A clear grasp of API design, modular architecture and platform patterns.
Hands-on experience using AI tools in your development work, and genuine interest in where this technology is heading.
Strong problem-solving and debugging skills, and a sense of ownership for what you deliver.
Clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Fluency in English, written and spoken.

For the AI Engineer direction, we also expect experience building with LLMs, AI services or frameworks (e.g. Anthropic, OpenAI or Azure AI services), and with integrating AI capabilities into .NET applications.

Nice to have

Experience with Azure cloud platform.
Familiarity of AI/ML-enabled systems, including information flow, uncertainty and error propagation, common failure modes, and approaches to troubleshooting and debugging.
Experience with agentic workflows, MCP or other AI integration patterns.
Understanding of business process mapping and optimization techniques.
Familiarity with content management, technical documentation or aftermarket information.

Who We Are

Aleido is a Swedish international company with a long heritage of driving the development of product information and learning solutions. Our customers develop complex products or systems, or seek knowledge and confidence to create lasting change, within a wide range of industries including automotive, telecom, advanced machinery, rail and medtech. We are almost a thousand colleagues in five countries. Together we bridge the gap between technology and the people who depend on it – by making the advanced simply understood.

You'll be part of a tight-knit and innovative team where your work truly makes a difference. We believe in empowering people, embracing creativity and constantly pushing the boundaries of what's possible with software and AI.

Joining IN Groupe means helping to shape the future of the identity and secure transaction market. Become part of our international teams — driven by innovation and proud to design solutions that make life easier and protect personal data for millions of people around the world.

We are looking for a Senior backend engineer to join our Stockholm office
with strong, hands‑on expertise in modern Java,
experienced in building and maintaining distributed systems and microservices. Brings solid proficiency in CI/CD and Azure DevOps

Integrationer för molnbaserade tjänster
Cloud DevOps och DevSecOps samt Lösningsarkitektur
DevOps verktyg; Git, Docker, Maven, Kubernetes

Goda kunskaper av Mikrotjänster - Utveckling och distribution av mikrotjänster i molnet inklusive containerisering, orkestrering och infrastruktur som kod med hjälp av Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, BlackDuck, samt +2 års dokumenterade erfarenhet av att designa/implementera AI/ML-lösningar, med fokus på maskininlärning, djupinlärning, NLP och GenAI
Du skriver och talar flytande svenska då det används i det dagliga arbetet

Front-end erfarenhet inom följande: Angular, Vue.js eller Jquery

Join our mission to grow and transform the subscription economy by simplifying subscription service delivery.

Infiterra
enables IT distributors, Managed Service Providers (MSPs), and telcos to succeed in the subscription economy. Our subscription commerce platform automates and unifies subscription workflows - from quote to bill- driving operational efficiency, billing accuracy, and scalable growth.

Recognized as a global leader in subscription commerce, Infiterra combines innovation, performance excellence, and trusted expertise to help partners transform and grow.

Join Infiterra and help power the future of subscription e-commerce.

Infiterra’s B2B SaaS platform helps IT Distributors and Managed Service Providers (MSPs) automate and grow their subscription business. With 100+ customers in 75 countries, we're recognized for innovation and global impact—and we’re just getting started. We foster a collaborative and growth-oriented culture, allowing you to be part of a dynamic, forward-thinking team.

The role in a nutshell 🔍

As a .NET Software Engineer, you'll be part of our agile team, working in the Scrum framework to deliver new features and improve existing ones in our subscription e-commerce platform, the multi-tenant B2B engine that powers global distributors. You'll own whole features within a product domain, from design to production, and work alongside experienced engineers who'll support your growth. From building scalable services to integrating major Software Vendors with our platform, your work will directly shape what our customers use every day.

🎯 Your goal?

To design and deliver reliable, well-tested features that simplify subscription services delivery, following our coding and architectural standards.

You'll be hands-on with .NET (legacy full .NET Framework 4.8 and .NET 10 (latest)), C#, SQL, and domain and service-oriented approaches. You'll work closely with POs, BAs, QA, and DevOps in an agile environment, so that features are delivered smoothly and predictably.

You won’t just code features. You'll own your features end-to-end: design, build, test, release, and keep them healthy in production.

🙋‍♀️ Our Ideal Candidate Profile

You’re a curious and analytical engineer who sees the big picture but sweats the details. You enjoy diving into system architecture, making thoughtful trade-offs, and writing clean, testable code.

You thrive in a fast-paced environment where innovation meets stability. You’re not just a builder. You’re a problem solver who looks for ways to make systems more efficient, scalable, and maintainable.

You value teamwork and knowledge-sharing, but you’re also confident in owning features independently. You’re someone who wants to grow while helping the team grow.

Work on a platform that directly impacts customers across 75+ countries.
Hands-on exposure to APIs, billing systems, and large-scale/high-traffic B2B commerce.
A collaborative engineering culture with peer-led code reviews and knowledge-sharing.
Opportunities to shape system architecture and technical direction.
Friendly, dynamic team with room to grow and learn.

Feature Ownership: Own the end-to-end delivery of whole features within a domain, designing and delivering them independently to our coding and architectural standards.
Technical Debt: Manage your own technical debt through refactoring.
Automated Testing: Write robust automated tests.
Code Reviews: Review your peers' pull requests.
Observability: Build observability into your features, with guidance from DevOps.
Dependencies: Surface cross-team dependencies early.
Clear Communication: Explain technical trade-offs clearly to Product and Quality.
AI-assisted Engineering: Use approved AI tools across implementation, testing, debugging and refactoring, while remaining accountable for correctness and maintainability.

Success looks like: predictable delivery, stable production, more tech debt paid down than introduced in your area, and low escaped defects and rework on the changes you own. All of this comes from strong feature ownership, systems thinking, valuable code-review contributions and dependability.

What You'll Bring

Hands-on .NET engineering experience, typically gained over 3+ years of professional work. We look for proven depth rather than years alone, and assess this case by case.

Descripción del empleo

¿Cómo marcarás la diferencia?

Liderarás el desarrollo de nuestras aplicaciones de software para PC, junto con el equipo de desarrolladores y expertos, impulsando las mejores prácticas de ingeniería y coordinando al equipo para garantizar soluciones innovadoras, escalables y de alta calidad, alineadas con las necesidades de negocio y de nuestros clientes.

¿Cómo será tu día a día?

Liderar el equipo de desarrolladores y expertos de software para PC.
Definir la arquitectura y la evolución tecnológica de las aplicaciones.
Planificar, coordinar y supervisar proyectos de desarrollo de software, asegurando el cumplimiento de plazos, calidad y objetivos.
Establecer estándares de desarrollo, calidad de código, documentación y ciberseguridad.
Gestionar prioridades, recursos y riesgos técnicos, apoyando al equipo en la resolución de problemas complejos.
Colaborar con los equipos de Producto, Hardware, Firmware y otras áreas para desarrollar soluciones integradas.
Impulsar la mejora continua mediante la automatización de pruebas, integración y despliegue continuo.
Evaluar nuevas tecnologías y promover la innovación en productos y procesos de desarrollo.

¿Qué queremos saber sobre ti?

Formación y base técnica

Grado en Ingeniería Informática, Telecomunicaciones, Electrónica o titulación equivalente.
Se valorará formación de posgrado en ingeniería de software o gestión tecnológica.

Experiencia profesional

Más de 5 años de experiencia en desarrollo de software.
Al menos 2 años liderando equipos técnicos y proyectos de desarrollo.

Conocimientos técnicos valorados

Desarrollo de aplicaciones de escritorio con tecnologías como C#, .NET, C++ o Python.
Diseño de arquitecturas software y desarrollo de productos.
Bases de datos SQL y NoSQL.
Herramientas DevOps, control de versiones y entornos CI/CD.
Metodologías ágiles (Scrum, Kanban).
Integración con sistemas embebidos, dispositivos electrónicos o entornos industriales.

Competencias clave

Liderazgo técnico y gestión de personas.
Orientación a resultados y visión de producto.
Capacidad analítica y resolución de problemas.
Comunicación efectiva y trabajo en entornos multidisciplinares.
Innovación y aprendizaje continuo.

Idiomas

Español: nativo
Inglés: nivel alto (oral y escrito).

¿Qué ofrecemos?

Flexibilidad horaria.
Jornada intensiva los viernes y durante el verano.
Medidas de conciliación para favorecer el equilibrio entre la vida personal y profesional.
La oportunidad de liderar un equipo clave en el desarrollo de productos tecnológicos innovadores.

Legal authorization to work in EU is required. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening.

If you are an agency/third party Recruiter and have not been engaged by Wabtec for this search, we do not owe you a fee if you submit a candidate to the applicant tracking system that is ultimately hired.

En Wabtec, no se trata únicamente de un empleo — se trata del impacto que generas.

Cuando nuestra gente se une, ampliamos lo posible mejorando continuamente lo que hacemos y cómo lo hacemos — para nuestros clientes y entre nosotros.

Si estás preparado para revolucionar la manera en que el mundo se mueve para las generaciones futuras, Wabtec es tu sitio.

Wabtec es un proveedor global líder de equipos, sistemas, soluciones digitales y servicios de valor añadido para los sectores ferroviarios de mercancías y transporte público. Con más de 150 años de experiencia, lideramos en seguridad, eficiencia, fiabilidad, innovación y productividad. new_jobs.description:
Company Description

Creating a future worth living for future generations gets us out of bed every morning. Depending on the project, we are consultants, implementers, or both for sustainable, innovative and economical solutions for real estate, industry, energy and infrastructure. Our more than 6,500 employees at over 80 locations worldwide support our customers in interdisciplinary teams. Our thinking is both visionary and realistic. We work independently and as part of a team. With passion and the latest technologies. We unite. Join us at Dreso and let’s create a world we want to live in.

Job Description

We help our clients turn data into measurable value. From data platforms and analytics to AI-powered applications, we develop smart solutions for complex projects across industry, real estate, and infrastructure.

As a Solution Engineer
, you play a key role at the interface between our clients, solution architects, and product developers. You translate business needs into viable data and AI solutions, guide their implementation, and make sure they deliver real value in client projects.

Your Responsibilities

Act as the trusted point of contact for clients on Smart, Data & AI topics, from first needs assessment through to solution rollout.
Analyze business processes and translate client requirements into functional and technical requirements, use cases, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
Work with solution architects to design data architectures, data models, analytics solutions, and AI use cases that fit the client's context.
Support the implementation of data, analytics, and AI solutions together with developers, architects, and data engineers.
Assess requirements against existing standard solutions, configuration options, and the need for new development.
Plan and facilitate workshops, demos, user acceptance tests, and solution validations with clients and project teams.
Support clients with adoption, training, and change management activities and feed project learnings back into solution development.
Communicate complex technical and analytical topics clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of Smart, Data & AI offerings, methodologies, and best practices.
Take ownership beyond advisory services by actively leading and supporting the delivery and deployment of solutions, ensuring concepts are successfully translated into operational outcomes for clients.

Qualifications

Completed degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Data Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a comparable qualification.
At least 5 years of professional experience in consulting, business analysis, solution engineering, or solution design within data, analytics, or AI-related projects.
Proven experience working in a client-facing role between business stakeholders and technical teams.
Strong understanding of data platforms, data modeling, ETL/ELT processes, analytics solutions, BI concepts, and the fundamentals of machine learning and generative AI.
Experience in requirements engineering, process analysis, user stories, acceptance criteria, and workshop facilitation.
Familiarity with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.
Understanding of data governance, security, roles, and permission concepts.
Hands-on experience with Python, SQL, data analysis, or AI technologies is considered a strong advantage.
Strong analytical thinking, a structured approach to problem-solving, and the confidence to challenge requirements constructively.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills in English and German.

Additional Information

To ensure your work-life balance, we offer the option of mobile working
We promote your professional and personal development through individual training and further education at the Drees & Sommer Academy
We support your health with a bonus for sports enthusiasts. We offer the possibility of subscribing to a private health insurance policy
Employees benefit from tax advantages related to their commuting expenses for the office
Fiscal advantages for employees expenses in meal costs during worktime. Employee referral program with attractive bonus scheme
Supporting career and family by receiving tax benefits for kindergarten expenses

, helping define and validate architectures that are scalable, secure, and aligned with enterprise standards.
You will work across multiple projects simultaneously, collaborating closely with CIO stakeholders, infrastructure teams, security specialists, application teams, and other architects.
The position combines hands-on technical architecture, enterprise governance, cloud strategy, and solution design
, with a strong focus on Azure architecture, networking, security, integration, and application provisioning
.
If you have broad architecture experience, enjoy working across different technology domains, and are comfortable challenging and validating complex technical solutions, this could be a great fit.

💻 What you’ll do

🔹 Define and validate target architectures
covering Cloud, Security, Data, Network, Integration, Infrastructure, Containers, and implementation standards
🔹 Support strategic technology programmes including Cloud Transformation, AI & Agentic AI, API Management, IT Security, and Workplace

🔹 Provide Enterprise Architecture
guidance to ensure consistency across the IT landscape and alignment with business objectives
🔹 Design and review Azure cloud architectures
, including Landing Zones, network topology, security controls, and platform services
🔹 Define and assess architectures based on hub-and-spoke networking models
, connectivity, segmentation, identity, and security principles
🔹 Lead and participate in Design Authority and Architecture Review Board (ARB)
processes
🔹 Review solution architectures and ensure alignment with enterprise and group standards
🔹 Define architecture principles, standards, patterns, and guidelines for APIs, services, cloud platforms, and distributed systems

🔹 Support application and infrastructure refresh strategies and technology roadmaps

🔹 Ensure proper end-to-end integration, security, resilience, and scalability
of proposed solutions
🔹 Collaborate with project and engineering teams during solution design and implementation
🔹 Provide architectural leadership, identifying technical risks and challenging proposed solutions when necessary
🔹 Contribute to Business Vision, Blueprints, Value Chains, and technology roadmaps

🔹 Support the provisioning and integration of applications across enterprise environments
🔹 Document architecture decisions and contribute to governance documentation and architecture standards

💡 Must Have

🔹 10+ years of professional experience
in IT, with strong experience in Technical, Solution, Cloud, or Enterprise Architecture roles
🔹 Strong understanding of cloud architecture concepts
, particularly within the Microsoft Azure ecosystem

🔹 Hands-on knowledge of Azure platform components and architecture patterns

🔹 Experience with Azure Landing Zones

🔹 Strong understanding of networking architecture
, including hub-and-spoke models, connectivity, segmentation, and security
🔹 Strong background in infrastructure architecture
, including Windows and Linux environments
🔹 Experience defining complex target architectures
across Cloud, Security, Network, Data, Integration, and Infrastructure
🔹 Strong understanding of IT Security principles
and experience validating solutions in highly secure environments
🔹 Good knowledge of DevOps and CI/CD concepts

🔹 Understanding of containers and modern application deployment models

🔹 Good knowledge of data management concepts
, architectures, tools, and large-scale data processing
🔹 Experience with API and service-oriented architectures

🔹 Ability to assess architecture from an end-to-end perspective
, rather than focusing on a single technology layer
🔹 Experience working in large enterprise environments
, ideally with multi-regional infrastructure
🔹 Strong communication skills and ability to interact with technical teams, architects, security teams, and senior stakeholders
🔹 Fluent English

🔹 Experience with AI and Agentic AI architectures

new_jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer (Booking Integrations)
new_jobs.description:
About The Team

Breakneck Studio
– an incubator and accelerator scaling digital and e-commerce brands at high velocity. It’s home to our Co-Found program, where ambitious founders take products from zero to market in months, not years. This is where you get hands-on, zero-to-scale experience you won’t find in a regular job.

We are looking

We are a fast-scaling travel startup with strong product-market fit, a generational traveltech company looking to disturb this sleepy industry. We are two-sided: travelers get a consumer product that helps them plan and book trips, and advisors get a SaaS-style subscription with certification and qualified leads in the offer.

We’re looking for the first developers to join a fast-growing travel startup that’s already found strong product-market fit and is now ready to scale.

This is not a role for someone who wants to manage agencies, coordinate stakeholders, or spend weeks building presentations. We’re looking for a builder – someone who can design a schema for breakfast, build a sandbox environment for lunch, load test it before dinner, and wake up excited to get it ready for prod the upcoming week.

You’ll work directly with the founder and early team, own growth from day one, and help shape what the product looks like as the company scales. Work-life balance can look different in a fast-moving company that’s on a mission to make a real impact.

Ready to apply?

Jump to the application form and start your journey with us.

Apply Now

Get ready to

Design, build, and own integrations with third-party booking systems such as suppliers, booking platforms, and partner APIs, covering everything from modern REST/OAuth APIs to legacy SOAP services.
Architect the webhook ingestion and worker queue infrastructure that keeps bookings, availability, and status updates flowing reliably at scale.
Design database schemas in Supabase (PostgreSQL) that model complex booking data cleanly and hold up as volume grows.
Build sandbox and testing environments so integrations can be developed, validated, and debugged safely before they reach production.
Load test and harden services, finding bottlenecks and failure points before customers do.
Take integrations from prototype to production: monitoring, alerting, retries, idempotency, and graceful handling of flaky third-party systems.
Make sure credentials, tokens, and traveler data are handled securely across every integration.
Help evolve our TypeScript, Supabase, and TanStack MVP into a scalable, production-grade platform, and make key architectural decisions along the way.
Work directly with the founder and early team to decide which integrations matter most for travelers and advisors, and ship them fast.
Set the engineering standards, patterns, and practices that future developers will build on as the team grows.

We expect you to

Strong software engineering fundamentals, with deep experience in Authentication & Identity and Backend Software Engineering (PostgreSQL, PHP/Laravel, Node.js/TypeScript).
Expert-level understanding of API authentication across many integration styles, including:
OAuth 2.0 (authorization code, client credentials, PKCE, refresh token rotation) and OIDC
SOAP APIs, including WS-Security, XML signatures and certificate-based authentication
REST API auth patterns such as API keys, HMAC request signing, JWT and mutual TLS

Proven experience designing secure, scalable webhook systems: signature verification, idempotency, replay protection, deduplication, ordering, rate limiting and dead-letter handling.
Hands-on experience building asynchronous job processing with AWS SQS workers, Temporal workflows, or an equivalent durable execution or queue system, including retries, backoff and failure recovery.
Experience integrating with a wide variety of third-party systems, including poorly documented or legacy APIs, and building abstractions that make new integrations faster to add.
Secure handling of credentials and secrets at scale, such as token storage, encryption, rotation and per-tenant isolation.
Strong TypeScript skills, as it is the team’s primary development language.
Solid grasp of engineering best practices, automation and observability, using tools such as Datadog for monitoring and alerting on integration health.
Comfortable in an agile, collaborative environment, communicating clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including external partners’ engineering teams.
Experience leading technical initiatives, influencing architectural decisions or providing technical leadership across teams.

Salary

Gross salary range is 6000-8000 EUR/month + stock options (ESOP) depending on your experience.

Location

We have several great workspaces to choose from, including our headquarters in Vilnius and our hubs in Klaipėda and Riga.

For our Vilnius office, we follow a 4 days onsite, 1 day remote
hybrid model. For roles based outside Vilnius, the work arrangement -onsite, hybrid, or remote-depends on the specific position.

Speaking Of Perks

Own your wellness

Stay sharp and well in your own way – health insurance (after probation), on-site physiotherapist, office gym, and fitness classes keep you moving. Plus 7 extra days off, 3 for weddings, hybrid work, and the freedom to work 2 months from anywhere in the world.

new_jobs.title: Solutions Developer
new_jobs.description:
About Mixvoip
We are Mixvoip, a Luxembourg-based company providing Cloud Telephony, Connectivity, Cybersecurity, and Managed IT Services to businesses and public organizations.
We design, operate, and support many of our solutions ourselves. When we see an inefficient process, a missing integration, or an opportunity to create a better customer experience, we like to build something that solves it.
That’s where you come in.
About the role
You will join Mixvoip’s IT Services team as a Solutions Developer.
Your role sits between software development, infrastructure, automation, and product design.
You will build internal tools that make our teams more efficient, automate repetitive processes, connect systems through APIs, and contribute to customer-facing products.
Projects can be very different from one another. You might build a small automation in Python, a backend service in Rust or C#, a React interface, an integration between several platforms, or a complete solution combining software, infrastructure, authentication, APIs, and physical devices.
We are therefore not looking for someone attached to one specific framework.
We are looking for someone who can understand a problem, choose an appropriate technical approach, prototype quickly, and turn the result into something secure, reliable, understandable, and maintainable.
AI-assisted development is part of how we work. You should be comfortable using coding assistants and development agents such as Codex, Claude, or similar tools to explore codebases, build features, refactor, test, document, and accelerate development.
The important part is not how much code AI can generate for you. It is whether you understand what is being built and remain responsible for the architecture, security, quality, and operation of the final solution.
Key responsibilities
Design and develop internal applications, automation, and operational tools

Contribute to customer-facing products and new commercial solutions

Translate operational or business needs into practical software solutions

Prototype ideas quickly and turn successful prototypes into production-ready systems

Work across technologies such as Rust, Python, C#, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Vite, and similar tools

Build and integrate APIs, webhooks, databases, internal systems, and third-party services

Design frontend, backend, and service components when required

Apply appropriate software architecture and design patterns without unnecessary complexity

Implement authentication, authorization, and secure handling of application data

Write maintainable, testable, and understandable code

Review both human-written and AI-generated code critically

Build automated tests and contribute to CI/CD and deployment processes

Deploy and operate applications in Linux, Windows, containerized, cloud, or on-premises environments

Troubleshoot across application and infrastructure layers, including logs, networking, databases, APIs, permissions, and services

Implement appropriate logging, monitoring, and health checks

Document architecture, dependencies, APIs, deployment procedures, and important technical decisions

Identify manual or repetitive work that could be simplified through software or automation

Work closely with systems engineers, network engineers, support teams, and other colleagues across Mixvoip

What do we need from you?
Strong software development fundamentals

Professional experience building applications, tools, automation, platforms, or software products

Experience with more than one programming language or technology stack

Strong knowledge of at least one backend language such as Rust, Python, C#, or similar

Experience with modern web development using TypeScript, React, Next.js, Vite, or comparable technologies

Good understanding of APIs, HTTP, authentication, webhooks, databases, and system integrations

Good understanding of software architecture and common design patterns

Experience with Git, code reviews, testing, and collaborative development workflows

Good understanding of application security

Good infrastructure fundamentals, including networking, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, operating systems, permissions, and reverse proxies

Comfortable working with Linux and the command line

Familiarity with containers and modern deployment practices

Strong experience using AI coding assistants and development agents in real development work

Ability to review AI-generated solutions critically and recognize when they are incorrect, insecure, or unnecessarily complex

Ability to learn unfamiliar technologies quickly

Good documentation habits

Professional proficiency in English

You do not need to be an expert in every technology we use.
Strong fundamentals, adaptability, and good engineering judgment matter more to us than knowing a specific framework by heart.
What would make you stand out?
Experience with Rust, Python, C#, or .NET

Advanced TypeScript and React experience

Experience building internal tools or operational platforms

Experience turning manual business processes into software and automation

Experience developing customer-facing software products

Experience integrating hardware, meeting room equipment, embedded devices, or IoT systems

Experience with PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Redis, message queues, or event-driven architectures

Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, or infrastructure-as-code

Experience operating applications in both cloud and on-premises environments

Knowledge of OAuth2, OpenID Connect, SAML, LDAP, Active Directory, or Entra ID

Experience integrating Microsoft 365, Teams, Exchange, calendars, or meeting room technologies

Good understanding of enterprise IT infrastructure and networking

Experience with monitoring, observability, secrets management, and secure software development

Contributions to open-source projects or personal technical projects

French, German, and/or Luxembourgish

Why Mixvoip?
At Mixvoip, you will work on software that solves real problems.
An internal tool might remove hours of repetitive work every week. An integration might eliminate an entire manual process. A prototype might become a product offered to our customers.
You will work close to the people who use what you build, and across telecom, cloud, networking, cybersecurity, managed IT, software, and sometimes hardware.
This also means you can work on a solution end to end: from the initial idea and architecture to the code, infrastructure, deployment, and operation.
We encourage experimentation and rapid prototyping, while expecting production systems to be secure, reliable, and maintainable.
You will have freedom in how you solve problems, together with responsibility for the technical decisions you make.
A new way to apply: Join Mixvoip’s success story
We would like to see more than your CV.
Record a brief video with your smartphone and tell us about something you have built. It can be a commercial product, an internal tool, an automation, a personal project, or something completely different.
Tell us what problem you were trying to solve, how you approached it, and what technical decisions you made.
Please remember to attach your CV in PDF format too.
Instead of a conventional motivational letter, we would also like you to use an AI tool of your choice.
For this role, show us how you use an AI coding assistant or development agent to solve a technical problem. We are interested in how you guide the tool, what you verify yourself, and how you apply your own engineering judgment.
PS: Want to know who you’ll be working with? Meet me, Antoine CAVELIER
I’ve been with Mixvoip for 8 years, and my role is to help businesses make better use of their IT.
With the IT Consulting team, we support customers who often have very different realities. Some have an internal IT department and need a reliable technical partner. Others rely on us for almost everything related to their infrastructure, users, security, cloud services, networks, and day-to-day IT operations.
That variety is what makes this job interesting. One day, you may be working on Microsoft 365. Another day, you may be helping with virtualization, servers, storage, backups, Wi-Fi, Linux systems, scripts, migrations, or a customer project that does not fit neatly into one category.
I like people who are curious, structured, and honest about what they know and what they still need to learn. In consulting, nobody knows everything. What matters is the ability to understand the problem, ask the right questions, investigate properly, communicate clearly, and take ownership until things move forward.
I care a lot about practical solutions. Our customers are SMEs. They need systems that work, advice they can understand, and partners they can trust. Good consulting is not only about technical knowledge. It is also about listening, explaining, documenting, prioritizing, and staying calm when something goes wrong.
I also believe that modern IT work should make good use of the right tools, including AI. Not to replace thinking, but to speed up research, scripting, documentation, troubleshooting, and daily operations.
If you enjoy broad technical challenges, customer contact, autonomy, terminal work, small automation tasks, and the idea of helping many different businesses improve their IT step by step, then you could be a great fit for the team.
